user_reviews.Name: Yalemisew Mintsnote Abgaz
user_reviews.Description:
Mama's Kitchen is a nice restaurant in a very convenient location around 4 killo. The fact that all the oldies restaurants are sweept away from the area makes Mama's Kitchen a convenient place.

The atmosphere upstairs is calm. Downstairs looks busy. The toilet and washing area is fairly clean.

Service: there are lots of choices of food. They also serve half portions,which offers a good option for more than two people to test different food.

Customer treatment: this is the poorest thing that they need to work on. First, they do not know what they have in store. They took the order and came back with excuses, when asked alternatives, they said the order is placed and can nit be changed! This is a very common phenomenon in the service sector in Ethiopia. Even for their own fault, they ask the customer to pay for it. ANNOYING! Consumers need to push further to demand a fair treatment!!!

Location: as I said, it is a great and convenient location and has plenty of space.

Price:Fair price, but in the middle upper category for many Ethiopians. Ok for visitors, an option for tourists.

Recommendation: worth to try it out especially if they improve their customer service.

user_reviews.Name: Estifanos Getachew
user_reviews.Description:
Cozy Restaurant is a lifesaver if you are spending time at Abrehot Library! It’s conveniently located just behind the library at 4 Kilo. While they serve great, authentic Ethiopian cuisine and traditional dishes like stews and injera, I personally love coming here for my coffee breaks, as they are the nearest place offering coffee in the evening, around 7–8 p.m.
The ambiance is very inviting and the service is friendly, making it the perfect spot to reset before heading back to work on my projects. It’s a great mix of a traditional dining experience and a cozy place to relax. Definitely check it out if you're in the 4 Kilo area!

user_reviews.Description:
I had a really great experience here! I ordered the chicken shawarma, and it was absolutely delicious—flavorful, juicy, and perfectly seasoned. You can tell they put care into their food.

The place itself was amazing—clean, welcoming, and had a nice vibe that made the meal even more enjoyable. The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service, always with a smile and ready to help.

user_reviews.Name: Yeabtsega Mekonnen
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had an incredibly disappointing experience at Wow Burger. I was excited to try their menu, but unfortunately, my visit was far from satisfying.

First, the food didn’t match what was advertised on the menu. I expected a delicious, well-prepared burger, but what I received was unpleasant and nothing like the description. The ingredients seemed low quality, and the presentation was sloppy.

To make matters worse, the customer service was terrible. The staff seemed uninterested and unhelpful, showing no care or effort in addressing the issues with my order. I left feeling frustrated and very let down, as I had high hopes for this place.

user_reviews.Name: Adonias Moges
user_reviews.Description: I recently visited Romina and was pleased to find that it lived up to the high standards set by the other branches. The service was excellent, the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. I particularly enjoyed the Chikina tibs and Bozena shiro, which were full of flavor and very satisfying. The wait staff at Romina was very attentive and went out of their way to ensure that I enjoyed my meal. Even though the restaurant was quite busy at lunch time, I was able to get a table fairly quickly and the food came out in a timely manner. Also was surprised to see KOBA was right next to it offering a great opportunity to grab treats afterwards! If you're looking for a great place to eat, I highly recommend this place.

user_reviews.Name: Rahel T. D.
user_reviews.Description:
If you are looking for both international and local options, Romina is the place for you!
It's clean and classy, the service is impeccable and the place is comfy despite being on a noisy road (the plants' fence make you feel protected and "far" from the street).

I asked for variations of their juice and they made them for me, no problem whatsoever: once I got guava, avocado and strawberry (the original includes papaya too), then I asked only for guava and strawberry, which were always delicious and clearly made from fresh fruits.

I forgot to photograph the shiro dish I got with cooked veggies on the side. Everything was yummy, I highly recommend you getting lunch and/or dinner at Romina restaurant!

user_reviews.Name: Tsigereda Tena
user_reviews.Description: Romita Cafe and Restaurant is a popular dining establishment located in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Known for its warm and inviting atmosphere, Romita offers a blend of traditional Ethiopian cuisine and international dishes. The restaurant is praised for its friendly service and flavorful food, including injera (a sourdough flatbread) served with a variety of stews and dishes like doro wat (chicken stew) and kitfo (minced raw meat seasoned with spices). Romita is also well-regarded for its coffee, a beverage deeply intertwined with Ethiopian culture. The cafe often serves freshly brewed Ethiopian coffee, which is known for its rich, bold flavor. Overall, Romita Cafe and Restaurant provides a taste of Ethiopian hospitality and cuisine, making it a must-visit for both locals and tourists alike.

user_reviews.Name: Leul T Agonafer
user_reviews.Description:
The new Five Loaves is honestly amazing. The old one was great, but this new branch just takes it up a notch — the vibe, the setup, everything feels leveled up. Warm, classy, n chill at the same time.

We had a few things — Chicken Parmesan, a combo plate, steak, n the Quesadilla(with chicken). That Quesadilla tho… hands down one of the best things I’ve tasted in a long time. Perfectly seasoned, cheesy, n crispy with that soft pita wrap n side sauce— pure goodness.

The Chicken Parmesan was also great, combo was solid, n even the steak (while not the standout) was still good. Everything came out fresh n full of flavor.

Price-wise, it’s actually super fair — most mains fall between 1K–2K birr, which is pretty good for the premium quality you get. Service was smooth, staff were nice, n the atmosphere just makes u wanna stay longer.

Overall, easy 5/5 — top-tier spot for good food, chill vibes, n a bit of class without the pretense

Dine to the fullest

user_reviews.Name: HAWA ABDULKADIR
user_reviews.Description: We came for breakfast at 9 a.m. and were the only customers. Unfortunately, the restaurant was quite noisy, as the staff were talking and shouting across the room. One lady, who seemed to be the manager, was especially loud, which made it difficult to enjoy a calm meal.

user_reviews.Name: Kirubel
user_reviews.Description: The food was good. They seem understaffed when the house is full. It has a good atmosphere. It’s a good place to go as a family or groups.

user_reviews.Name: Bisrat Abraha
user_reviews.Description:
I have always found this place to have a great menu and argued with many before I even tasted it that it maybe the best restaurant in the city. Many said that it wasn't as great in food flavors and service as it is written in the menu.

My brother wanted to have a healthy breakfast meal and recommended this place. I called the place right away and made a reservation and asked until what time they serve breakfast and considering it was Saturday, they said until about 3pm.

When we got there, we parked on the street as there wasn't any parking space for the place located in the busy area of Signal area on the other side of Hayahulet.

No one asked if we had reservation and sat and continued to order our meal. We order Beef Fillet, Grilled Chicken Breast, French Toast and Seafood Omelette.

Out waitress brought us a 'Bruschetta' with tomatoes and parmesan cheese. It was a very nice touch and complimentary. Our lunch / brunch arrived and the Seafood Omelette was more than I expected. It was very hot, delicious, perfect portion and plenty of seafood (both garnished and sauteed with). It was one of the best dishes I have ever had and priced only at 900 birr.

With many new restaurants opening in Addis Ababa like Marcus Addis and C-Prem, Five Loaves seems to have the capablility to compete with those restaurants although it lacks...

1. During the middle of of our lunch / brunch service, the staff that is supposedly to start work at around noon just stormed in through the front door and at that with some staff carrying their aprons in their hands and greeting one another in the middle of the floor and asking the earlier staff the statuses of the morning service.

2. Some great painings / photos are placed on the walls throughout the restaurant, but seem to be dirty, old and not aligned.

3. Shouldn't you have a reception at the door?

But my overall experience at this place was beyond my expectation. It was amazing. I can not wait to return and try other dishes I read in the menu like Roasted Whole Chicken and Chicken Parmesan.

user_reviews.Name: Betlihem M. Abraha
user_reviews.Description: The food is top tier a bit on the expensive side, but if you wanna impress people, it is a great place to recommend. We had the steak sandwich, house burger, and grilled fish. Let me tell you when i say best fish i had in addis, couldn't get enough. To top it off, they even have great desert. It's definitely one to try!!

user_reviews.Name: frank rispin
user_reviews.Description:
Been many times to their original location. Yesterday found their new location.
300 M from Sandfird Koba. Or access from Kebena to Menelik hospital road.
Superb ambience and service and food.
Prices highish for Ethiopia but well worth it.
Cards accepted.

title: Marcus Addis Restaurant & Sky Bar
address: Head Office Tower 47th Floor, Ras Desta Damtew St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: Head Office Tower 47th Floor, Ras Desta Damtew St

user_reviews.Name: Siye Keberabe
user_reviews.Description:
Marcus Addis presents a truly breathtaking concept. Perched high in a stunning Addis Ababa high-rise, the venue offers amazing panoramic views. The physical space is beautifully divided into intimate settings, a stylish bar, a lounge, and a dinner area all of which are outstanding and worthy of a five-star designation.

I will give full credit where it's due: the ambiance and location are world-class.

However, the experience falls short of its immense potential. For a setting of this caliber, the expectation is a seamless, seven-star, ultra-luxurious, and formally impeccable establishment. Currently, there are significant gaps.

The most notable issue lies in the staff's professionalism, discipline, and general coordination. The service lacks the flawless, anticipatory quality required, from the moment one enters to the moment one leaves.

Furthermore, the food was mediocre. I understand the chef is working hard to pioneer a fusion of Ethiopian cuisine with European influences—an ambitious and commendable experiment. Yet, in its current execution, it does not meet the mark for a restaurant that aims for the pinnacle of fine dining.

In summary, Marcus Advis has all the foundational elements of a legendary dining destination: the view, the location, and the beautiful settings. However, to transition from a place of great potential to an undisputed leader, there is substantial work needed in service execution and culinary refinement. It feels very much like a "work in progress."

user_reviews.Name: Sašo Nožič Serini
user_reviews.Description: Marcus is marvellous place in Addis, you can come just for coffe, drink or two *Bedele Special  (my recommendation) and view, have a Tomahawk (Japanese Beef) a la Chef Marcus's (the place got his name after there one chef) for brunch, lunch or dinner and finish with nice gin and whisky or limoncello. Signature cocktail 🍸 👌 list is nice touch with original Ethiopian Habesha flavour. You will definitely not regret the visit.

user_reviews.Name: A S
user_reviews.Description: Swedish celebrity chef Marcus Sameulson's sky restaurant atop a high rise. Definitely an experience you want to enjoy while in Addis Ababa. The cuisine is African fusion with varying international interpretations. I had the scallops which were forgettable, and I was with a large group so there were too many other dishes to get a vibe. The cocktails were perfection. If you're looking for that celebrity chef restaurant experience, this is the place. There's a DJ spinning and the atmosphere is wonderful. You need reservations and you should dress to impress.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Stunning view and amazing atmosphere make this fine dining spot memorable. The service is excellent and welcoming. However, the menu is very limited with few options to choose from. While the food tastes good, the lack of variety and value falls short of expectations.

user_reviews.Name: Jamie NS
user_reviews.Description: Excellent food and service and good value lunch menu.  I really enjoyed my visit here, very friendly and well trained staff.  The Malbec wine and steak were excellent.  All on top of the tallest building in East Africa!

user_reviews.Name: Bisrat Abraha
user_reviews.Description:
From the time the reception confirmed my reservation twice at around 11am as I did move my reservation to another date once, I was impressed at their consistency of what time to confirm reservations.

The place was as lovely and even more than I expected and better than all the videos I saw prior to our arrival.

Chef Marcus is talented of course, but better than his amazing talent lies a view and an elevator ride that is worth a visit to this place.

The price is very affordable and my date and I were surprised as we stared at our bill and already planned another visit very soon.

I like to add that you should work on the Wi-Fi service. You shouldn't have a password for it. Phones or other devices should automatically sign into it. I don't think clients will climb a 47 story building just to use Wi-Fi.

user_reviews.Name: Tortura Tarantulo
user_reviews.Description: Yesterday, I spontaneously decided to visit Addis Ababa's tallest building. I found a very pleasant atmosphere in the sky bar and restaurant there. I got a table without a reservation and was able to enjoy a delicious dinner. I had delicious, high-quality food and excellent service. Rachel served me very attentively. I had an excellent dinner in a pleasant atmosphere with a magnificent view of Addis Ababa at night from the 47th floor. As I left the building, I was warmly bid farewell by a young lady, also named Rachel—what a coincidence.

user_reviews.Name: Swiss Note
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of having dinner at Marcus Addis Restaurant And Sky Bar and it was exceptional. This dining experience perfectly represents Ethiopia’s modernisation. It offered a unique consolidation of traditional Ethiopian dishes with western influenced cuisines. Every dish was presented with care. It was a wonderful experience from start to finish.

The restaurant was located on the 47th floor and the view was absolutely spectacular.

The ambience was stunning, magnificent decor, and they brilliantly integrated comfort and elegance.

A special mention goes to staff members, who truly made our evening memorable and we felt truly valued as guests. Post-dinner the staff offered to give us a private tour of the entire restaurant which occupies an entire floor which topped-off our lovely experience. Overall the service was fantastic.

I understand why Marcus Addis Restaurant And Sky Bar has gained traction in the city. It truly exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a terrific dining experience in Addis Ababa.

Side note: We took couple videos which is on our page and linked to Google Maps.

user_reviews.Description: I had the Special Shawarma, my order arrived very quickly, the server was friendly but the food was lukewarm, chicken was bland and not well seasoned and the French fries were dry and overcooked. It was a fine lunch since i was hungry but quality wasn’t good enough .

user_reviews.Name: Rooney Getu
user_reviews.Description: During my last visit, it was a bit busy, but the food was good, and the portions were generous. I really enjoyed the pineapple mojito. In particular, I highly recommend the shawarma, and the prices were reasonable.

user_reviews.Name: i-see
user_reviews.Description:
During my recent visit to Amrogne Chicken at 4 Killo in Addis Ababa, I encountered what can only be described as a significantly underwhelming dining experience, particularly with their food offerings.
My order began with their Special Shawarma, which unfortunately did not live up to its name. It was a stark contrast to what one would expect from a dish labeled 'special.' The shawarma was not only bland and tasteless but also disappointingly small in portion. To add to the dismay, it was served cold, further diminishing any potential flavor it might have had. This was certainly not the kind of shawarma experience one would look forward to.
Hoping for a better experience, I then tried their Chicken Fajitas. Regrettably, the fajitas followed the same disappointing pattern. The dish lacked the vibrant flavors and textures that are characteristic of a well-made fajita. It seemed more like a beginner's attempt at experimenting with spicy ingredients, without a true understanding of what makes a fajita delightful. The dish lacked cohesion and the flair that is expected in such a popular international dish.
However, it's only fair to mention that the shakes at Amrogne Chicken did partially redeem the experience. The shakes were quite satisfactory, offering a refreshing contrast to the otherwise lackluster meal.
In conclusion, while Amrogne Chicken might have potential in its beverage offerings, the food, specifically the Special Shawarma and Chicken Fajitas, were a letdown. The culinary experience fell short of expectations, especially in a city like Addis Ababa, known for its vibrant and flavorful food scene. My visit to Amrogne Chicken was, regrettably, one of the more disappointing dining experiences I've had in the city.

user_reviews.Name: Michael Banjaw
user_reviews.Description: There food is so delicious well cooked chicken and perfectly seasoned rice. The portion size is great and great customer service. Honestly the best shawerma in Addis

user_reviews.Name: Hilena Tafesse
user_reviews.Description:
The place is very beautiful, with a spacious and graceful setup. I really enjoyed the natural coffee espresso, it was amazing. The speciality coffee were great as well.
However, I was disappointed with the cake. I had one of the worst tiramisus I’ve tried in Addis . It was very dry and not tasty. Since it’s a newly opened place I expected better quality. Same goes with the chocolate cake. Their cheese cakes were great tho.

Overall, the atmosphere and coffee were great, but the dessert needs serious improvement.

user_reviews.Name: Senit Abreha
user_reviews.Description:
We visited this place twice, once for a meal and a second time for dessert. What I will say is that the service isn't very good. We had a waiter come up to us and ask if he can take the menu so that he can serve somebody else and we have to ask him to take our order also and he was very irritated by that request. Given that the place is new, I'm shocked that this is the attitude they have with customers.

Regarding the food,
We had the cheesesteak sandwich and the chicken pesto wrap. The wrap was very good but the cheesteak sandwich was bland and the bread wasn't good.
Regarding the drinks and dessert,

We quite enjoyed the chocolate cake and biscodf cheesecake but the drinks leave a lot to be desired. The iced matcha latte was very bland, and so was the lemonade. The iced ube latte wasn't out favourite but that's an acquired taste and don't hold it against them.

Overall, please improve your service and try to maintain quality of the food.

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Samson
user_reviews.Description:
Adorsi Coffee is pure comfort in a cup.
Their brews have that rich, authentic Ethiopian flavor that instantly lifts your mood. And the Ube Latte — wow! It’s creamy, smooth, and beautifully unique. You can taste the passion and care in every sip. Truly one of my favorite coffee spots! 💜☕

user_reviews.Name: Naftoli Gezahegn
user_reviews.Description: love this place, and i got their oreo cheese cake and ube latte(hot) and it was an amazing experience also the service was amazing the waitresses are welcoming. parking can be tricky to find, so if it's your first time coming, make sure to plan ahead for parking. overall, it was a 10/10 experience.

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Firdawok
user_reviews.Description:
It’s a beautiful, aesthetically pleasing place. I enjoyed the atmosphere. It was bright and very modern looking. The service was amazing, all of them have a smile on their face and are happy to serve you.

The only thing that I am not satisfied with is the food. I wasn’t consistent, the first time I went the latte was amazing and the cake was great too so I wanted to take my friends so I came in a different day and it was disappointing. The latte was very bitter and it didn’t taste good and the cake tasted like it has stayed in the out for too long. Then I wanted my family to try it out so I took my sister and my dad with me a different day hoping last time was just a one day thing but sadly again the latte was not good was very bitter as we tried the ube and I’m not sure what it’s supposed to taste like but it just tasted like water so I made a fool out of myself by taking people there twice so I’d wish they fix this cause I’m sure it’s a fixable problem and I’d love to go again because the place is very pretty it just gives me hope that next time it will be better and I’m sure going to go there again with hope that it will taste like the first time.

user_reviews.Name: Silas Getachew
user_reviews.Description: I loved the atmosphere. I tried the ube latte, which was good, and the pesto chicken wrap was fine. However, the customer service could be improved.

user_reviews.Name: Yonas

user_reviews.Name: Hanan Ibrahim
user_reviews.Description: I tried their Biscoff cheesecake and chocolate cake. The cheesecake was terrible, but the chocolate cake was nice. I also tried the caramel iced latte, which wasn’t good,it only tasted like sugar. The atmosphere, however, was great.

user_reviews.Name: Juanita Yeheyes
user_reviews.Description: Excellent service, excellent food, the atmosphere was absolutely gorgeous and so comfortable and relaxing. It felt like home. Would definitely recommend anyone who wants a beautiful setting with amazing traditional food and delicious filtered tej to try this place out. They have been in Piassa for many many years.

user_reviews.Name: Pooja Patel
user_reviews.Description:
Stopped here for lunch as part of our tour and enjoyed authentic Ethiopian food!
They made a special vegan dish for us with varying spice levels - fresh and flavorful. The Tej (honey wine) was also the right balance of sweet and refreshing.

user_reviews.Name: Jaila P.
user_reviews.Description: Loved the ambiance. Great vegan food. I don't drink coffee, but I had some and enjoyed their traditional ceremony.

user_reviews.Name: Henok Garedew (Henny breezy)
user_reviews.Description:
This place is the best cultural restaurant in Addis owned and operated by the Addis Ababa city administration. The food is fresh clean and original Ethiopian traditional taste, price is very affordable comparing with other similar restaurants. very professional staff and the place is very clean and  inviting. It's perfect for families, events and groups.
I  haighly recommend for every one.

user_reviews.Name: Henok Alemu
user_reviews.Description: I had a fabulous lunch with client a vegan dish in a legendary Addis Ababa restaurant it was really fabulous we enjoyed it. And also the honey wine was also quite tasty.

user_reviews.Name: Jumana K
user_reviews.Description: Stopped for lunch at this historic and authentic Ethiopian Restaurant as part of a city tour. Really enjoyed the food and architecture of the place.

user_reviews.Name: Lindsay Harkness

user_reviews.Name: Cibi Boovendran
user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: tre son
user_reviews.Description: Ordered 4 slices of cake + 2 in-house chocolate bars (dark & white). Cheesecake was just okay. The pistachio velvet cake and trio chocolate cake were the standouts, really good. The opera caramel cake was meh. Pricey overall, but a couple of the cakes felt worth it

user_reviews.Name: Dori Travels
user_reviews.Description: Great array of cakes and pastries, crafted to satisfy every sweet craving. The service is fantastic, making the experience even better! The only hiccup was finding parking, but that doesn’t take away from the joy of indulging in such sweet delights!

user_reviews.Name: Sheba Saba
user_reviews.Description: My favorite cafe in Addis!  Staff is highly professional and food and pastries are wonderful!  My second home, as I'm there multiple times a week.  Great barista, great waiters/waitresses and awesome parking staff.  They are like family to me 💞

user_reviews.Name: tewodros wondwossen
user_reviews.Description: Nice spot and suitable for people with a sweet tooth. We only tried the macchiato due to a rather heavy lunch  which was okay but the prices of the cookies seemed relatively much more expensive from my perspective (Birr.600 per 1/2kg). Check out the macchiato bill in the pics to judge for yourselves. But overall, a nice place with a wide variety and definitely a cool Logo+Name.

user_reviews.Name: i-see
user_reviews.Description:
If you find yourself in the heart of Addis Ababa, a visit to Koba Pastry at 4 Killo is an absolute must for anyone with a sweet tooth. This charming pastry shop has carved out a niche for itself in the city's culinary landscape, especially with its exceptional selection of cakes and pastries.
From the moment I stepped into Koba Pastry, the experience was delightful. The array of cakes on display is nothing short of amazing – each one a masterpiece of baking excellence. Whether you prefer classic flavors or innovative creations, Koba Pastry has something to enchant your palate. During my visit, each bite of the cake I had was a journey through layers of exquisite flavors and textures, perfectly balanced to create a memorable experience.
The ambiance of Koba Pastry adds to its charm. The atmosphere strikes a perfect balance between cozy and elegant, creating a welcoming environment where you can truly savor your sweet indulgence. The decor is thoughtfully designed, contributing to an overall sense of warmth and comfort.
Complementing the delightful cakes is the commendable service. The staff at Koba Pastry are as sweet as the treats they serve. They are attentive, friendly, and genuinely seem to take pride in ensuring that every guest has a pleasant experience. Their service is prompt without feeling rushed, allowing you to relax and enjoy your time there.
In conclusion, Koba Pastry is a gem in Addis Ababa's culinary crown. It's not just a pastry shop; it's a haven for cake enthusiasts and anyone looking to indulge in beautifully crafted sweet treats. With its fantastic atmosphere,

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: The University branch of Koba provides a slightly more upmarket environment in 4 kilo. It serves a mix of cakes and light food all day.  Cakes are a bit too sugary for my taste and come in chunky portions - so not for the health conscious - but otherwise nothing to fault it.

user_reviews.Name: Mikiyas Melkamu
user_reviews.Description: I recently visited KOBA Patisserie & Bakery and tried one of their pastries. Unfortunately, it was too sweet for my taste and did not meet my expectations. I would not recommend this place to anyone who has a low sweetness tolerance.

user_reviews.Name: Cinema Semere entertainment
user_reviews.Description: Cosy pastry place in the heart of Addis. I like their Opera Pastry. A must see place in Addis if you want to have a tasty cake, your choice should be Koba Patisseries and Bakery.

user_reviews.Description: Caldo burger is always my favourite burger place. It has always same taste. The portion of the burger was big enough. Me and my little sis was extremely full after eating 1 caldo special Burger together with coke each.

user_reviews.Name: Yosef getachew
user_reviews.Description: This might be the best burger I've ever had. Tastes good with good price. The vibe is also nice. I definitely recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: nahom ayele
user_reviews.Description: the food alone is good but the atmosphere is kind of bad because there a shortage of a parking place and it is hard to find a place for your car the other ting is the place most of the time is kind of full so it may be hard to get a seat but the food and service is good

user_reviews.Name: The City’s Spots
user_reviews.Description: Yall this is hand down the worst smoothie ever....it doesn't look healthy too......it got a weird taste ...but i think the burger is fine/no that bad

user_reviews.Name: Daniel Solomon
user_reviews.Description: The burger is hands down one of the most delicious I have ever had. Size is perfect and the price is also fair.

title: La Mandoline French Restaurant
address: 2QHM+RRR La Mandoline French Restaurant, 17 Côte D'Ivoire St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bruno MARTY
user_reviews.Description:
When I come to Addis, I come to La Mandoline restaurant. In 15 years, they change 3 times of location. Always, not disappointed, delicious. you must come and test that french food. Today we take onion soup (very good), fondue bourguignonne (perfect: good meat with 6 sauces, and absolutely perfectly cooked french fries) and finally a sublime lemon tart. And to accompagny that meal a very good local Gebeta dry red wine. Thank you, an excellent diner.
It's a pity that the new location is not so easy to find: That restaurant needs more customers

user_reviews.Name: Shir Portugez
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing food, best restaurant we found in Addis Ababa . Great atmosphere! Beautiful and cosy design.
Every dish was excellent and the service was great (not the best English, but tried to do their best).

user_reviews.Description:
Tomoca Coffee – Piassa Branch (by Eliana Hotel, on the way to St. George Cathedral)
One of my favorite coffee spots in Addis. The vibe is classic and always full of energy. The smell of freshly roasted beans pulls you in the moment you walk by.
Their macchiato is my go-to rich, smooth, and just the right kick. Quick service, no extra fuss, but the taste always delivers. If you're around Piassa, this place is a must-stop.

user_reviews.Name: Bent_uaq
user_reviews.Description:
Bold espresso and rich heritage at Tomoca Coffee ☕🌍
Stopped by Tomoca Coffee, and tried their espresso—intense, aromatic, and beautifully roasted 🇪🇹🔥. It’s exactly what you’d expect from one of Ethiopia’s most iconic coffee houses: bold flavor, smooth finish, and a deep, satisfying kick. If you enjoy your espresso strong and unapologetic, this one delivers 👌🏻☕.

Tomoca is known for blending Ethiopian beans with Italian-style roasting, creating a signature profile that’s both authentic and refined. The ambiance is classic and welcoming, with a timeless charm that reflects the brand’s legacy in Addis Ababa 🏛️🫶.

Staff are friendly and efficient, and the service feels personal even during busy hours. Whether you’re grabbing a quick shot or lingering over a macchiato, the experience is consistently high-quality.

Highly recommend Tomoca Coffee for anyone seeking a true taste of Ethiopian espresso culture 🌟🫘.

user_reviews.Name: Lindsay Harkness

user_reviews.Description:
ኮባ Cake & Comfort at Koba Pastry 🍰☕

I recently visited Koba Pastry, and if you're craving quality cake, this is definitely the place to go. I tried their cheesecake with a cup of hot tea, and the combo was spot-on. The cheesecake was creamy and smooth, with a rich texture that just melts in your mouth. The tea added a warm, relaxing touch—perfect for a short, sweet break.

The pastry display is a visual delight. From the vibrant Pistachio Velvet to the sleek Chocolate Fudge, everything looks as good as it tastes. Their éclairs—whether coated in coffee glaze, cream, or rich chocolate—are beautifully crafted and flavourful.

Customer handling is also commendable—friendly and professional. You feel attended to without being rushed.

However, it’s not the kind of place you'd bring children to, and seating can be limited, especially if you come in a group. Sometimes, you might not even get a seat at all. It really depends on the day and how crowded it is.

That said, go for the cake and coffee—that’s where Koba truly shines. It’s not a lounge or hangout spot, but for a quick indulgence or takeaway, it’s well worth it.

So if you're passing by or planning to treat yourself, make it Koba—and make it cake.

Comment: What if you serve the cake with ኮባ itself. Make it unique, make it special.

(Thank you Mekides for the service)

As a local guider of at level 8.5/10 (Globally), in case Koba needs a great photos and few video, they can communicate me. My reviews has more than 100,000 views per day with a total of 12,000,000 content views having over 2k followers, mainly foreigners.

@Fitihb

user_reviews.Name: Omo Culture Ethiopian Tours
user_reviews.Description:
What is Galani Coffee?

Galani Coffee is a café and specialty-coffee space located in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. It was established in 2016 with the goal of promoting Ethiopian coffee in a modern “third wave” coffee shop context.
It’s more than just a café: they roast their own coffee, they hold trainings, tastings, and present coffee as a craft.

Name & Identity

The name “Galani” comes from the Gelan River which runs down the Bale Mountains and through many coffee-growing regions in South Ethiopia. This was chosen to evoke origin, journey and coffee heritage.

The branding reflects local transport of beans (for example donkeys carrying coffee) and connects to the idea of origin, traceability and authentic Ethiopian coffee culture.

Location & Ambience

Address: Jacros – Salite Mehret Rd, Behind the Jackross Villas Compound, Addis Ababa.

The space is described as “industrial chic” and quite spacious for Addis Ababa café standards.

Upstairs there is a cultural/art space and boutique items (crafts, locally-made goods) alongside the coffee bar.

Opening hours (as of recent info): Tuesday to Sunday ~8 AM–7/8 PM; closed Monday.

Quiet elegance and local charm at Ambassador Mall 🏙️🛍️
Visited Ambassador Mall in Addis Ababa and was pleasantly surprised by its calm atmosphere and clean layout across four floors 🧼🪞. It’s a great spot for relaxed browsing, far from the usual hustle of larger malls.

One highlight was discovering a perfume shop offering local brand fragrances 🧴🌸—a refreshing change from the usual international names. The scents were unique, culturally resonant, and perfect for those seeking something authentically Ethiopian.

The mall itself is well-organized, with a mix of fashion, beauty, and lifestyle stores. While it’s not packed with global brands, it offers a more grounded, community-focused shopping experience. Ideal for quiet afternoons or purposeful visits.

Recommended for anyone looking to explore local products in a peaceful mall setting 🌟🛍️. Will return to check out more hidden gems and specialty shops.

I was especially happy to see they stock Duplo sets, which are perfect for little ones to build smaller LEGO creations. One of my favorite finds was the red flower bouquet LEGO set—I’d been looking for it everywhere!

Whether you’re shopping for kids or adults, this store is full of great gift ideas. It’s well-organized, fun to explore, and perfect for LEGO lovers of all ages!

user_reviews.Description:
As we are in Gena fasting period, many of Ethiopian have decided to fast. We prefer not to consume some particular foods including the traditional pizza, which contains ham and different varieties of meat and cheese.

Here is a fasting version of the traditional pizza which found in Karavan coffee.
This cafe serves different delicious foods and drinks with good hospitality and service.
Ingredients

450gr flour

1 yeast sachet

Tomato sauce

Greek virgin olive oil

1tsp sea salt
.boild Brooklyn

And if any on is welling to make it home here are some instructions for you.

Instructions

Start by heating some water. Put the yeast into water, until it is dissolved

Add some flour and mix for a while. Let it rest for almost 10 minutes

In a large bowl, add some flour and some sea salt. Afterwards pour them into the yeast mixture. Mix until, all ingredients are combined

Cover with a towel and let the dough rise

Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough in very thin sheets

Spread some Greek virgin olive oil in a baking tray

Cover the sheets of the dough with tomato sauce and add the ingredients you prefer

Bake the pizza at 200C for almost 20 minutes

Enjoy

Finding a restaurant where culinary excellence meets the precision of a doctor and the hospitality of a hotel management expert is incredibly rare.  Guansa Ma'ed - ጓንሳ ማዕድ stands out as a beacon of quality in Addis Ababa’s dining scene. Whether you're a local or a visitor, this is a dining experience you do not want to miss!

user_reviews.Name: Omo Culture Ethiopian Tours
user_reviews.Description:
📍 Overview & History

Tomoca Coffee was founded in Addis Ababa in 1953, making it one of the oldest commercial coffee roasting enterprises in Ethiopia.

The name “TOMOCA” comes from Italian Torrefazione Moderna Caffé (meaning “modern coffee roasting”).

It started as a coffee roaster and café, and has since expanded to many branches around Addis and beyond.

The brand has become something of a local institution: a place not only for coffee but for experiencing Addis’s coffee culture.

Location & Hours

One of the main branches is located on Wawel Street (Wavel St), Piassa, Addis Ababa.

Typical opening hours: daily from around 06:30 AM to 8:30 PM.

What to Expect

The café has a vintage, “old-school” vibe — you’ll often find the smell of freshly roasted beans as soon as you walk in.

It serves a variety of coffee drinks: espresso-style, macchiatos, etc., as well as bags of roasted beans for purchase.

Many visitors note the strong flavour — e.g., a reviewer said “The coffee was very strong so I recommend going early in the day to start your day right.”

The location is good for a quick stop — many tables are standing tables; the concept is less about lingering for hours, more about a quality cup of Ethiopian coffee.

user_reviews.Name: Juliana Siapai
user_reviews.Description: I went in for a late lunch and was not disappointed. Great experience - warm atmosphere and most importantly, delicious food!

If you're new, try the Katagna Special, which is a selection of dishes and easily feeds 4.

💳 Takes credit card

user_reviews.Name: Nathnael Tekabe
user_reviews.Description:
Kategna is an absolute gem of a restaurant and an experience you won't want to miss. We started with the meat firfir, and every bite was an incredible blend of savory spices and tender injera. The siga wot was equally impressive—the meat was so flavorful and cooked to perfection, with a rich, authentic sauce that truly stood out.
​Beyond the fantastic food, the entire atmosphere of the place is magical. The interior is stunning, filled with beautiful, intricate Ethiopian artifacts and decor that create a warm, inviting, and truly immersive dining environment. It’s clear that so much thought went into every detail.
​What really sealed the deal for us was the service. The staff was incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout our entire meal, making sure we had everything we needed without ever feeling rushed. It was genuinely a top-class experience from start to finish. I can't recommend Kategna enough; it's the perfect spot for delicious, authentic Ethiopian food and a wonderful evening out.

user_reviews.Name: jade P
user_reviews.Description: A specifically came to this restaurant for their doro wat, but what I seem to have been served is a small tiny drumstick of chewy meat in a big bowl of sauce with one egg. I paid a premium price for this. Everything else was fine at the restaurant. But my main dish was minuscule and chewy. I'm definitely not returning to this restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Mehalet Shibre
user_reviews.Description: Very beautiful breakfast experience we ordered 3 items + buna and we paid a little over 3,000birr. The portion size is pretty average but the taste was very nice. user_reviews.Name: Yafet Mola
user_reviews.Description:
Kategna Restaurant Recommendation!

The drinks are well-chosen, and the traditional Ethiopian coffee is a real highlight. All this in a cozy, warm atmosphere.

A restaurant that I highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Mulugeta
user_reviews.Description: This fine dining started with a fancy electric shuttle Carriage ride, which brings guests up from the deep deep parking lot in the subbasement to the ground floor elevators.  Inside the restaurant you have huge tables with generous space between tables which gives the place classy vibes. The wait staff have excellent deportment and they seem well trained. In fact since we went in the middle of the afternoon and the place wasn't so crowded, they were having a training session in the back. As for the Sushi and Sashimi boats we ordered, it's nothing to rave about. The sushi rice especially 👎. Unevenly cooked and caked into a block. Miso soup with salmon in it also👎 Dessert was better. Some cake made with dates topped with ice cream - delicious.

user_reviews.Name: Ale Bolale
user_reviews.Description:
As a foodie who enjoys fine dining experiences, I had the pleasure of trying HOTTO, a modern Japanese-inspired Asian fusion restaurant in Addis Ababa. Overall, it was a pleasant experience and a good value for the price, especially considering the unique concept and stylish atmosphere. The location and ambiance were excellent elegant, modern, and inviting.

That said, there were a few areas that could be improved:

1.	Seating for Couples
I visited with my wife and was surprised to find there were no tables specifically arranged for couples. We had to sit at a table meant for four, which slightly diminished the intimate dining experience we were hoping for.

2.	Inconsistent Service
During our visit, four different waitresses attended to our table. This led to some confusion orders were forgotten, and we had to repeat requests as staff rotated. A more consistent service approach would greatly enhance the dining experience.

3.	Order Mistake with the Main Course
I ordered a medium-rare fillet of beef but was initially served a medium. I thought it was a kitchen error, but upon checking the bill, I realized the order was entered incorrectly. To their credit, they corrected it promptly and brought the steak as requested, which I appreciated.

4.	Lipstick on a Tea Glass😾
When we ordered tea, we noticed lipstick on one of the glasses. This was quite disappointing and not acceptable for an establishment of this caliber. Cleanliness and attention to detail in presentation are essential.

5.	Delays Between Courses
There was a significant delay between courses, especially when it came time to order dessert. We had to wait around 30 minutes and call the staff between meals to proceed with the next course.

Final Thoughts:
Despite these issues, HOTTO still stands out as a promising addition to Addis’s dining scene. The fusion menu is creative, and the atmosphere is ideal for special occasions. I especially appreciate the effort the team made to accommodate my special request for my wife it meant a lot😊

Thank you for the experience, and I look forward to seeing how HOTTO continues to grow and improve.

title: Trattoria Gusto

user_reviews.Name: Mehari Tesfamichael
user_reviews.Description:
A Total Letdown at Trattoria Gusto
Went to Trattoria Gusto and honestly, it was a mess from start to finish. The waiter couldn’t keep track of orders and kept confusing our table with another one.
The food? Terrible. The lamb roast was the worst I’ve ever tasted, and the steak was just… sheat — no other word for it. Dry, flavorless, and badly cooked. The only thing I actually enjoyed was the starter (chicken soup and Caprese), which was decent.
And here’s the funny part: the best thing about the place? The draft beer — because they don’t make it! 😁
If you value your time, money, and taste buds — avoid this place.
If flavour had a funeral, it would be catered by Trattoria Gusto.
To be fair, they didn’t charge us for the food we couldn’t eat — merciful, really 🤔

user_reviews.Name: Woldeamlak “Wolde” Woldegiorgis
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at this hidden gem of a restaurant that offers a limited selection of buffets with incredible food and an amazing vibe. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by the cozy and inviting atmosphere that gave me comfort.

The buffet selection may be small, but let me tell you, the dishes they have were very tasty. The food feels fresh and flavorful. Each bite was a delight for the taste buds, and I couldn't get enough of the delectable dishes on offer.

What truly sets this restaurant apart is its incredible vibe. The ambiance is warm and welcoming, with stylish decor and comfortable seating that creates the perfect setting for a relaxing meal. The staff were friendly and attentive, adding to the overall fantastic experience.

Despite the limited buffet options, the quality of the food more than makes up for it. Every dish was thoughtfully crafted and bursting with delicious flavors.

If you're looking for a restaurant with great food, a cozy atmosphere, and a unique dining experience, look no further. This restaurant has it all.

user_reviews.Name: Mikiyas Melkamu
user_reviews.Description: I recently had the pleasure of enjoying lunch at Trattoria Gusto, and I must say, it was a delightful experience. The moment I stepped in, I was greeted with a warm ambiance that set the tone for a great meal. I opted for the Steak with mushroom sauce, and it did not disappoint. The steak was cooked to perfection, tender and flavorful. The mushroom sauce added a rich and savory element that complemented the steak beautifully. Additionally, I also indulged in their lasagna, which was equally delightful. The layers of pasta, cheese, and sauce came together in a harmonious medley of flavors that left me craving for more. Not only was the food impressive, but the service was also top-notch. The attentive staff made sure that every need was met, contributing to an overall enjoyable dining experience. The fact that the price was reasonable for the quality of food and service provided was definitely a plus. I was pleased to find out that the restaurant is kids-friendly, making it a great option for families. The availability of parking also added to the convenience of the visit. In conclusion, I wholeheartedly recommend Trattoria Gusto to anyone seeking a delectable dining experience. The combination of delicious food, excellent service, reasonable pricing, and family-friendly environment makes it a must-visit. So, if you're looking for a place to enjoy a mouthwatering steak and pasta, Trattoria Gusto should be at the top of your list.

An amazing experience!
The food was exceptionally good with an outstanding variety of dishes – every bite was top-notch. The waitstaff were friendly and attentive, the place was clean, and the restrooms were well maintained. Small details like bringing a bowl for handwashing to the table really showed care for the guests.

The atmosphere was elevated by beautiful live music and phenomenal dancing – the performers made a real effort to involve the audience, which made it even more engaging. There's also a souvenir shop on-site, which is a lovely touch to end the evening. While it’s a bit on the pricier side, the whole experience is absolutely worth it. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Ethio Mobile
user_reviews.Description:
Review for Louver Hotel – Disappointing Roasted Chicken

We visited Louver Hotel on March 30, 2025, and ordered roasted chicken and spaghetti. Unfortunately, the roasted chicken was a complete disappointment.

First, it wasn’t even roasted—it was just cooked chicken. On top of that, it was nearly impossible to find the actual chicken because it was buried under a pile of vegetables. The portion was extremely small, and what was served looked nothing like what was described on the menu. The chicken was cut into tiny pieces, making it even less enjoyable.

When we asked the chef about this, he told us that the “main chef” had changed the dish. We even pointed out that no such version of roasted chicken exists, and his response was dismissive. If that’s the case, they should rename the dish on the menu instead of misleading customers.

My advice: Do not order the roasted chicken at Louver Hotel. It’s not what you expect, and the experience was frustrating.

user_reviews.Name: Bella Al
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Bait Al Mandi……. Simply the Best!

We’re visitors from Australia and the United Kingdom, and during our stay in Ethiopia, Bait Al Mandi has become our absolute favorite spot. We’ve been coming here throughout our entire visit, and every single time, the experience has been nothing short of amazing.

The service quality and efficiency are beyond words, genuinely unmatched. The staff are always kind, attentive, and deserving of every tip. The owner himself is one of a kind: warm, welcoming, and always willing to go above and beyond to help in any way possible. You can truly feel the baraqah in this place.

The food, the hospitality, the atmosphere everything comes together perfectly. It’s rare to find a place that makes you feel so cared for and satisfied every single time. Without a doubt, this is a five star experience, and we can’t wait to come back again.

Bait Al Mandi isn’t just a restaurant; it’s a beautiful experience. The best of the best!

user_reviews.Name: Tigs Chadder
user_reviews.Description:
Extremely disappointing:

Why do some restaurants in Ethiopia feel
A “delivery and takeaway” services deserves to be treated with the worst cut of meat? The portions, selection of the meat cut “there is a big difference between lamb and mutton”

For the past few months,  we were told about the food at this restaurant and we decided to order for delivers.

Meant to have 1/4 chicken, 2 x Lamb vegetable, rice etc . The only thing that was correct from the order was the amount of rice sent to us.

The “lamb bone” was actually old mutton then the 1/4 checkin had the worst (no chicken meat) side of the Chicken which was not edible at all! A quarter of a chicken means “you divide the chicken into four equal parts” not sell of the side of the chicken that should be thrown out or used for “stoke” purposes only …

This was a meal for two costing (in the local market terms) a substantial amount.

Not ordering from here again and we suggest those who do, ask for a proper ration of the portions not be given the cast offs!

user_reviews.Description: Had a short layover in Addis Ababa and stopped here for a break. It’s not fully Western-style, but definitely the closest you’ll get at this airport. Great beer, fast and friendly service.

user_reviews.Name: maisie kwan
user_reviews.Description:
I had a generally good experience at Cravings, especially if you're looking for a comfortable spot to relax during a flight transfer. The seating area is spacious with plenty of comfy chairs and useful plugs, which made it a great place to settle in and get some work done instead of the lounge.

However, I did encounter an unpleasant situation with one of the staff members. The restaurant was mostly empty at 8 PM, yet I was asked to move from a four-seater sofa to a two-seater to make room for other passengers. This seemed unnecessary, especially when there were barely any other guests around, as shown in the photos. By 8:55 PM, there were only 7 occupied tables, and they even moved another person from a two-seater to the bar, which felt a bit odd.

As for the food, the Ethiopian dishes were delicious, and I recommend them if you're in the mood to try local flavors. However, the pasta portion was quite small for the price.

Overall, Cravings has a great atmosphere for travelers, but I hope the staff can consider a more flexible approach to seating when the restaurant isn't crowded.

$28US for a pasta

I visited the restaurant eager to enjoy their famous ribs or the impressive Tomahawk steak, but unfortunately, they had run out of both by lunchtime.
