user_reviews.Description: A very beautiful, cozy place to be. Service is amazing. The food is amazing. Lots of healthier options.

user_reviews.Name: Hannah.M
user_reviews.Description: It was quite pleasant. We had the chicken carbonara and farmer steak, and it was enjoyable. The staff were friendly and helpful. Overall, I would recommend Moyos to anyone looking for nice dining.

user_reviews.Name: Abiy Alazar
user_reviews.Description: Great food and excellent service. This place also offers Keto diet meal program. They also have open kitchen to see how clean they are. Parking is a challenge.

user_reviews.Name: David Waruinge
user_reviews.Description: The food at Moyos was honestly surprisingly good. The restaurant is very simplistic and doesn't quite prepare you for the amazing cuisine they serve. The place is very clean and the staff are very friendly. They have great steak and a whole lot of healthy shakes and smoothies. I highly recommend them

user_reviews.Name: A A
user_reviews.Description: Had the teff crepes, mixed veggies and fresh juice. I love that they have teff breakfast options. Service was bad first time good second time.  Overall good spot.

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Jc
user_reviews.Description: The place was very nice.we orderd double chess burger and farmers stake, grille chicken.the food was great.

title: Temsalet Kitchen | sarbet |Iconic kitchen
address: XPVQ+JX2 Temsalet Kitchen | sarbet |Iconic kitchen, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Ali Weber
user_reviews.Description:
It my go-to spot to order Ethiopian food and I don't even like Injera, lol :)

Honestly, you can’t go wrong with anything on their menu (tried most of it), but if I had to recommend one thing, it would be the "Quanta Firfir", It's my personal favorite. You also have to try their traditional coffee, it is simply perfect.

user_reviews.Name: Selamawit Zewdu
user_reviews.Description: I literally have no words who in there right mind would do this it has glasses inside of it which tells me they don’t care

user_reviews.Name: Hilena Tafesse
user_reviews.Description:
I love this place from the day it was launched.
Every food taste good. They serve well with good manners. They are so friendly and having happy faces.
Good food. Space looks amazing 🙌🏽

user_reviews.Name: X Z
user_reviews.Description: I’m an American who ate at this establishment during my time in Addis Ababa. I visited for the first time in February 2025 with a guide. I still fondly remember the food, service and that coffee. I kept going back over and over as the service and food were both top notch. The restaurant provides an authentic Ethiopian experience and even though not a lot of foreigners visit, I became a regular- can’t wait to come back . The prices cannot be beat.

user_reviews.Name: E S
user_reviews.Description: Personally I think it is literally the best ethiopian food ever 😭 I swearrrrr! I had a normal firfir(I was salivating) Tibs, shiro with gomen! I don't know how it's possible that every food tastes so good except for the tibs, sauce was amazing but the meat was a bit off but it's okay! I wish I could've given them all the stars in the world 🙈

user_reviews.Name: Elsina Daniel
user_reviews.Description: Best traditional food can be found here. I have had a great experience and came often.Well recommended.

user_reviews.Name: Josh S
user_reviews.Description: We are long term Addis residents, and this is probably our favorite place for traditional Ethiopian food. It's delicious and affordable: we recommend the Temsalet Combo for 3-4 people, only 570etb! The recent renovations make the environment great with the big wood slab tables and carved chairs. The servers are a pleasure to interact with. IF YOU HAVEN'T BEEN THERE, GO NOW!

user_reviews.Name: Samrawit G. Wari
user_reviews.Description: I enjoyed the authentic cultural atmosphere of this place. The service was excellent, and I was pleasantly surprised by the pricing. I had a delicious breakfast and coffee..

title: Akkoo Coffee | Addis Ababa University 6 Kilo
address: 2QW5+V28 Akkoo Coffee | Addis Ababa University 6 Kilo, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Akkoo Coffee | Addis Ababa University 6 Kilo (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: T H
user_reviews.Description: Overpriced and not well stocked...claim to serve all kinds of dishes no fish for product for instance ..The price makes you wonder who their target customers are given how much Ethiopian lecturers get paid....

user_reviews.Name: S “サリー” J
user_reviews.Description: 大学構内にあるカフェで伝統的なスタイルで淹れてくれます

title: Join burger
address: Algeria St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Ruth
user_reviews.Description:
I don’t usually write reviews, but this place deserves it.

I ordered what was supposed to be a simple burger, and somehow it turned into one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had. The patty tasted old, the bun was soggy, and the whole thing had a weird smell that I should have taken as a warning sign. A few hours later, I was violently sick — easily the worst food poisoning I’ve ever had.

I spent the entire night regretting every bite.
Save yourself.
Save your stomach.
Save your dignity.

I would not recommend this place to my worst enemy.

user_reviews.Name: HIRUT DIRIBA
user_reviews.Description: Last time i got a very good burger on "join burger" via bue delivery . It was so Delicious .

user_reviews.Name: Bemnet Yohans (Ngus)
user_reviews.Description:
Join burger is one of the best burger place in sidist kilo, Addis Ababa. They serve in a good quality and can order Takeaway.
This is the place to Dine at Lunch, Breakfast and Dinner time. It has a Casual atmosphere. Clean Toilet on the back side of the burger house.
They have enough space for the ceremony like birthday, anniversary.
There is a parking lot and wheelchair accessible.

user_reviews.Name: Corinna Chan
user_reviews.Description: Has a lunch buffet serving injera with a wide variety of toppings which was all vegetarian friendly. Place was busy with locals eating the same buffet which is a great sign of authenticity. Be prepared to eat in the same way as locals do (i.e. eating with your hands and sharing a table with other strangers if the place is busy).

user_reviews.Name: Amanuel Seife
user_reviews.Description: One of the best fast food places in the area. Quality services at a really affordable price. Also serve a few local dishes.

user_reviews.Name: Kidus Abebe
user_reviews.Description: Fast.....good hospitality. Not the best in town but definitely my go to. Plus it's very affordable compared to what others charge with bad food. I reckon you should go.

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Hailu
user_reviews.Description: Best Burger house!

user_reviews.Name: NEIMA MOHAMMED
user_reviews.Description: There was too much oil on the plate

title: Kategna Restaurant Unity Park
address: Arada 15/16, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Dori Travels
user_reviews.Description: The restaurant is located in Unity Park, behind King Minelik II Palace. Very good Ethiopian food, highly recommended. There is a large selection of many dishes. The service is super friendly and quick. The ambiance is great.

user_reviews.Name: M Tes
user_reviews.Description: I was truly surprised by the authenticity of the food and the reasonable price.  The service was great, the place was beautiful and the view incredible.

user_reviews.Name: ZELALEM ZENEBE
user_reviews.Description:
Doro Firfir/ Tins Firfir all the way!!!
Just next to his Majesty Enkulal BeAt!

user_reviews.Name: M D
user_reviews.Description: Wonderful staff and amazing food, ate so quickly forgot to take photos lol 😆

title: Gambela Hotel | 6 Kilo | ጋምቤላ ሆቴል | 6 ኪሎ
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Gambela Hotel | 6 Kilo | ጋምቤላ ሆቴል | 6 ኪሎ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Nafkot Mamuye
user_reviews.Description:
I am only rating the the fish menu and I must say that there are far better places to eat fish in town than here the taste and quantity are very mediocre to say the least. I may be back for the view but certainly not for the fish.
Note to self: don't believe adds you see on social media

user_reviews.Name: Biruk Getachew
user_reviews.Description:
We had an event there at the first floor hall. The waiters were not fast and active. They even tried to rip us of our money and cheat. Sad indeed.
The room service in the suit was fine but the room was not clean. The morning breakfast was cold and not a good menu. Try their breakfast at their restaurant rather than ordering from your room for better food quantity. Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this spot for a friend.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: Only went here for lunch so cannot comment on the rooms but the hotel is located on the road between Ras Mekonnen Bridge and Afincco Ber, and overseas the riverside development that is underway. It would a fantastic location when all the construction is finished. We were greeted by staff wearing nice uniforms and the hotel looks newly refurbished. I must say however that the interior design is a bit dated for a hotel that looks new. The lunch was a buffet of Ethiopian food, with fasting and non fasting options. Taste wise the food is just average, and not something I would go back for. The jebena coffee was good.

user_reviews.Name: Fraol
user_reviews.Description: About the price, it becomes expensive in a short duration. This is not fair for the customer since there is a better place in town with half of their new price, and their food is overpriced with low quality food.

user_reviews.Name: ዳግማዊ ሰለሞን
user_reviews.Description:
The hotel is new and clean. It is also a nice and quite place. But, it has only one mobile number contact address and it was switched off. We want there without having full info about the hotel, the services and the prices.
The staffs need a professional guest service training.

user_reviews.Name: Nahum P
user_reviews.Description: Poor customer service. price of food and room is too expensive. I hope it will be fixed.

user_reviews.Name: keya amen
user_reviews.Description: I never see  junck food  really bad even service is zero never come back agan good bye

user_reviews.Name: Nova tube
user_reviews.Description: Its clean and a place where you find transportation easily and also they are very good at serving customers.

title: Allebnany Restaurant
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Hussain Almoamen
user_reviews.Description:
I thought I will enjoy my food there but unfortunately didn’t.
I came for shawarma but she said we don’t have it now and instead she offered me Shish Tawooq sandwich. I accepted coz I was already there.
The sandwich looked fine but didn’t taste good, it has more fries inside than chicken and has nothing from vegetables like at least onions. Costed 700br.
I think they have better dishes but I don’t think I will come back.

The restaurant is at the back side and the one you see in the street is the coffee shop

user_reviews.Name: Letera Asfaw
user_reviews.Description: They have good foods and cakes, specially I enjoy their cake and baklava. However, the service is poor. The waitress are not welcoming. Sometime the place is crowded and noisy with people and hard to find table.

user_reviews.Name: bini abe
user_reviews.Description:
Allebnany Restaurant offers a remarkable  dining experience. The food is exceptional; every dish we tried was bursting with flavor. A standout for me was their dessert—simply amazing! It was the perfect sweet ending to our meal, and I still find myself craving it days later.

The service team at Alebnany deserves high praise as well.

One suggestion I have is to consider expanding the vegetarian options during fasting times. If they could incorporate more vegetarian dishes into their menu, I would definitely find myself visiting more frequently!

Overall, Allebnany Restaurant is a fantastic choice for anyone looking for delicious food, great service, and a lovely atmosphere. I can't wait to return, especially for that incredible dessert!

user_reviews.Name: Roseau Trading co
user_reviews.Description:
Great place for authentic Arabian desserts

I came back here for dinner few days back and here are few photos of what I had it was the best hummus that I had  and a great arrais meat wonderful taste

Will come again

user_reviews.Name: Mihai Ignat
user_reviews.Description:
Splendid restaurant with very tasty foods!
I wish that I knew earlier that they have a buffet for Ramadan period which started at 6 pm, I would have come then! But I got there at 8 and they were just cleaning the buffet.

However the menu is very simple yet the food is very raffinate!
I had some kebab which was very tasty and appetisers!

I would love to give 5 starts however they need to improve the waiters…
I ordered for Coca-Cola and she just brought the bottle without the opener. I asked for an opener or if she could open it for me and she never brought it, so I had to open the bottle with my lighter 😂

Then I asked for chips for my kebab and she brought rice.

Then her English was very very poor.

It’s pity because the restaurant is amazing and the food is delicious! You guys need to improve on your waiters.

Otherwise I’m happy to come back again soon!

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
Wow! This is the real Lebanese style of # shawarma in # Addis Ababa that I finally found out.
The long, thin, and crispy baked bread contains the chicken meat and french fries, which is my favourite.

It seems to be mainly busy at dinnertime, but they are also open in the mornings and at lunchtime.
I was told by a waitress that the live music show and dancing attraction starts at 10 pm every night for 3 hours, and that they no longer have a sheesha service.

​I realised that it would be more economical to order two chicken shawarma sandwiches than one chicken shawarma plate, considering the volume and taste.

Unfortunately, I heard that their belly dancing show has been suspended for the time being.
They have also stopped accepting credit​ cards for some unknown reason.

# shawarma　# Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: I truly appreciate Mario's wonderful suggestion to try out this restaurant. The shawarma was absolutely delicious, and this spot has now earned a place on my list of top favorites. Thank you so much!

user_reviews.Name: Fadi Iskandarani
user_reviews.Description:
I was surprised to find a Lebanese restaurant and sweet shop in Addis Ababa… went in with local friend and enjoyed the sweet

I was lucky to meet chef Elie.. who welcomed us very warmly

Next day went for lunch with friends, food was very delicious and portions are big

It was a very pleasant experience… next time in Addis Ababa I know where to go for food

title: ሸራተን አዲስ ሆቴል
address: Taitu St, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia
description: Laid-back quarters in a refined retreat offering 10 dining options, an outdoor pool & a spa.

user_reviews.Name: Shairul Azni
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing king bed room.

Luxurious, comfortable and peaceful! Best sleep in Addis, beautiful property with pools and gardens. Staff fantastic. Far better than other big-name hotels here. 10/10 – my new go-to! 🇪🇹✨

user_reviews.Name: baiano59
user_reviews.Description: Exceptional property - well managed and maintained, great facilities and excellent, attentive people.  Ethiopians are friendly by nature but the team at the at the Sheraton is over the top. ||Everything about my stay was first class starting with the check-in process which was handled by Mariamawit Yimer. She thinks like a guest, was very friendly / funny and has a contagious, positive attitude.  I made a point of telling the front desk manager, Zelalem, about Mariamawit. He was very gracious, professional and extremely helpful to me during my stay.  He is one of the main reasons I will return. ||The service in the executive lounge led by Wondwossen Worku was outstanding. Attentive and prepared great food.  He is extremely funny too ||There are 3 more people which made my experience unique:  each worked in the Summerfield restaurant. Abnet Mengistie, Ayda Fitwi and Bethlehem were, you guessed it, professional, funny and attentive.  I can’t speak highly enough of them.

user_reviews.Name: RakeshWahi
user_reviews.Description: The Sheraton Addis Ababa is the best hotel in the city. It’s a sprawling estate with a great walking track and outside gym. The pool and SPA are exceptional. Restaurants at the hotel are very diverse in cuisine. The staff was very well trained and courteous. A fantastic stay. 👏👏

user_reviews.Name: 343howardr
user_reviews.Description: The Sheraton Addis was an excellent hotel. The hotel sits up on a small hill overlooking part of Addis. The approach to the hotel from side is very impressive.  The quality and ambiance of the hotel was more than what I was expecting. Addis and Ethiopia are nice in places but certainly has its rough spots as well. The Sheraton will make you feel well cared for while you are there. The doormen out front and reception staff were always very helpful. |All of the dining venues we ate in were very good.  The food, drinks, whether coffee or wine were exceptional. Our favorite restaurant was Stagioni Italian Restaurant. We ate there for dinner with a nice view out the back overlooking a lit up skyline of Addis Ababa.(see Photo) We tried the local Ethiopian wine, Castel Rift Valley, Cabernet Sauvignon, which we thought was very good and much cheaper than the imported wines from South Africa or France.    Also, we had very nice drinks and snacks before our city tour at the Fountain Court bar in the lounge area. |We booked some tours before hand but probably could have waited to book at the Sheraton.|Did not have any qualms about security and no issues with noise or crowds. On Saturday night it was very popular with nice groups of locals enjoying this lovely hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Cosmin Pavel
user_reviews.Description: I’ve stayed here five times now, and it’s honestly one of the best places you can stay in Addis. Some of the amenities are a bit older and show some use, but everything is always very clean and comfortable. A little renovation in a few rooms could make it even better, but overall it’s a great place.

user_reviews.Name: 135jamr
user_reviews.Description: Service is good - but rooms are very old, with old furniture and not thought for the business traveler. It took me forever to understand how the old lighting system works, with all the writings being gone by usage, and in the room there was not a single USB plug! That should be a bare minimum nowadays. There are definitely better options in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Taylor Kidd
user_reviews.Description: Overall a very nice hotel with excellent staff and luxurious rooms. Beddings and linens are clean and comfortable. Gym is well-equipped and the pool is also enjoyable. I must say, I've been here 3 times and I've gotten sick each time just eating hotel food only. Not acceptable for a chain like this. Hotel is also located in a rough area so don't walk around with any valuables or they will be removed from you.

user_reviews.Name: Tsega Fanta
user_reviews.Description:
Sheraton Addis is amazing — I love the ambience, the service, the cleanliness, the spa, and the entertainment. Everything feels top-notch and welcoming.

Just a small note: at the big coffee ceremony, a warmer smile would make the experience even better. On both visits, the hostess seemed less welcoming compared to the outstanding service everywhere else.

Still, Sheraton Addis is an exceptional place I’d highly recommend!

title: Aladdin Restaurant
address: XPQG+VWC Aladdin Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bonny Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description:
The Warq enab lacked the pomegranate sauce according to my friend that knows and loves the dish. We also had the tabbouleh and hummus which tasted divine but forgot to take photos.
Might be the best pizza in town.

user_reviews.Name: RC
user_reviews.Description:
My family and I visited the old location 2 or 3 times over the past few years and made some good memories. The waitstaff was always engaging, and the food was good. Yesterday I learned from another business owner that Aladdin moved closer to my home, so I figured I’d take my wife there for our date night. We passed the restaurant twice expecting a stand-alone location, so we asked some guards where to find it. FYI, the restaurant is at the lower level of the building that has Daily Mini Market and Arosci Spa.
The entry makes it feel like you’re entered whole new world. The ambience was nice. We chose to sit outside. I recognized one of the servers. She and the other guys have been with Aladdin for nearly a decade. It was clear throughout the night that they were seasoned staff and knew how to interact with both local and ferenji clientele.
My wife and I ordered a number of things, and all of them were perfect. I can’t think of a negative thing about our evening. Once the word gets out that the Bisrate Gebriel area has another quality dining experience, I expect this place to be packed.

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
No wonder I was surprised to find how this restaurant tucked away on the main road to the international airport. The genre name of the restaurant reminded me of one of my favourite teachers.
I had little idea what 'Armenian cuisine' was, but it seemed to be somehow Lebanese.
More than 95% of the customers are European and most of them are travellers. The food was quite good but the service was a bit poor, unfortunately, due to the crowds.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: Restaurant has now moved to a new location, in the basement of a building located near Lafto Mall. I must say that the new place has a warm and cosy feel, even if part of it is outside the building. There are two other parts: a bar and restaurant, which are designed very well. The food is as good as usual, and the service is excellent.

user_reviews.Name: Emnet Sebhatu
user_reviews.Description: Kind of hard to find as it is at the basement level of the mall. The space is very peaceful, good dining environment, and the food was delicious. We ordered the falafel and the Tabouleh. Draft beer was fresh and the pita bread was excellent.

user_reviews.Name: Chloe Jeong
user_reviews.Description: Nice outdoor tables under shades and good service! Tried chicken Kebab and mixed one. And we liked the chicken better: super tender and beef had some smells which I dont like. Portion is not big for guys and enough for ladies. Will definitely come back and try their pizza and other menus:)

user_reviews.Name: Maricha MartinezSosa
user_reviews.Description: Extensive menu with Arabian/Armenian  gastronomy as well as many pizza options. They have lots of vegetarian plates all properly identified. The food was good: falafels were freshly fried, meat was fresh and the baklava was really juicy... The staff is very polite and they have a small parking area available for the clients.

user_reviews.Name: Changsu Siris Woo
user_reviews.Description:
This is a quite atmospheric Lebanese restaurant. While the food quality is not outstanding, the service from the staff is excellent, and the prices are reasonable.

There are plenty of sittings.

When I visited in the evening, there were continuous power outages, but they were resolved through the use of generators.

The restaurant has a mix of half foreigners and half locals, making it a recommended place for those who like Middle Eastern cuisine. The quatrofomagio pizza and hummus were decent, and the falafel was okay, but the shish kebab was a bit lackluster.

title: Angla Burger
address: Zimbabwe St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mostawanted R
user_reviews.Description:
Hello Angla Burgers Team,

I have been a loyal customer for the past 15 years, visiting every week because of your excellent customer service and great food. The service has always been the main reason I choose Angla Burgers as one of my favorite places in Addis.

However, during my last two visits, I was disappointed to see a change. One of your employees was handling four customers at the same time, while the manager was sitting and using his phone. This is not the level of service I am used to at Angla.

Since I really care about this place and don’t want to see it go down in quality, I wanted to let you know. You may even ask your long-time employees — they know me well, as I always sit in the same spot.

Thank you for your attention, and I hope to see the great service return.

Kind regards,
Rami Hussen

user_reviews.Name: benyam asfaw
user_reviews.Description: Angla has fallen so far. For ten years, it was my favorite. Despite the rise of other great burger places, I held onto Angla, fueled by memories. But those memories are all that's left. Today, they were out of everything: the fish sandwich, the vegan burger, and my friend's choice, the Angal Special 4. I ended up with a vegetable sandwich, and my friend left without eating. The fries looked like scraps seriously it looked like they reheated someone else's left overs, and the sandwich was tasteless. The nostalgia is gone, replaced by disappointment. Angla is no longer a place for me.

user_reviews.Name: Ermias Abebe Kassa
user_reviews.Description:
I visited their new branch at Arat Kilo with family  and I would say this is one of the crappiest burger joints in Addis.
1. The place is stuffy and dirty. No janitor in sight. I suspect they clean it once in the morning and that is all.
2. Our order, just three plain burgers, took 45 minutes. Obvious, as the kitchen is too small to cater for the massive order their ads attracted.
3. The burgers are bland. Would not say more.

The only saving grace was the girl who served us was cheerful.

user_reviews.Name: Razo
user_reviews.Description: I used to visit this spot 10 years ago because it was close to my gym and I loved eating their special burgers after my workouts.However in 2025 the quality has significantly declined the food tastes worse, the service is lacking and the place hasn’t had any upgrades. Unfortunately i don’t think I’ll be coming back this was my last visit.

user_reviews.Name: Amanuel Gezahegn
user_reviews.Description: There burger is nice. In fact its one of the best burger in town. Small in quantity and a little higher in price. We've tried the Angela Special 1 best taste.

user_reviews.Name: Nader Iskander
user_reviews.Description:
This is hilarious ... the actual restaurant differs from the photos which belongs to a other branch!

Plus, horrible burger.... don't waste your money nor time

user_reviews.Name: Amanu R
user_reviews.Description: Food and service both awesome here and the ambiance is old school small town goodness

user_reviews.Name: Mikiyas Melkamu
user_reviews.Description: I recently visited Angla Burger and found that the burgers were overrated. The place was usually empty, which made me question the quality of the food. The prices were expensive as well, and I was unimpressed with the taste. Overall, I would not recommend visiting Angla Burger.

title: Mama's Kitchen | Bole Medhanialm | ማማስ ኪችን | ቦሌ መድሐኒአለም
address: XQWQ+72J Mama's Kitchen | Bole Medhanialm | ማማስ ኪችን | ቦሌ መድሐኒአለም, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Mama's Kitchen | Bole Medhanialm | ማማስ ኪችን | ቦሌ መድሐኒአለም (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Maricha MartinezSosa
user_reviews.Description: At first the menu appeared too limited but then we discovered they also have a pizza menu and some day offers. The food we ordered was delicious, the portions have a good size and the price was way lower than expected. Service was outstanding: as a vegetarian I even got the option to order a side dish of vegetables that were not in the menu. The ambient is amazing, they have and extensive bar with a vast variety of alcoholic drinks that included draft St. George beer. Both on Sundays and Mondays they have live music in the night. A great spot to be repeated and recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Hilena Tafesse
user_reviews.Description:
I love how you can get good food and drink at the same place. The music is not so loud , allows you to talk each other.
It’s a good place to hangout with friends.
Their food is tasty, but a bit expensive.

Good interior look as well.

user_reviews.Name: Hannah.M
user_reviews.Description: Awesome place! Great food and great vibes. The staff were very helpful and friendly. Overall check out the place.

user_reviews.Name: ዳግማዊ ሰለሞን
user_reviews.Description:
The place is used to be very busy in previous years. There were only very few people on Saturday night. It was very quiet and we liked it. Nice slow musics were played. The food was tasty. The staff who has served us was active and friendly.
I hope they will work on to return back the busiess.

user_reviews.Name: J M
user_reviews.Description:
I was feeling hungry, so I decided to order Tibs Firfir, a dish made up of torn-up bits of injera mixed with clarified butter. I specifically requested for it to be non-spicy, but when it was served, it turned out to be a bit hot and spicy. Although I could have eaten it without complaint, the waiter insisted on changing the order to make up for the mistake. I was impressed by the excellent service provided in Addis.

Thank you Betty , yordi

user_reviews.Name: Tigist Tadesse
user_reviews.Description: I went with my mother for lunch and all I have to say is this;The food was incredibly average. And don't get me started on the service , it is one of the worst I have ever seen. I ordered a cheeseburger and my mom ordered a mixed salad and how many minutes does it take them to make these dishes? Not 20 minutes, Not 30 minutes, Not 40 minutes but 50 FULL minutes. I don't know how the owner of this establishment calls this abomination of a restaurant "exemplary". Overall, my experience in this restaurant was incredibly underwhelming. My recommendation is that you either go to another restaurant or wait 1 full hour for food. If I could rate this restaurant a 0 stars than I would most definitely would.

user_reviews.Name: Arinze Uche

user_reviews.Name: Surafel Chanie

user_reviews.Name: ZEMEN

user_reviews.Name: Ermi Misge

user_reviews.Name: Secret Wars
user_reviews.Description: If there was a 0 star service I would have given it, considering the house has a good reputation, I was disappointed by the service they were giving. Even the vibe in the house sucks due to lack of management. That's all I have to say during my 2 hour stay at the house.

user_reviews.Description:
The worst burger I've ever had. Won't recommend it. Plus the space is very tiny.
This place is getting shitter. Never recommend for anyone. If you don't have cash never think about this place. Goddammit!

user_reviews.Name: haymnot
user_reviews.Description: The food is too good, but prepair to wait for 1 or 2 burgers

user_reviews.Name: Azaria
user_reviews.Description: The place has a very small sitting area and service was slow maybe its b/c its the weekend and it was crowded.The Food is good but i don't know why they don't add salt in their burger. The price is very affordable.

user_reviews.Name: bruce bruce
user_reviews.Description: U have to try it, It was so good but the time i wait till prepared is too long so i advice u call and order before you come.

user_reviews.Name: henok fentaw
user_reviews.Description: You have to wait for an hour to get the food ,but the price is good ,it is better to call before you come.

title: Totot Traditional Food Hall | Gerji | ቶቶት | ገርጂ
address: 2R54+2W4 Totot Traditional Food Hall | Gerji | ቶቶት | ገርጂ, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Totot Traditional Food Hall | Gerji | ቶቶት | ገርጂ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: chaitaly mehta
user_reviews.Description:
We were recommended to this restaurant by our hotel concierge. It was our first morning in Addis with majority of us arriving during the night and morning hours. Everyone was hungry.
We were here for a conference.

The place is charming, people are kind and food was delicious and excellent. Throughout our conference we kept comparing the food we ate here with all the other places, this one still came up 1st.

This restaurant should definitely be on your must visit list when in Addis.
The coffee was also some of the finest.

The service was excellent although I think our server was overwhelmed with the sheer no of us- 18 or 19 but still tried to deliver to his best.

One of the highlights of my trip.

The food was just yumm and delicious.

user_reviews.Name: Asael Gadot
user_reviews.Description: We arrived at Totot Restaurant as an organized group. It is a touristy place, with a continuous show throughout the evening. I don't know about the prices, but we mainly ate traditional Ethiopian food from the buffet. I must say that it was very tasty and the spiciness was moderate (probably for our Western taste). The service was pleasant and the band was loud, but it added to the ethnic atmosphere. Recommended.

user_reviews.Name: C Ray
user_reviews.Description:
Resturant serving traditional Ethiopian food and life music and dance performances.

I went on my first day in Addis Ababa, so it's a bit hard to compare the food to other places.  I can just say that my meal was tasty.

The dance performances were amazing.

I had one dish and one half bottle of Tef. My bill was 3400. Expensive, but you're paying for the performances as well.

Monday's show started before I arrived at 8 PM and ended around 10:30 PM. Rumor says the shows start later on other nights.

Credit cards accepted

user_reviews.Name: Tekalign Chemesa
user_reviews.Description: The band and  the atmosphere is very familiar form of Ethiopian traditional places and the service also gives the best traditional food the food is very good at it all I love everything in there I will recommend who has foreign guests to invite them here thanks “ Tenkir”(owner of the place) for this amazing place to promote your country culture and your welcoming is very nice.

user_reviews.Name: tsi tsi
user_reviews.Description:
Visited on July 29, 2025

I had dinner at this traditional restaurant with five family members — we were six in total (my child didn’t eat). The place is beautifully designed and has a classic atmosphere that really reflects Ethiopian culture.

We ordered traditional food and Tej (honey wine). While the first round of Tej arrived normally, the second order came very late. The waiter told us it had run out and a new batch had to be prepared.

Unfortunately, shortly after returning home, I and the family members I live with began vomiting. The next day, I called my other relatives and they confirmed they also experienced the same symptoms.

Today is day two. While the rest of my family (who live here in Ethiopia) are feeling better, I’ve been in bed all day, weak and unwell. I live abroad and this experience has been very upsetting.

It’s really unfortunate, especially coming from such a respected and beautiful establishment. I’m sharing this not out of anger, but as a warning: please be careful with food and drink hygiene, especially with items like ‘Teji’.

I hope the restaurant takes this feedback seriously

user_reviews.Name: Ahsan Mirza
user_reviews.Description:
Great ambiance, good authentic food

Too loud. They don't pause for too long between performance so you can't talk with your table mates. Service is slow when they're at peak

user_reviews.Name: Soffonias
user_reviews.Description:
We visited Totot as a large group — three families, several kids, and most of us diaspora who came excited to enjoy a nice meal together in our home country. The restaurant is very spacious, almost like a wedding venue, so we truly believed it would be a comfortable place for families to dine.

Unfortunately, what happened there left us shocked and deeply disappointed.

From the beginning, we waited an unusually long time for our food. Naturally, the kids became bored — as any kids would — and they started walking and running around in the huge open space. We were watching them, and in a place that big, it didn’t seem like they were bothering anyone. We were simply trying to keep them occupied while waiting and had no intention of disturbing anyone.

But then a manager approached us and told us to “hold our kids” because they were disturbing the white people in the restaurant. Hearing that was extremely hurtful — especially coming from staff in our own country. As diaspora, we always try to support local businesses, and that day we were spending just as much, if not more, than any other customers. To be singled out and spoken to like that was not only disrespectful, but also discriminatory.

Instead of acknowledging the long wait time or speaking to us respectfully, the manager chose to prioritize certain guests over others and make us feel unwelcome and inferior in a place we were supporting with our money. That comment alone ruined the entire experience. We immediately got up and left because no family deserves to be spoken to that way.

We didn’t complain or raise our voices; we simply removed ourselves from a situation that made us feel small and disrespected.

Totot needs to understand that every customer — local or foreign — deserves equal respect. No parent should be made to feel embarrassed for their children simply being kids, and no one should ever be told their presence is less important than someone else’s.

Our experience was painful, disappointing, and unacceptable. We will not be returning, and we sincerely hope management reflects on this incident and learns to treat all guests with fairness and dignity moving forward.

user_reviews.Name: Daniel
user_reviews.Description: Well designed and maintained cultural hall with amazing traditional Ethiopian cuisine Even the waiters are wearing traditional clothing as well. I visited for lunch on a weekday and it was less busy than usual.

title: The Exclusive Restaurant
address: XQVP+Q3C The Exclusive Restaurant, XQVP+Q3X 123, Africa Ave, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Meazi
user_reviews.Description:
Thank you for making my friend's birthday unforgettable! This restaurant in Addis Ababa is truly professional, with delicious food and outstanding customer service. The staff are incredibly nice and attentive.
Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Surafel Boss
user_reviews.Description:
Exclusiv Fine & Dining offers an exceptional dining experience from the moment you walk in. The atmosphere is elegant and inviting, with a warm ambiance that makes every guest feel special. The service is outstanding — attentive, professional, and always delivered with a smile.

The food is truly the highlight. Every dish is prepared with care, beautifully presented, and full of rich, balanced flavor. From starters to dessert, you can tell that the chefs put passion into every detail. Whether you're coming for a romantic dinner, a family celebration, or an exclusive event, this restaurant consistently delivers a top-tier experience.

If you're looking for a place that combines luxury, comfort, and unforgettable taste, Exclusiv Fine & Dining is the perfect choice. Highly recommended.

user_reviews.Name: Biruk Gossaye
user_reviews.Description:
Great for your fine dining experiences.
Call to reserve your seats. We were lucky enough to get a table walking in. The appetizers were more awe inspiring than the main dish. Over all a good experience with a lovely staff.

user_reviews.Name: Josh Smalley
user_reviews.Description: An excellent place. Good vibes. Good flavors. Professional staff. A must visit in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Estifanos Alebel
user_reviews.Description:
The service was outstanding. The staff were friendly, attentive, and really made the whole experience smooth. I especially want to mention Hana, who stood out with her professionalism and kindness. She checked on us at the right times, made great recommendations, and genuinely made the night feel special.

The food? Amazing. Everything was fresh, well-seasoned, and beautifully served. From the starters to the main dishes, you can tell the kitchen puts real effort into quality and presentation.

user_reviews.Name: Wendy Oui
user_reviews.Description:
Feels like dining at a high-end restaurant in Europe.
The ambiance is great, and they serve pasta and pizza as well.

The appetizers and drinks were all excellent.
For the main course, we went with the restaurant’s recommendation and ordered the ribs and tenderloin…
but the ribs were disappointingly ordinary. 😞

I should’ve gone for the tenderloin with pasta or pizza instead.
That said, the atmosphere is truly amazing!

— Oh, and they’re closed on Wednesdays. 😆

user_reviews.Name: Yohannes Tefera
user_reviews.Description: We went on a birthday dinner and the food was outstanding starting from the entree, the steak and the chicken cordon bleu, to the cocktail and desserts as well. When we come to our server girma he was very caring person. He helped us choose foods and drinks that were great to our likings. The manager was a very cooprative and a nice guy who was checking on us every once in a while and make the birthday a day that we will never forget. I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to the staff members especially our server girma and the house manager for making this special day unforgettable. I would recommend this place if you want to have a very chill vibe and good meal or if you have a special day to celebrate this is the right place to be at

user_reviews.Name: Jordan Granger
user_reviews.Description: One of the best steak dinner experiences I have ever had in the WORLD. The food is not only the very best, but the facility, the staff, the culture and environment is unmatched. Come here and you will be treated like family and royalty with the highest of careful, warm service of the most exquisite dining experience of your life.

title: dok restaurant
address: 2RF3+29 dok restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Nana Tchuingwa
user_reviews.Description:
The location is excellent, offering a pleasant view over part of the city. The restaurant itself is beautifully decorated, with plants throughout that add charm and character, and the space is generous and comfortable.

On the downside, the carbonara did not meet expectations, despite the pasta being fresh. Additionally, the service would benefit from improvement.

user_reviews.Name: JHA
user_reviews.Description: The atmosphere is very nice, the place amazing the sight is magnificent the price is in the range of a bit to the expensive side but it makes u forget when you taste the food

user_reviews.Name: Yohannes Belay
user_reviews.Description: I had the worst chicken Alfredo in my life it taste like garlic water disgusting when I inform them they say they will make it better in the future and did not change the food

user_reviews.Name: Abebe Dessalegn
user_reviews.Description: Food was amazing. We ordered 6 dishes and all of them were bomb 👌🏾… wine was great as well… we had great time…

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description:
Situated on top of Addis, I love this place and the views it offers. The menu has pizzas, pastas, meats/chicken and Ethiopian food. You’d also get a range of beers and wines on the menu.

We only had a thin crust pizza: prosciutto crudo and the dok special (50:50) and were very happy with it.  Service was excellent too!

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Firdawok
user_reviews.Description: The place is great I liked the top view went there with a bunch of friends well I don’t know the food was pretty bland for the price but I enjoyed and ate it. But me and my friends did have a great time on the swing bringing up old days.

user_reviews.Name: Fikir A
user_reviews.Description: Delicate taste with selected Italian cuisine. Cosy ambiance and  located in a walking distance from one of the active areas of the new downtown of the city. After revisiting the place; the service and food was more nicer which we enjoyed every single wish we ordered from different parts of the menu.

user_reviews.Name: Dave Samuel
user_reviews.Description: Ever feel tired of going to suffocating restaurants here in Addis Ababa during lunchtime? Then this place will be your favourite spot especially if you like Italian cuisine. I had pizza, ravioli and quanta fir fir and all of them tasted amazing. In addition, the place has plenty of space even to dine outside, you will love it during sunny days. They have a good parking space that can accommodate many cars.

title: Deluxe Catering & Restaurant

user_reviews.Name: Liya Tadele
user_reviews.Description: a very handsome 👨‍🍳  chef from Norway ......z food is 🔥 i hv no word for their service ......am in love with zat place .....❤❤❤❤

title: OM Indian Bistro | Bole Rwanda
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: This vegetarian-only spot a bit of a letdown at first since I was hoping for more variety dont be surprised once your there like me, but still very nice place. The food is good, and you can ask detailed questions about the dishes staff is super polite, helpful, and really knows the menu. The drinks are a nice surprise too, especially the mango lassi, which is definitely my favorite. The vibe is great—cozy, calm, and a solid place to just chill or hang out with friends. If you’re into veggie and Indian food its the place.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Mengesha
user_reviews.Description: The place provides many vegetarian options, very recommended for fasting seasons. The customer service was wonderful. The waitress is very friendly and helpful. The food was a whole experience for me. I specially enjoyed the Indian Thali (fasting version),  should tell them how spicy you want it. The place is not as spacious as it seems on the pictures so reservation would be a good idea.

user_reviews.Name: Amanuel Belay
user_reviews.Description: Very cozy atmosphere, with great flavorful food and presentation.

user_reviews.Name: Chintan Raichura
user_reviews.Description:
Can’t stress enough! We felt like going back to Addis Ababa or extending our stay to have one more meal at this restaurant.
Authentic taste, hot meals, warm hospitality and cool breeze of air!
Not very pricey.
Fully VEGETARIAN which was difficult to believe at first!

user_reviews.Name: RC
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been an OM customer for several years. I’ve had only 1 negative experience in this period of time, and the manager resolved the situation in an excellent manner.
Today I took a friend out for lunch. When he saw the street food, he asked, “This is lunch?” and “Where is the meat?” Lol. I assured him everything would be ok, and he left very satisfied without being able to finish our meal. I ordered the pani poori, masala dosa, paneer tikka, garlic naan, and samosa chaali (sp.) items from the menu. I also got a mango lassi for myself. The food was a combo of different flavors: sweet, savory, spicy, etc. I enjoyed myself, as always.
The interior design is really nice. I remember having Valentine’s dinner here with my wife a few years ago, and the atmosphere was perfect. Service was attentive.

user_reviews.Name: Jun Amano
user_reviews.Description: Very cozy and stylish Indian restaurant which serves only veg foods. Interior design is just simply gorgeous and Indian food here is needless to say, nice. I had Indian thali which was well in volume and spinach curry became my favorite. The location may be hard to reach but it is worth coming here!

user_reviews.Name: Kyle Dontoh
user_reviews.Description: Very high quality vegetarian food. Service was excellent and many of the dishes were up there with the best I've had anywhere. Ultra creamy Palak Paneer was a delight, and the Thali was massive. Brownie with Kulfi was a vision of decadence. Food was so good I ordered some more to take home, will certainly be coming back.

user_reviews.Name: S. Howard
user_reviews.Description: We wanted to try everything on the menu! I would recommend to order appetizer because main meal does take a little time to prepare.   Our waitress was very good but I wish she came to check in on us more regularly.

title: Entoto Restaurant
address: Abyssinia Real Estate Building, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Nuhamin Abera
user_reviews.Description:
I went to Entoto with my little sister for a birthday lunch staring at 6:30 local time. They had strictly business coded outfit rule and kids under the age of 10 is not allowed which we were informed via text message last minute but they let us to enter since it was their fault for delayed delivery of information yet they changed our table set. Overall the place is a fusion of elegance and artistry, every details of each corner is perfectly designed to impress and had a promising dinning experience with a beautifully presented plate yet the feast for the eyes ended when we took a bite. The flavor fails to deliver a satisfaction with poor seasoning and unevenly cooked meals. The staffs tried to enhance our experience, offering a good cup of coffee afterwards unfortunately the hospitality can't compensate the disappointment.
Beside the restaurant the place also have a beautiful art gallery, gift shops with unique items and a coffee shop. They serve amazing pastries and healthy smoothies as well.

user_reviews.Name: Henokabba
user_reviews.Description:
Entoto Restaurant
Bole Japan Embassy

If you're looking for a perfect dining experience in Addis Abeba, Entoto Restaurant is definitely worth a visit. Located conveniently near the Japan Embassy and not far from the airport, it offers an ideal spot for both locals and travelers seeking a relaxed yet refined atmosphere.
The setting is nothing short of impressive. The restaurant features a beautiful gallery that adds a touch of elegance, complemented by luxurious furniture that enhances the overall dining experience. Whether you're there for a casual meal or a special occasion, the ambiance is both calming and inviting, making it a great place to unwind.

When it comes to the food, Entoto doesn’t disappoint. The menu features a variety of fresh and flavorful dishes. The salad is light and crisp, the vegetable soup is comforting and both the spaghetti and gnocchi are cooked to perfection, rich in flavor without being overwhelming. Each dish feels like it’s made with care and attention to detail.

What truly stands out, however, is the attentive staff. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted with warm hospitality. The service is prompt and the staff is more than happy to cater to your needs, making the experience feel personal and memorable.

Whether you’re in the mood for a leisurely meal or need a quiet place to reflect, Entoto Restaurant’s combination of great food, serene environment and exceptional service makes it a standout choice.

Highly recommended

user_reviews.Name: Kirubel Seyoum
user_reviews.Description:
The place has 3 different spots located side by side. The gallary, the cafe and the restaurant. I only got to experience the first two.
The gallery has an eye-catching exterior wall facade design. it's a glass wall with beautiful patterns cut off from beveled squares arranged on a grid. There are also crafts displayed for people passing by. Inside, you'll find delicately made decorations, artworks, accessories and tools all made by talented and creative individuals.  I really loved the whole vibe of it.
And the Cafe was a casual and cozy one, nothing too crazy. It's a great spot to sit and talk. Its a great place overall!

user_reviews.Name: Hiền Kim
user_reviews.Description: On my first visit at 7 PM on a Wednesday, the restaurant said they didn't have a table available if I hadn't made a reservation; I assumed the restaurant must be really good. On my next visit during lunch, there wasn't anything particularly special except for the raw beef dish, which I really enjoyed. If you're famished, I advise against going to this restaurant because the food takes a long time to arrive – almost 30 minutes between the first and second dishes, even though there were only 3 tables of customers at that time. Drinks also took a while. I didn't have enough time to eat the last dish and left it untouched. Overall, the restaurant experience wasn't very positive

user_reviews.Name: anduamlak temesgen
user_reviews.Description:
Entoto Restaurant – Tikur Anbesa Branch (Menged Dar)
The issues I faced were as follows:

Extremely Poor Customer Service:

The staff showed limited attentiveness and hospitality.

We waited a long time before even being acknowledged and attended to.

Customer requests were not handled with courtesy or urgency.

Unreasonably Delayed Food Service:

Our order took an excessively long time to be served, without any explanation or apology.

Other customers also appeared frustrated due to the slow service.

user_reviews.Name: Wengel Alemayehu
user_reviews.Description: We ordered the Arba Minch fish dish, but when it arrived it was very cold, like it had just come out of the fridge. We asked them to remake it properly, but instead they only reheated it in the microwave. Unfortunately, it was still unpleasant and very disappointing.

user_reviews.Name: Rooney Getu
user_reviews.Description:
Expensive!! but the food is really outstanding! Every meal we had was full of flavor and cooked to perfection. I really suggest the "MUKET" dish.

The atmosphere is  great! Cozy atmosphere, soft lighting with stunning art gallery and gift shop.

user_reviews.Name: Andy Turnbull
user_reviews.Description: This is a review of the gift shop, not the restaurant.  This is the perfect place to buy gifts for your loved ones. The staff we're very friendly and very helpful. The shop is a treasure trove of Ethiopian handicrafts, ornaments, clothing, books, coffee, soaps, so much to choose from. All at a very reasonable price. You will also help unprivileged women and those living with HIV by buying products here. It also has a fantastic art gallery, a cafe and a restaurant.

title: Fogo No Chao
address: Woreda, Block No 14 # 3, Airport Road, Addis Ababa 8111, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Michael Schienke (VORBILDarchitecture)
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been here many times, always when staying at the Ramada. its a very cool roof top restaurant, always busy, always with good food.
I remember coming here since 2019 and it's great to see the space change and adapt.

My absolute favourite is the grilled pineapple. Sadly it’s not always prepared…

user_reviews.Name: Veronika Kunz
user_reviews.Description:
This restaurant deserves much higher rating!
The food is very tasty, big verity of side dishes and deserts, meat is good (some cuts of beef are hard to chew, but some are melting in your mouth). Service is very attentive and friendly and the view is beautiful!

user_reviews.Name: Scott Jackson
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful restaurant with a great view. The staff is very helpful and accommodating. The food is pretty good although some of the meats can be overcooked or undercooked.

user_reviews.Name: Jun Amano
user_reviews.Description: Brazilian restaurant in Addis Ababa where serves churrasco. All the meat is very delicious but the beef is a little tough so we need a little more of tenderness. Salad, black beans and grilled pineapples are all terrific. Also the location and night view are the highlight of the restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: CAN OZDEMIR
user_reviews.Description: Very nice place located on the 10th floor of Ramada with great views over Addis Ababa. Very friendly servers and nice setting, however it is not up to Brazilian standards. The buffet is very nice, the meat is no good (caused by the meat in Ethiopia, it is very hard, almost impossible to chew), the desserts were almost finished by the time we finished our meat so don’t know how it was.

user_reviews.Name: Konsta Riihinen
user_reviews.Description: Good food. The meat is not as good as in South-America, nice place and very enjoyable experience. The buffet dinner was 18€

user_reviews.Name: Yurii Reznikov
user_reviews.Description: Great service.  Excellent food.  Big thanks to chef Abdulmajid.

user_reviews.Name: BUDI SANTOSO
user_reviews.Description: First time tasting genuine Brazilian Churrascaria Restaurant here in Addis. Great buffet dinner, very friendly staffs. Will come back...

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: Kimo the DJ is best at his welcoming face, and very well aware of the hospitality industry. The overall service is quite nice, I expected to see the beautiful viewed of Addis Ababa in general, unfortunately a new building is built, blocking that marvelous view. Anyhow I enjoyed my time, the compound has a lot of plants and outdoor space for a nice fresh air. I highly recommend this place, especially for a night life!!

user_reviews.Name: Ayehu
user_reviews.Description: Despite the name change - dok, and not any more Top View -, it is still a very good Italian restaurant in #Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Selamawit Zewdu
user_reviews.Description: The food wasn't bad but the service was kinda questionable love the vibe tho

user_reviews.Name: David Fenech
user_reviews.Description: Situated away from the chaos of the city, you can enjoy fresh air and open space at this restaurant. Good food, but not special. Was also greatly assisted by a man from the restaurant when it was pouring cats and dogs and he accompanied me with an umbrella up to our car

user_reviews.Name: Kidan Abayneh
user_reviews.Description: Great food, great service and a nice atmosphere. For those who want to walk there- it’s a bit of a steep slope.

user_reviews.Name: Lemi Werkneh
user_reviews.Description: They have very talented hosts and talented chefs, and the cleanliness is top notch. Their food is also very delicious. I really enjoyed it. Thank you.

user_reviews.Name: M C. (Maly)
user_reviews.Description: This is one of signiture restaurant in Megenena(Most of the Addis ababa Taxi drivers know the place) The view is now a bit hidden by other buildings But space of the restaurant is quite big. There is a outdoor playground for kids. Foods are mostly good(it was quite salty sometimes). Mostly Italian but they serve nice traditional dishies like Torowat(Spicy Chicken stew with Injera).

user_reviews.Name: A Anderson
user_reviews.Description: Sadly it’s now the “No View” restaurant since a huge hotel has been built totally blocking the view. Now it’s average food with a decent outdoor space, but no view at all.

title: Mamma Mia Italian Restaurant & Bar
address: beside the old tobacco factory, Close to the African Union Headquarters, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: beside the old tobacco factory, Close to the African Union Headquarters

user_reviews.Name: Sona Dadi
user_reviews.Description: Incredible atmosphere...I felt like I was stepping into a secluded historic place, with an "old Ethiopia" vibe... found with so much warmth, sophistication but also effortless elegance. This place felt intimate and cosy but also made me travel across the world to Italy. The chef is really passionate about what he does and the food speaks volumes. Prices are simple to understand. Highly recommend this place for family get togethers or a romantic dinner.

user_reviews.Name: Bethlehem Abera
user_reviews.Description: This place offers an incredible experience with its top-notch ambiance, simplicity, and seclusion. The setting is beautiful, and the chef's hospitality is exceptional. The homemade Italian pasta and sauces are truly delicious, and the tiramisu is a must-try. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Semhal Guesh
user_reviews.Description: Mamma Mia is an amazing place with excellent food and a beautiful ambiance. It’s one of those spots you go to not just to eat, but to truly enjoy the whole experience!

user_reviews.Name: Dave Samuel
user_reviews.Description:
I have come across to check out this fancy Italian restaurant which serves very authentic dishes, the place has got an extremely old villa which is very classic and attractive for me and I went there at night for dinner and most of the customers are foreigners, especially US embassy workers. When it comes to the food it’s worth trying their food if you are a fan of Italian foods and also don't forget to try their tiramisu probably one of the best in this city. Last but not least, the place is very suitable for a night date with your loved one with dim light and a candle on each table will create an unforgettable experience.

Notice:- the restaurant has only got one waiter who can serve you drinks only and to order food you need to get the head chef who gives a brief explanation for each food on the menu and you need to be patient.

user_reviews.Name: BP CG
user_reviews.Description: Some of the food I had here was better than in Italy. The host is so passionate and very friendly. I could taste that all this food was homemade with love. Well done ! Will be back again if I revisit Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Food is very tasty if h know what your ordering. Dessert ✅

user_reviews.Name: Mekonnen Gebretekle
user_reviews.Description: Delicious Italian food. The Ravioli, steak with teramiso desert was so nice. the house is a traditional old Ethiopian house made of mud which reminds the old days. It is absolutely lovely. The location is also ideal as it is few minilutes drive from Kazanchis. Bruno (the owner) assists what to eat and helped us to have the good mix. Please take care, it is over priced!

user_reviews.Name: Yonas tesfazion
user_reviews.Description: The food is absolutely delicious and the staff are very friendly. It has a home like vibe, very spacious outdoor area. Just like a mother’s home cooked meal, this place will satisfy your visit. I look forward to visiting again :)

title: Hilton Addis Ababa
address: Menelik II Ave, Addis Ababa 1164, Ethiopia
description: Airy quarters, some with mountain views, in a premium hotel offering 3 eateries & a geothermal pool.

user_reviews.Name: Yonas Isaak Tekle
user_reviews.Description:
Hilton Addis Ababa is an amazing place to stay and relax. It is a historic property that beautifully blends rich tradition with modern facilities. I had a wonderful stay and highly recommend it. All the staff I have had an opportunity to interact with were amazing but I would also like to give a special shout-out to Dawit Fikade, Alemayehu T. Markos, Hailu Abreham and Jerry Gedamu, who hosted me at the breakfast restaurant. They treated me like a family member and attended to all my needs. Their professionalism and kindness go beyond words.
In addition, I had access to the Executive Lounge and the opportunity to experience exquisite dining on the top floor, featuring breathtaking views and delicious food. The staff there, including Bizu Getahun and Tensaiy Seyoum as well as Hanna from executive lounge operator, were outstanding in their service and exceptional care.
I am truly grateful for the warmth, attention, and exceptional service I received from these individuals. Thank you for making my stay so memorable!

user_reviews.Name: Karolina Pearl
user_reviews.Description:
I had an excellent 10-day stay at the Hilton Addis Ababa. The highlight of my experience was the incredible staff, especially during breakfast every morning. They consistently went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and well taken care of. Their warm hospitality, kindness, and attention to detail truly made our stay unforgettable. 🩵💙💜

Thank you to the wonderful breakfast team—you made our mornings so much brighter. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Heyab Addisu
user_reviews.Description:
I regularly come to Hilton’s Gazebo Restaurant, and every visit is consistently amazing. From the moment I walk in, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff always make me feel at home. Samuel, the manager, is truly outstanding, he’s  friendly, attentive, and genuinely cares about the guests, which makes a huge difference.

The food is the main reason I keep coming back.  Both Chef Fikadu and Dereje are incredibly talented. Their pizza is to die for, easily one of the best I’ve had, and the steaks are always cooked to perfection,  juicy, flavorful, and unforgettable. You can really taste the passion they put into every dish.

Great food, great people, and consistently great service. I’ll definitely keep coming back!

user_reviews.Name: pngufor
user_reviews.Description: I came for some tennis and then sat in the restaurant next to the pool after for a drink and some snacks. Very good portions and the avocado salad/tapas was very fresh. The manager Abraham made it a point to come make sure I was ok as I was on my own and explained a few things to me about Ethiopian food. The assistant manager Gete was also very pleasant and this is a nice place to chill and enjoy some good food

user_reviews.Name: Diana Yvonne
user_reviews.Description:
The hotel is very nice , I have enjoyed the wide breakfast selection, the staff is very friendly and ready to help,  the pastry corner is literal heaven , shoutout to the Baker.

The rooms are clean and comfy beds, although we really needed some shower slippers.

Alex has a passion for his job.

The entire team made our Christmas holiday worth it !

God bless Ethiopia.

Merci.

user_reviews.Name: Nebyat Million
user_reviews.Description:
I am not a guest at Hilton Hotel but I am a member of Hilton's remarkable and intriguing gym.
While working out at the gym, I am always impressed by the diligence and responsiveness of the gym attendants and the remarkable recreational manager named Meklit Keflie is a person with an exceptional leadership experience and ability . Her professionalism, kindness, and hospitality have improved the hotel's service profoundly.
Meklit Keflie is always visible around the recreational area checking everything and ensuring everyone is doing good. She always listens to everybody's compliance politely and with patience. When a small issue cones up, she handles it personally and professionally striving to fix it immediately. She is constantly demonstrating outstanding leadership, ensuring both guests and staffs feel valued and supported inorder to ensure smooth flow of operations.

The other person that I can not help noticing while I am at the gym is a guy named Biruk Shewadeg. Every time I see him, he is always working voluntarily and happily to keep the fitness area exceptionally clean, organized, and well-stocked with towels and water.
Biruk Shewadeg is always friendly, polite, welcoming and attentive, making sure guests have everything they need and the equipments are in perfect working order.
Whether it is cleaning equipments, assisting guests, or supporting staff, Biruk handles every task with professionalism and enthusiasm.
His welcoming attitude and attention for details makes us to feel at home and our workout enjoyable.

Nebyat from Hilton gym.

user_reviews.Name: Hemanth Sriyapu
user_reviews.Description:
Hilton Addis - This place has postive vibes all around. This is my 2nd time here, had a warm welcome and all the staff are so good and nice hospitality. Today i was served by Waiter Hailu in the Restaurant. My special thanks to him for taking care of me.

Overall, a good place with lushy green gardens and lot of amenities.

Looking forward for a wonderful stay - Higky recommend this place.

user_reviews.Name: Trey Chenier
user_reviews.Description: Our stay at Hilton was amazing. Jerry and Dawit had made our stay more enjoyable. They are very friendly and professional. The location of the hotel is very convenient and there is a lot to do on site. The execute lounge has a 360 view of Addis, really pretty at night. We highly recommend Hilton Addis.

title: Grub On burger | Bole | ግራብ ኦን በርገር | ቦሌ
address: XQXQ+R3V Grub On burger | Bole | ግራብ ኦን በርገር | ቦሌ, Djibuti St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Grub On burger | Bole | ግራብ ኦን በርገር | ቦሌ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: mariem adem
user_reviews.Description: We had the Cheesy chunk and Chilliy Hot burgers. They tasted really good, however the size of the burgers were somewhat smaller than I expected. It’s a self serve restaurant, very clean and nice for taking photos.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: This burger place used to be great, but it’s really gone downhill lately. The burger just doesn’t taste the same anymore horrible taste kind of bland and disappointing. Chips are still fine, but the slow service makes it worse. Sad to see a once good spot lose its touch.

user_reviews.Name: Eletta Bonfanti
user_reviews.Description: Grub On serves up some juicy burgers. They're definitely on the pricier side, but the restaurant itself is quite visually appealing. It's a nice spot to dine in or conveniently order takeout. Unfortunately, the neighborhood isn't the best, so you might want to stick to delivery or takeout if you're concerned about your surroundings.

user_reviews.Name: tewodros wondwossen
user_reviews.Description: Nice and chill spot. It's self-serve at the counter. Great burgers slightly more expensive but good taste n portion as well.  Staff hygiene could be improved. But a nice spot plus music playlist was to my liking. Will definitely revisit.

user_reviews.Name: kalid seid
user_reviews.Description: The place is nice and they provide some chicken and beef types of burgers with some drinks and ice cream. Compared to others Burger places I would say the taste is descent. It's self service and also has a window for takeaways which in both cases the service is pretty fast.

user_reviews.Name: Bete Aberra
user_reviews.Description: Grub On is one of my favorite junk food places in Addis! What makes them unique is their sauces. I have tried few of them, the “Messy Melt” and the “Cheesy Chunk” are two my favorites. Both 380 BIRR, drinks are not included, I found it expensive. Moreover, if you want to taste how normal burger tastes in India, then try the “Chilly Hot” :) However, to be honest I didn’t like the fries, very chewy. But over all a good spacious place.

user_reviews.Name: benyam asfaw
user_reviews.Description: It's a real shame what's happened to this place. It used to be my go-to for burgers, a place which I can proudly recommend to others, but lately, it feels like the magic is gone. The quality has really taken a nosedive, especially considering the prices just keep climbing. I remember when their prices were higher than other burger spots, but you didn't mind because the food was worth it. Today, after not ordering for a while, I was honestly shocked at how far the quality has fallen. The patty tasted like it had been sitting in a freezer for ages – they're clearly not using good meat anymore. And that Messy Melt sauce I used to love? Ruined by some overly sweet tomato ketchup. It's just disappointing when a 1,000 birr burger tastes like something you'd get for 200 birr. Like I said, the magic's gone, and I just can't justify going back. Seriously, you're better off heading to Sishu or another place like that.

user_reviews.Name: The bmp
user_reviews.Description: Okay I regularly go to this burger place, but the service is the worst, it took them 50 minutes to get my order out when I ask why they said they were eating lunch!! And when my order came out the beef was burnt and it tasted sour, when I told them that they said they can’t do nothing about it!!

title: Inter Luxury Hotel
address: Kazanchis area, Guinea Conakry, Tito St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Elegant rooms & suites in a high-end hotel providing a rooftop terrace with a bar & a pool.

complete_address.street: Kazanchis area, Guinea Conakry, Tito St

user_reviews.Name: Jasper van de Pol
user_reviews.Description:
The decoration of the hotel lobby is very beautiful. Great bar lounge with nice live piano in the evening.
Kefale was a very nice waiter!
Also the guys at the pool were very proactive and friendly
Daniel made one of the best pizza I ever had. Special thanks to the cleaning Lady.(unfortunately I don’t know her name)

After a misunderstanding, hotel management did everything within their power to make sure the stay in the hotel was great!
Thank you “Inter Luxury”, Thank you Selam
We enjoyed and hope to see you again

user_reviews.Name: carolinekT3594JI
user_reviews.Description: Ibtruly enjoyed my stay in Inter Luxury Hotel. Addis Ababa. .The cleanliness in yhe rooms, ambience. The warm personalities of staff from.the entrance to rhe rooms was so welcoming. I felt at home with staff in the dining and reception. Particularly the Quern of Africa NIGIST was very helpful.  ||The prompt support of the electrician and technicians was appreciated ||I enjoyed the Span7sh  omlette and kindness of the chef. ||In all I would like to stay here again if I chancecto come to Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Naima H
user_reviews.Description:
We had a great stay at the hotel. The standard rooms were comfortable, clean, and well maintained, offering excellent value with all the amenities needed for a relaxing stay.

The service throughout the hotel was truly outstanding, warm, professional, and always attentive. A special mention goes to Kafale, who went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. His attention to detail, friendly attitude, and genuine care made our experience exceptional.

user_reviews.Name: Andrew Magunda
user_reviews.Description:
This place is a darling to stay at. Truly nice, clean, and hospital. The room service was also partularly excellent. R xeotion was also truly great.
Kefale Yayhe was hurtwarming. He also told offered me more information which helped me take more good decisions about my stay and the services available. Thank you so much.

user_reviews.Name: aydarus mohamad
user_reviews.Description: Myself and family had the best time in inter luxury hotel in addis ababa. The staff were kind and so supportive. The service were top notch. Unlimited breakfast, fresh and taste. Once again my family and i thank you selam . We highly recommend this hotel to our family and friends and The general public.

user_reviews.Name: draleruh
user_reviews.Description: Thank you so much for the excellent reception from the time I checked in and out. I would wish to appreciate the management and the entire team for this most especially the house attendants like Ayelu Tekalegn, Roamn Gardener, reception team not forgetting Sisay And Berry (Berihun) and the entire team, security, restaurant, door attendants. All the staff of the hotel, I can't mention you one by one. Accept my appreciation for the excellent services done. My you shine in this industry. Good bless you all till we meet again.

user_reviews.Name: fesehat
user_reviews.Description: This hotel has felt like home for me and my family for the past five years. Everyone—from the security and parking staff to the team inside—has always been incredibly kind and welcoming. They truly make us feel at home. I especially want to mention the lobby staff, including Daniet, who are always professional and very friendly.

user_reviews.Name: Haimanot Habtemariam
user_reviews.Description:
I was very pleased with how (Selam) the manger treated me with so much care and accommodation. The staff were amazing. The breakfast was delicious with various food. The bed was very comfortable. And my room was quite to my liking. The spa was so clean and spacious. The location is right in the center of everything.
Very pleased with everything.
I will definitely come back!

title: Simple Bistro | Bole | ሲምፕል ቢስትሮ | ቦሌ
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Simple Bistro | Bole | ሲምፕል ቢስትሮ | ቦሌ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Zaka
user_reviews.Description:
I recently tried their signature burger, the one that comes with pineapple, and overall it was a nice experience. The potatoes were surprisingly good—crispy on the outside and soft inside—with spices that added a really enjoyable flavor. I asked for mayonnaise on the side, but they mentioned it costs an additional 150 Birr, which I didn’t expect.

The burger itself is priced at 1,250 Birr. The presentation was appealing, and the combination of pineapple with the patty gives a unique twist. However, when it comes to the meat, the texture and taste felt quite ordinary. The cheese also didn’t stand out as anything special, so for this price, I expected a bit more depth in flavor and juiciness from the patty.

Overall, it’s a decent burger with great fries and nice seasoning, but the taste of the meat and cheese could be improved to match the premium price. Still worth trying if you like pineapple-style burgers or want something different.

user_reviews.Name: Ali Weber
user_reviews.Description:
This was my second visit, and while the portion sizes are generous, the food was quite difficult to eat. I ordered the double chicken junkie burger, and I remember being offered a knife the first time I came. However, this time the staff said they couldn’t provide one, which was disappointing.

It's quite hard to find a table(if you go there during peek hour), and the taste of the chicken (possibly due to the sauce) wasn’t great. Personally, I didn’t enjoy it, and I find their prices to be quite high.

Lastly, the parking situation wasn’t ideal either, but then again, it is Bole!

user_reviews.Name: Tiwild Amare
user_reviews.Description: I didn't even know that they had a vegan option but they did. It was an amazing pasta even better than most places that provide pasta as their main dish.10/10 customer service. It's a must try.

user_reviews.Name: Mike Antonio
user_reviews.Description: It's a great burger place. I like the taste very much. But recently they increased the price and decreased the portion of the burger. I used to be very full leaving after eating there. But now it's a different story.

user_reviews.Name: Dave Samuel
user_reviews.Description: I knew this place 5 years ago at the time of its opening and it’s a very famous burger place in the city, most people like their homemade BBQ sauce, but it has not had a unique taste for me, I advise you to no to go during lunchtime as well as dinner it's a bit crowded. As a recommendation, it would have been better if they had lettuce, onion and tomato inside their burger. I didn't rate the service because it's self-service. In terms of price, it is a bit costly for me.

user_reviews.Name: Kaleb Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description: Simple Bistro has decent food not bad at all, but nothing special either. I didn’t hate the taste, but I didn’t really enjoy it much. The main issue is the price; it feels too expensive for the quality you get. The burger especially is very basic and ordinary, not a high-standard one to match the cost. Overall, it’s okay, but not worth the price.

user_reviews.Name: Henok K.
user_reviews.Description: Every time I went to this place the taste of the burger is consistent. That was spicy and delicious. The atmosphere, the service was really nice. The staff were very friendly and helpful. And the prices were not expensive. The location is good and easily accessible.

user_reviews.Name: KEthiopia
user_reviews.Description:
un gusto da morire
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Simple Bistro has been an absolute gem since it opened its doors in 2016, and it’s no surprise why it’s still a local favorite! Every bite at this burger joint is pure perfection juicy, flavorful patties cooked to order, fresh toppings that pop with crispness, and buns that strike the ideal balance of soft and toasted. The vibe is cozy yet vibrant, with friendly staff who make you feel right at home. Whether you’re craving a classic cheeseburger or one of their creative specials, every dish is consistently bomb packed with bold flavors that keep you coming back. The fries?
