Crispy, golden, and addictive. Don’t even get me started on their house made sauces! Simple Bistro nails the art of a great burger experience, and it’s a must visit for anyone who loves good food done right. Keep slaying, Simple Bistro! 🍔🔥

title: SMASH BURGERS
address: 2Q2M+4H SMASH BURGERS, Namibia St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Nathnael Tekabe
user_reviews.Description:
I ordered a breakfast pita for delivery. Shortly after placing the order, they called me to say they were unfortunately out of pita bread. They asked if I would be okay with having the filling served on a burger bun instead, and I said yes.
I am so glad I agreed! The breakfast sandwich on the burger bun was absolutely delicious—I actually liked it better than the pita I usually get! The food was not disappointing at all.
Great service for calling me immediately about the substitution.
Suggestion to Management: The sandwich on the burger bun was so good, it should definitely come out as a permanent breakfast option.

user_reviews.Name: Elias Westman
user_reviews.Description: This is the go to burger place in Addis. The burgers are amazing and authentic and the prices are very good considering the quality of the food. The only problem with this place is that it’s very popular and it’s hard to find seating sometimes. Also sometimes you have to wait for a long time if there are a lot of people. But overall I love this place

user_reviews.Name: Elias Melaku
user_reviews.Description: This place has great burgers, really good flavors, really good sauces (or dips as they call them) and the portions are ok, not the best, but decent enough. The sausage burger and the malmo smash were really great. The place gets really crowded during lunch and dinner times though, and had to wait 10 minutes to get our table and upto an hour to get our food, so I'd recommend ordering in advance or potentially going for delivery or pickup.

user_reviews.Name: Ali Weber
user_reviews.Description:
This is definitely one of the more reliable burger joints in Addis and for good reason, they make a really good burger.

The place is almost always crowded, which is usually a sign of how popular it is. Just be prepared for a lively atmosphere. I did have one experience where they ran out of buns, but that only happened once out of my many visits.

Overall, if you're craving a quality burger and don't mind a bit of a crowd, this is a solid and dependable choice.

user_reviews.Name: Letera Asfaw
user_reviews.Description: I have no words for the burger, with out exaggerating it's my favorite burger spot so far in Addis. However, sometime when they are busy it tastes different and the order will take long to serve. I usually order prior.

user_reviews.Name: Shakir Khalaf
user_reviews.Description: A great tasty burger, Staff is Friendly, Service is quite slow but it is to be expected due to the popularity of this restaurant!

user_reviews.Name: Michael Getu
user_reviews.Description: Food for its price is really good but I face inconsistency at this place thats why its a 4/5. Service is average since theres few stuff for a lot of customers. Atmosphere is crowded and just not the thing you would go for when coming to this place.  The perks of this house is good burgers for average price.

user_reviews.Name: Yam fiseha
user_reviews.Description: Although the burgers are excellent, the service is poor; I am aware that it's quite busy still they can do better

title: Castelli's Restaurant | piasa | ካስትል ሬስቶራንት | ፒያሳ
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Castelli's Restaurant | piasa | ካስትል ሬስቶራንት | ፒያሳ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Israel Kebede
user_reviews.Description: I booked a table for two a day in advance for myself and my fiancé. They mixed up my booking, but they got us a table in less than five minutes. After being seated, I had to remind the waiter that we hadn't placed our order. We then waited an hour and fifteen minutes for our food to arrive. However, when the food was finally served and I took my first bite, all the inconveniences melted away. It was authentic Italian cuisine, like a plate from the heavens. Every moment of waiting was worth it. And We will definitely be back here.

user_reviews.Name: Morgan Dixon (The L & T MD)
user_reviews.Description: We came with a large group and they did the best they could to accommodate us without a reservation. The pasta was very fresh and the server at the table was attentive. We waited over an hour for our entrees. The front desk cashier/manager could be more kind and welcoming. Was hoping for better tasting Italian as it came highly recommended. Not terrible but not great. In a very busy, congested area. No parking.

user_reviews.Name: Cate Nyambura
user_reviews.Description:
This is a cozy Italian restaurant around the Adwa  Victory  memorial in Piassa. Quite a glorious sight driving in when we went as the fountain was on and there were crowds, which makes the place even more memorable and worth getting to.

We went there twice and there are a few highlights; the ambience is definitely that of an Italian restauarant, basic but quite aligned on how an Italian place should look like. First day we were walk-ins, but second day we had reservations. The foyer has photos of all VIPs who have patronized the restaurant, and there are plenty including Thabo Mbeki and Brad Pitt.🤗🤗

Food; I enjoyed the beef fillet  steak  with cream and mushrooms and the fettucinne pasta with truffle sauce, my partner also really enjoyed his fish. The salad was the worst ever and the french fries also horrid and we did not try dessert  So stick to the Italian cuisine I guess. Not much Italian wine stock which is disappointing, but it is what it is.

Service: fairly acceptable, but we had small issues like glass not being soo clean, and having to wipe, food handling as well might need some improvement. Service charge not included and the waiters remind you without fail.

Yes, I would still go back again and again!!!!

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Firdawok
user_reviews.Description: Best Italian food I’ve ever had would be here. The taste was so refreshing and so delicious I had no complaints. The ravioli literally gave me foodgasm, it was that good. I would definitely go again just to experience that once more. Everything else was good, nice service the atmosphere makes it feel in the old days and the food was top notch.

user_reviews.Name: M Tes
user_reviews.Description: Went to Castelli's because we heard they make their own pasta and was greeted by the least welcoming person in Ethiopia. We ordered calamari and roasted vegetables for appetizer. The roasted vegetables were great and we could have used marinara sauce with the calamari.  The rest of the food was bland and the stake was over cooked, but now we can say we had their pasta.  The servers seemed tense, but considering how we were welcomed, it may be the culture of the house.

user_reviews.Name: Bete Aberra
user_reviews.Description:
Castelli is an Italian restaurant. I had Linguine al Nero di Seppia which was amazing, I loved it! However, the Scaloppina al Vino was chewy, not so good. The dessert was Cassata which was nice. Overall I like the old look of the restaurant.
Price: for two dishes, one dessert, one glass of wine and water was 2050Birr.

user_reviews.Name: Chloe Jeong
user_reviews.Description:
Their food, they stick to the basics.
We tried three different pastas with truffle, gorgonzola, and ham. Homemade pasta, the pasta itself -noodle- is excellent and the cream sauce is bit too buttery for me to finish everything, but savory for sure.
Tried different Italian restaurants in Addis, this is the place for a creamy pasta:)

user_reviews.Name: Prajyoth Mirajkar
user_reviews.Description: Excellent Italian food and good service. For entree you can choose from a selection of salads and cold cuts then you can order a main from menu. Lots of vegan and vegetarian options.

title: Beta Burger 2
address: 3Q25+QQ2 Beta Burger 2, Haile Melekot St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: SR Firm
user_reviews.Description: I waited two hours to get my order. The waitresses prioritize men and will serve them before you even though you were there before them. Very horrible experience. They arenot willing to serve or listen.

user_reviews.Name: Hanna Nigussie
user_reviews.Description: Mistreatment by the servers also long wait hours for simple meals

user_reviews.Name: Ruhama Yohannes
user_reviews.Description: Bad service. I don't recommend. I WAITED HOURSSSSS.

title: Capital Grill
address: 2Q2J+J42 Capital Grill, 372 Cape Verde St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mistre Legesse
user_reviews.Description:
I’m soooo impressed with this place! The steaks were genuinely some of the best I’ve had in Addis, perfectly cooked and full of flavor. Even the sauces were rich and authentic with no shortcuts or substitutions. Service was exceptional, especially with Kebron as our server. He was attentive, professional and the right level of friendly. The ambience was cozy and elegant. For a fine dining experience, the prices were  reasonable. Overall, we were extremely pleased and will definitely be back!

Order: smoked nile perch ravioli, steak frites with béarnaise sauce, and truffle tenderloin

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: This grill spot is a gem! The food is absolutely delicious, and the interior is cozy yet stylish. The music vibe is chill and they are very flexible. Service is super polite and attentive makes you feel welcome. Perfect for hangouts or a casual date night. Definitely worth checking out!

user_reviews.Name: Bitania Geremew
user_reviews.Description: The food was amazing, the service was even better. We met a wonderful server named Kebron he needs a promotion asap. Loved the food, portion for the chicken might be a little small but the steak was great! Definitely recommend for a date night or dinner with friends.

user_reviews.Name: Eyob Abate
user_reviews.Description: I enjoyed the food and the service her and they have plenty of seating options both indoor and outside. The food was presented nicely a bit hesitant of the dessert menu but all in all very good experience

user_reviews.Name: Fatemeh Shahmirzaei
user_reviews.Description:
I do not recommend this restaurant at all. It was extremely overpriced, and the atmosphere was very dark and uninviting. We were celebrating a birthday and had brought our own cake, but they charged us around 800 Birr just for bringing it to the table. On top of that, the service charge and tax added up to 25%, which made everything even more expensive. The prices were already very high and The food was very average and the portions were quite small — it was not enough at all, even for one person.
Overall, it was a disappointing experience and not worth the price.

user_reviews.Name: Benhur Gebresellassie
user_reviews.Description: Talk about food, service & Atmosphere….. this place has it all. Top class everything. I give it 100/10. You will not be disappointed. Special thanks to Dagmawit & Kebron for taking care of me and my other half. Well done👏🏽

user_reviews.Name: LI LM
user_reviews.Description: We had wonderful dinner, I really love the food it’s Delicious with capital D also the sweet cocktail 👌🏽and the hospitality was everything they will make u to feel like a home , I would like to thank Mr Genetu he is so kind to help

user_reviews.Name: Lau Guiance
user_reviews.Description: It was a truly wonderful experience. We were in Addis for work, and we'll likely be coming back to the capital more often. We’ll definitely return as soon as we can! Everything was amazing — the overall experience, the delicious food, and the incredible service. We especially want to highlight Kebron’s professionalism, lovely taste, and beautiful smile. Thank you for everything!

title: GLAM HOTEL
address: 2QJ6+59F GLAM HOTEL, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Eyoel Woldearegay
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful stay at GLAM Hotel. The hotel is very clean and offers comfortable beds. It’s welcoming, friendly, thoughtful, and caring staff always blows your mind with the utmost prestigious customer service. The rooms are spacious and equipped with the standard amenities including a fast and reliable WiFi. The hotel is located at the center of the city known as Arat Kilo behind the city’s largest library Abrehot Library. The area is very safe 24/7 and ideal for both walking and cycling. Further, it is convenient for accessing the city public transport network; taxi/bus. Ride share transportation is accessible day and night. The location is very convenient for tourists as it is surrounded by plenty of cultural, historical and recreational sites like the Holy Trinity Cathedral, the National Museum of Ethiopia, Unity Park, Science Museum, the Ethnological Museum, Meskel Square, Yekatit 12 Martyrs Square, Friendship Park, the Adwa Victory Memorial Museum, the Menelik Palace, Meyazia 27 Square, Sheraton Addis, His Majesty King Haile Selassie Palace and so on. All of them are 5-15 minutes walking distance from the hotel. You could also access within a 20 minute drive Mercato, the largest open market in Africa, and Entoto Mountain, home to the historical Entoto St. Mariam Church and the recently opened Entoto Park that provides lots of adventurous activities. GLAM Hotel has also a cafeteria located at the reception floor and serves pastries, coffee, tea, water, beer and wine. There are plenty of restaurants very nearby with very good quality and affordable prices that serves the local Ethiopian dishes and other countries food. Most of them provide delivery service and could bring you whatever you crave.Room prices are affordable and meet the value of the service. Overall, I highly recommend this hotel for your travel adventure to Addis Ababa as a layover and/or extended stay.

user_reviews.Name: Pasqualina Giuseppe
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is center for both tourist and solo travelers. The staff are welcoming, there is a working elevator, and hot showers are available. It provides hot drinks, but no snacks or food. Unfortunately, the Wi-Fi is not working, the beds are uncomfortable, and there is construction noise. Additionally, some guests may find the staff to be too loud and present in guest room areas throughout the day and night.

user_reviews.Name: Allyson
user_reviews.Description: Staff was nice and helpful. Rooms are simple and nice but it was quite cold. WiFi doesn’t work well in our room but seems like it works in other rooms. There’s laundry service for good prices. Minor issues here and there but gets the job done. Good for short stays

user_reviews.Name: 千佳大
user_reviews.Description: There was some construction in front of the hotel so the path was a bit muddy, but the location was still super convenient and comfortable.|I wasn’t feeling my best at first—maybe from the altitude or just travel fatigue—but the clean and cozy room helped me recover and I felt much better during my stay.||The best part was definitely the staff. Everyone was so friendly and helpful, always happy to answer even small questions. They greeted me with a smile every time I went out and came back, which made me feel really relaxed and at home.||I’d love to stay here again!

user_reviews.Name: Frezer Zewdie
user_reviews.Description: The staff was so friendly and helpful! The food was absolutely delicious! Those pancakes in particular were unforgettable. The hotel is close to Ambassador mall and a lot of other enjoyable spots in the city, the library, the science museum and friendship park as well.... Aside from a few barking stray dogs in the neighborhood at night I really enjoyed my stay here... 5 ⭐

user_reviews.Name: Nils Borjesson
user_reviews.Description: Very nice staff. clean rooms with proper hot shower for a relaxing stay. Very affordable. Better quality than some 4star hotels I have stayed at before. Good food in the area.

user_reviews.Name: Shanx Omer
user_reviews.Description: I had a great stay at this hotel — it’s definitely excellent value for the price. The room was clean and comfortable, exactly what I needed. What really stood out to me was the front desk staff — the girls at reception were incredibly kind, helpful, and their English was excellent, which made everything so smooth. The food was also surprisingly good, with a nice variety and great taste. Overall, I was very satisfied and would happily stay here again.

user_reviews.Name: Nebyu Teshome
user_reviews.Description: Glam Hotel is a nice place to stay in Addis. They have very clean rooms with affordable price. The location is in 4 killo which is at the center of Addis and easy to access many areas like friendship park, unity park, national museum, shiro meda (cultural center of Addis), Entoto park, Adwa Museum  and others. I was very satisfied by the service from the hotel staffs. I highly recommend this place for those looking for a place to stay in Addis.

title: Tomatelli
address: Djibuti St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bethlehem Abera
user_reviews.Description: The restaurant was just okay, but it didn’t meet my expectations for a place specializing in pasta. They only had three pasta options, which felt limited. The fasting pesto was disappointing, but the non-fasting dish I ordered was fantastic. The place wasn’t very busy, and it operates on a self-service model. Overall, not a bad experience, but not impressive either.

user_reviews.Name: Hrvoje Petrovic
user_reviews.Description: We only try lasagne and it was really good. So my ratongs goes only for tjat kind of meal. Price is OK, and restaurant is on 1st floor. Toilets are clean.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Pasta place is pretty meh limited options and the taste is just okay went there for the spaghetti meatballs cause not much places have that but u will get just 3-4 meatballs thats it u cant add extra either just boring. Don’t expect much on the service front; it’s all self-serve, which feels a bit lazy. Atmosphere’s nothing special either. Not the worst, but definitely not a spot I’d rush back.

user_reviews.Name: Sam- Tar
user_reviews.Description:
Little Italian place, good pasta dishes.
Recommend the Ravioli with pink sauce it tasted great.

It’s a self service fast food place, so you order and pick up at the desk. Bit odd for a pasta place.

user_reviews.Name: Hilena Tafesse
user_reviews.Description: I really like the taste of the food. Very simple and delicious taste. The restaurant is has nice vibe too.

user_reviews.Name: Zina Abebe
user_reviews.Description: I'm a huge fan of their food, I can say the lasagna is one of the best in town, and the chicken cream was good!

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Kassa
user_reviews.Description: We had an early dinner, so the place was almost empty. Albeit the food took long. Its self service so there is no interaction with a waiter/waitress. We order penne with pomodoro and spaghetti with arrabiata. The pasta was not great. It was only ok. The pomodor sauce didn't have that tomato flavour and it was quite salty. Over the place was good, could be an option at times.

user_reviews.Name: Mussie Moss
user_reviews.Description: Food is ok the pasta is a bit uncooked portion is ok but price is redicilously high had a plain fasting tomato sauce pasta paid 850birr in my opinion price should be no more than 450 considering the current market and food quality

title: Ethiopian Ta'em Cultural Restaurant
address: XQQQ+6W7 Ethiopian Ta'em Cultural Restaurant, Airport Rd, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Yuen Yee Wan (YY)
user_reviews.Description:
We were transiting and had the buffet lunch here. There was a very large spread of traditional Ethiopian food.

Eden was very patient and explained the dishes to us so we weren’t overwhelmed. We got to try the famous raw beef dishes, and of course the different stews that are more mainstream back in the US where we’ve had Ethiopian food.

Everything was very tasty. Granted, we haven’t had much Ethiopian food before so this was easily the best Ethiopian food we’ve had 🤣 Would recommend trying this if you’re stopping over instead of the European buffet so you get a taste of the local cuisine!

The only strange thing was I think we were the only two people eating the lunch buffet for the whole lunch session. What happens to the rest of the food? 🤔

user_reviews.Name: Marianna Arkoulaki
user_reviews.Description:
I am a transit passenger staying at the Skylight Hotel.
I had dinner and tried the traditional food at the hotel’s traditional restaurant. The food was excellent, and the service was great.
Zelalem was very kind and friendly. I highly recommend it to everyone.

user_reviews.Name: 김진서
user_reviews.Description: It was rly good it was the best Ethiopian food I've ever had in my life! Yehwalashet was so nice and welcoming ! Definitely recommend to come here for the authentic Ethiopian experience

user_reviews.Name: Kellson Marcus
user_reviews.Description:
I was pleasantly surprised with my visit to the restaurant. The space is extremely well decorated with nods to Ethiopia's rich culture and history. The food was simply divine, I ordered one of the "Non-Fasting" platters, and it didn't disappoint. The portion sizes are very generous, and it could have easily fed more than one person. During my visit, there were musical and dance presentations that also furthered my experience and the enjoyment of all people there.

This is definitely one of the best restaurants I have ever been to, and I'll make sure to pay another visit in the future.

user_reviews.Name: Juan Fernandez
user_reviews.Description: Just tried it tonight while in transit. Excellent food and ambience. Highly recommended for Ethiopian food

user_reviews.Name: Harold Gray
user_reviews.Description: Amazing food and staff! Eden and Daniel S. Provided exceptional customer service.  Best food I had during my visit!

user_reviews.Name: Scott Forler
user_reviews.Description: Excellent choice of traditional Ethiopian food. Particularly good attention by my server, Zelalem.

user_reviews.Name: Eyerusalem Kebede
user_reviews.Description:
Two years ago, my family and I had a wonderful experience at Cultural Ta'em Restaurant during our small wedding ceremony. The food and service exceeded our expectations, and we were hoping to relive that same quality this year.
While we were happy to see the restaurant had moved to a new location, unfortunately, our recent visit was disappointing. The food quality had noticeably declined, and the staff seemed inattentive, rarely checking in or offering assistance. We were also surprised to find there was no cultural band, which was part of the charm during our previous visit.
When we asked for dessert, the response was dismissive — we were told they would serve it "if we badly needed it," which left us feeling unwelcome. In the end, we decided to skip it altogether.
Overall, the experience this time did not live up to the standard we remembered. We hope the management considers this feedback seriously to improve the quality and service in the future.

title: Dagim Nega bar & restaurant
address: Bole 4/6, 7, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Lotus Wellness
user_reviews.Description: They are serving Goat roasted meat or raw if you want to eat in gm. In plates they are serving sheep's meat. Location is OK & Service is very good.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: Have been here a few times for tibs )goat meat), but have also tasted the Kitfo. All good and tasty. It also has a lively bar that was vibrant all the times I was there. Would definitely be going.

title: Tesfa Coffee | ተስፋ ቡና | 5 kilo
address: https://maps.app.goo.gl/fYqt2kdHqdvg7BRb7, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Pooja Patel
user_reviews.Description: Cute, quiet, local coffee shop close to the National Museum of Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Thomas Doughty
user_reviews.Description:
The best coffee I had in Addis, and in a wonderful and authentic coffee ceremony atmosphere, and at a really good price. Popular with locals as much as with tourists. The staff are all lovely, and the founder Tesfa was great company and conversation - he happened to be there each morning.
I had my morning coffee here every day while I was in Addis, and I will be heading straight here next time I visit.

user_reviews.Name: Agnieszka Wawreszuk
user_reviews.Description: Amazing coffee and great atmosphere. We bought few kilograms of their delicious coffee and came every morning during our last 3 days in Addis. Strongly recommended! 😊

user_reviews.Name: Corey Fredericks
user_reviews.Description: I had an amazing time at Tesfa Coffee! This was my first time trying Ethiopian coffee and it was the best coffee I’ve had as a coffee lover! The owner of the shop was so kind and interpersonal and went above and beyond to make sure I enjoyed my first Ethiopian coffee experience. He even went above and beyond to let me try a new roast! Anytime I am back in Addis Ababa Tesfa Coffee is a must!!!

user_reviews.Name: Martin
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely love this place. It’s a little cute traditional cafe with really nice staff and atmosphere. We were lucky to meet the owner who was so welcoming and nice to us. It’s a walk distance from the National museum. 10/10. Hope to be back soon 😊

user_reviews.Name: Connie O'Dell
user_reviews.Description: Lovely coffee/breakfast spot so close to the National Museum!  They created a memorable coffee experience, and the owner was very helpful and kind.  The atmosphere was fun, and the coffees (we loved both traditional and macchiato) were very reasonably priced.  We also had a breakfasty dish, with eggs, flat bread, onions, honey, and optional spicy peppers, so yummy!

user_reviews.Name: Noëmi Liebe
user_reviews.Description: Really wonderful place with delicious coffee, a nice atmosphere and friendly staff & owner. Will definitely come back.

user_reviews.Name: Eli Kaufman
user_reviews.Description: Super delicious and friendly service and a pleasure to meet Mr. Tesfa himself.

title: The Goat🐐 Cafè | Mexico
address: 2P6W+RXC The Goat🐐 Cafè | Mexico, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mikiyas Melkamu
user_reviews.Description: Goat Cafe is a charming and cozy spot that exudes a distinct hippie vibe. The decor is eclectic and inviting, with colorful tapestries adorning the walls and cozy seating arrangements that make you feel right at home. The cafe has a unique aroma that's hard to miss - the smell of burning egg. While it may not be everyone's cup of tea, it adds to the overall ambiance of the place and gives it a distinct character. The menu at Goat Cafe is diverse and offers a range of options for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The food is fresh, flavorful, and reasonably priced, making it a great spot for a casual meal with friends or family. Overall, 🐐  Cafe is a must-visit for anyone looking for a laid-back and unique dining experience.

user_reviews.Name: Alazar.M Mekonen
user_reviews.Description: A nice little place to chill with your friends. The food is decent, but the price is a little bit above average.

user_reviews.Name: Mohammedkabir Dawud Mohammed
user_reviews.Description: The Goat Café 2 is a fantastic spot for coffee and relaxation. The ambiance is modern and cozy, making it perfect for catching up with friends or enjoying some quiet time. The coffee is rich and flavorful, and the menu offers a good variety of snacks and beverages. Highly recommended for coffee lovers looking for a great experience!

user_reviews.Name: Feril Chitalia
user_reviews.Description:
It's inside creative hub Ethiopia
I have passed through the street of Mexico so many times but did not know they have GOAT cafe here.
It's right in front of Wabe shabelle  Hotel.
Good place to have a meeting along with coffee and a quick snack.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: Small cafe at the heart of Senga Tera.  I only came here for tea after 8:30 AM so that may be a reason for the place being empty.  It does provide a range of foods too, although I haven’t had anything to eat when I went there.

user_reviews.Name: Hayu Abubeker
user_reviews.Description: I used to order club sandwich 🥪 every whenever I go there but today i tried their breakfast menu. I ordered french toast with strawberry classic. It was worthy. The taste of the toast was delicious. Try it

user_reviews.Name: Ermias Alemayehu
user_reviews.Description: I really liked their menu at "The Goat Cafe". My only comment on them is regarding their service, If the team can get the proper training, I guarantee it will be the greatest like its name. 🐐

user_reviews.Name: Nardos Bisrat
user_reviews.Description: I ordered goat loaded fries and i got a wrong one, the food came after an hour and a half and it wasn't worthy it was just chips with some sauces.

title: Keba Guest House (INN)
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Anthony Bolton
user_reviews.Description: I highly recommend staying at Keba Guest House. For the price this place over exceeded my expectations. It was clean, quiet and relaxing. The Host along with the hostesses was very kind and provided great service. The food was amazing and I just couldn't believe how incredibly they accommodated me. That is a place that I will be definitely going back to when I go back to Addis Ababa Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Arone Tamene
user_reviews.Description: Very nice hotel and I will really love it. I highly recommend to anyone who is going to addis!

user_reviews.Name: NC
user_reviews.Description: The staff was very friendly and accommodating. They were very helpful in terms of helping arrange taxis and giving advice about the city. The food was great as well. The wide view of the city from my balcony was nice.

user_reviews.Name: Kk Kk
user_reviews.Description: Oh its gorgeous hotel I have been to and it has nice rooms,good service and friendly stuffs ,it has restaurant you can order food and there is  kitchen you can cook your own food.

user_reviews.Name: Admas Kebede
user_reviews.Description: Great team with great amenities. Definitely recommend staying here if you are looking for a cosy place to stay in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Jarso Gedecho
user_reviews.Description: Very excellent iam hapy

user_reviews.Name: Ahmed adam
user_reviews.Description: It was à good place to live and stuffs were so kind and helpful,So friendly stuffs

user_reviews.Name: Queeneth Obobaifo
user_reviews.Description: Ethiopians are hospitable

title: Hilton Addis Ababa
address: Menelik II Ave, Addis Ababa 1164, Ethiopia
description: Airy quarters, some with mountain views, in a premium hotel offering 3 eateries & a geothermal pool.

user_reviews.Name: Yonas Isaak Tekle
user_reviews.Description:
Hilton Addis Ababa is an amazing place to stay and relax. It is a historic property that beautifully blends rich tradition with modern facilities. I had a wonderful stay and highly recommend it. All the staff I have had an opportunity to interact with were amazing but I would also like to give a special shout-out to Dawit Fikade, Alemayehu T. Markos, Hailu Abreham and Jerry Gedamu, who hosted me at the breakfast restaurant. They treated me like a family member and attended to all my needs. Their professionalism and kindness go beyond words.
In addition, I had access to the Executive Lounge and the opportunity to experience exquisite dining on the top floor, featuring breathtaking views and delicious food. The staff there, including Bizu Getahun and Tensaiy Seyoum as well as Hanna from executive lounge operator, were outstanding in their service and exceptional care.
I am truly grateful for the warmth, attention, and exceptional service I received from these individuals. Thank you for making my stay so memorable!

user_reviews.Name: Fanuel Teklegiorgis
user_reviews.Description:
At Hilton Addis Ababa and was truly impressed by the overall quality of service, comfort, and hospitality. The hotel offers a relaxing atmosphere, well-maintained facilities, and a sense of professionalism that makes every stay enjoyable.

A special shout-out to the Gazebo team, whose service was consistently excellent throughout my stay. Tarik, Bereket, and Berkayew deserve particular recognition for their attentiveness, warmth, and dedication. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, always serving with a smile and genuine care. Their constant presence and professionalism made a real difference and elevated the entire experience.

Hilton Addis Ababa is a place where you truly feel valued as a guest. Thanks to the outstanding Gazebo service team.

user_reviews.Name: Karolina Pearl
user_reviews.Description:
I had an excellent 10-day stay at the Hilton Addis Ababa. The highlight of my experience was the incredible staff, especially during breakfast every morning. They consistently went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and well taken care of. Their warm hospitality, kindness, and attention to detail truly made our stay unforgettable. 🩵💙💜

Thank you to the wonderful breakfast team—you made our mornings so much brighter. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Heyab Addisu
user_reviews.Description:
I regularly come to Hilton’s Gazebo Restaurant, and every visit is consistently amazing. From the moment I walk in, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff always make me feel at home. Samuel, the manager, is truly outstanding, he’s  friendly, attentive, and genuinely cares about the guests, which makes a huge difference.

The food is the main reason I keep coming back.  Both Chef Fikadu and Dereje are incredibly talented. Their pizza is to die for, easily one of the best I’ve had, and the steaks are always cooked to perfection,  juicy, flavorful, and unforgettable. You can really taste the passion they put into every dish.

Great food, great people, and consistently great service. I’ll definitely keep coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Yohana Wondesen
user_reviews.Description: I want to express my sincere appreciation for Sefenech Mekbib, who made my experience at Hilton truly exceptional. As an Arab guest, I sometimes struggle to communicate clearly, but her Arabic language skills made everything so much easier and more comfortable for me. She was incredibly polite, professional, and helpful throughout my entire stay. Her warm attitude and dedication to great service really stood out. Hilton is truly lucky to have her on their team. Thank you so much for your outstanding hospitality.

user_reviews.Name: pngufor
user_reviews.Description: I came for some tennis and then sat in the restaurant next to the pool after for a drink and some snacks. Very good portions and the avocado salad/tapas was very fresh. The manager Abraham made it a point to come make sure I was ok as I was on my own and explained a few things to me about Ethiopian food. The assistant manager Gete was also very pleasant and this is a nice place to chill and enjoy some good food

user_reviews.Name: Diana Yvonne
user_reviews.Description:
The hotel is very nice , I have enjoyed the wide breakfast selection, the staff is very friendly and ready to help,  the pastry corner is literal heaven , shoutout to the Baker.

The rooms are clean and comfy beds, although we really needed some shower slippers.

Alex has a passion for his job.

The entire team made our Christmas holiday worth it !

God bless Ethiopia.

Merci.

user_reviews.Name: Nebyat Million
user_reviews.Description:
I am not a guest at Hilton Hotel but I am a member of Hilton's remarkable and intriguing gym.
While working out at the gym, I am always impressed by the diligence and responsiveness of the gym attendants and the remarkable recreational manager named Meklit Keflie is a person with an exceptional leadership experience and ability . Her professionalism, kindness, and hospitality have improved the hotel's service profoundly.
Meklit Keflie is always visible around the recreational area checking everything and ensuring everyone is doing good. She always listens to everybody's compliance politely and with patience. When a small issue cones up, she handles it personally and professionally striving to fix it immediately. She is constantly demonstrating outstanding leadership, ensuring both guests and staffs feel valued and supported inorder to ensure smooth flow of operations.

The other person that I can not help noticing while I am at the gym is a guy named Biruk Shewadeg. Every time I see him, he is always working voluntarily and happily to keep the fitness area exceptionally clean, organized, and well-stocked with towels and water.
Biruk Shewadeg is always friendly, polite, welcoming and attentive, making sure guests have everything they need and the equipments are in perfect working order.
Whether it is cleaning equipments, assisting guests, or supporting staff, Biruk handles every task with professionalism and enthusiasm.
His welcoming attitude and attention for details makes us to feel at home and our workout enjoyable.

Nebyat from Hilton gym.

title: Denver Boutique Hotel
address: Denver Tower, Arat Kilo, Adawa st, Woreda-9, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: Denver Tower, Arat Kilo, Adawa st, Woreda-9

user_reviews.Name: Booking.com
user_reviews.Description:
😊: Great value for money & an excellent location.
 Staff were very friendly & helpful. The manager Stephanous was so good , he even made time to have a coffee with me & discuss life in Ethiopia.
Thank you Stephanous.
 Steve from New Zealand ( not Czech ).
😢: Nothing.

user_reviews.Name: olalao2023
user_reviews.Description: I used to frequent this hotel because it was cheap and in arat kilo. It was dingy and they had roaches but the people were nice. The relationship changed when we booked a room and the jacuzzi pool was broken and leaked all over the bathroom floor. We complained about it to the receptionist (she has a mole on her chin and looks like a witch) and she said she’d send maintenance. A few minutes later, the security guard (who I’m very familiar with) pretending to be maintenance, finally arrived. He tapped a few parts of the tub and told us that maintenance would come the next day.||We didn’t stay there again but continued to get laundry done there. The prices rose rapidly from one week to the next. I expressed concern but continued to get it done there.|Today, my husband and father picked up my laundry and approached the same witch-looking receptionist with the mole and she spoke negatively of me when trying to describe me, to find my luggage (although she also knows my husband as well). The place is truly run down and only worth it if their rates are low and if that witch-looking lady is no longer working there and they put true, joyful spirits at that desk (which is most of the staff). I wanted to write this review for a while but decided not to since I love supporting Ethiopian businesses, but the mole-lady is truly an awful person.

user_reviews.Name: Devin
user_reviews.Description: Just finished a 6 night stay here and was happy with the experience. The staff is all friendly and housekeeping does a great job with keeping the rooms clean. The location is within walking distance of the National Museum and there are a couple decent burger spots close by. They also offer a complimentary shuttle to/from the airport which was incredibly helpful for the first time visiting to the city. Overall, it’s a great budget option for Addis and I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

user_reviews.Name: MariaWGermany
user_reviews.Description: We deliberately chose this hotel in the more traditional part of Addis away from the modern hustle and hotels and can only highly recommend it. The rooms are spacious and very clean. Service is excellent and friendly. The airport transfers all worked out with no problem. Our plans changed surprisingly and we had no problems returning to the hotel were offered a room again. Breakfast is buffet style local foods hot and cold. The hotel has a restaurant offering local and foreign Foods for a slightly higher price than outside places. A very good place to stay in downtown Addis Ababa!

user_reviews.Name: binulaw
user_reviews.Description: Our favourite hotel from our 1 month travel in Ethiopia. We stayed here on two separate occasions, five nights in total. The hotel, its rooms and bathrooms are modern, clean, tidy and spacious. The staff were a highlight - going beyond their duty in ensuring we had a comfortable stay. They once turned on the generator so we could get the lift up to the 7th floor during a power outage! They also made the effort to ensure we were able to pay with a credit card. ||The hotel is also located conveniently near a medium sized road - not too busy to cause noise issues and not too small to be dangerous at night.||The included breakfast has a good range of food - good mix of local food (fir fir was a regular) and continental breakfast options (eggs, toast, jam, peanut butter) and juices (watermelon, papaya, lemon). The restaurant is also fairly priced and open till 01:00am, convenient for a quick meal if required - admittedly we didn’t use the restaurant for this though.||The hotel is also excellent value for its price.||Overall, very satisfied with our long stay here and would definitely be staying back here again if we return to Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: Nathe
user_reviews.Description: The price is relatively fair. WiFi doesn't work at all like speed is 1mbps when measured with speedometers. There is no air conditioning, the walls are dirty, and the curtain is not adjustable. They have broken fans and lamps. No soaps and toiletries in the bathrooms. in case u need a one night stand it might be ok.

user_reviews.Name: Tigerlileeee
user_reviews.Description: They advertise free breakfast. There is none. They advertise a bar. There is none. they advertise free shuttle to and from the airport. There were two of us flying in at two different times and they refused pick up of the second person even though they were not dropping either of us off. They were late even to pick up the one person. It was stiflingly hot in the room. The refrigerator did not work. They advertise toiletries and there was only soap The photos are terribly misleading. When we approached the owner of these multiple discrepancies, he said it wasn’t his fault because he didn’t control his own website.  (?!) The only saving grace was the comfortability of the beds. Highly recommend looking elsewhere.

user_reviews.Name: Surafel Luleseged
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed for 6 nights November 2020. Good hotel but when I arrive the room is not ready, no toiletries, bathroom pack (like soap, soft paper etc) I had to call reception to get a soap and buy my soft paper for my stay. The shampo was used, half full. Well under my expectations. Given that it is pandemic time, I was expecting more cleanness. Getting a blanket was also not easy, it was very cold at night (no blanket in the room and the reception gave me nothing close to a blanket)
The good side is friendly staffs and owner, very secure with card activated lifts....

title: North Addis International Hotel | Chilot | ኖርዝ አዲስ ኢንተርናሽናል ሆቴል | ችሎት
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: North Addis International Hotel | Chilot | ኖርዝ አዲስ ኢንተርናሽናል ሆቴል | ችሎት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Cabdiraxmaan Xuseen
user_reviews.Description:
North Addis International Hotel is very quiet and also has an amazing peace environment. Between January 02, 2024, and January 09, 2024, my wife and I were there. The hotel's staff is extremely helpful and friendly. Following that, I would like to point out that the cost of the food is slightly higher than the rates we paid for the hotels we stayed at last year.

Furthermore, as happened to me today, you will only receive a one-time airport shuttle; other times you will have to pay money, like today, when I gave the hotel 500 ETB to go to the airport. You need to agree with them to come and go to the airport. You can also try a Ride Taxi, which is cheaper and also more convenient.

Thank you, all the best.

Abdirahman Hussein

user_reviews.Name: Abdul-Salaam Oseni
user_reviews.Description: Hands down my best hotel experience ever! When I was about to leave, I got a few snacks because I had just little money left and didn’t want to change more. I kept fearing the snacks won’t suffice and I’d have gastric pains because my trip was by midnight but out of nowhere the manager orders the kitchen staff to give me a complimentary meal which was a big lifesaver. That’s exactly how the hotel is run, they treat their customers very dearly and the staff are the absolute best! Thank you so much for this experience, y’all should definitely definitely check it out!

user_reviews.Name: AbroadDee
user_reviews.Description: The room was clean, tidy and neat. It had a large window which meant plenty of daylight. The double bed was very comfortable and clean, I loved that. The bathroom was fair size for me too. ||||All the staff were friendly especially the ladies on the reception which gave good advice and guidance to the driver I was using to see the city. The food was delicious-compliments to the chef. The home made tomatoe soup especially which I had nearly every day...The waitresess too were fabulous, helpful and always served with a smile :)||||Just like to add, that if you do get a chance to visit Addis Ababa, check out the seasons before you travel. I travelled during the rainy season and although I managed to get around and see things and learn a heck of a lot...Beware of the thunderstorms, thunder and lighting etc, etc....You don't want to get caught out. Raincoat, Mac is defo advisable.||||Also if you have never been to this part of the world...power cuts can and do happen. No point in losing your rag with staff. This is Africa after all and it is better to know that and not travel with to many expectations..which people occasionally do.

user_reviews.Name: 4747tnt
user_reviews.Description: They do airport pick up and delivery with a few days stay. Being off of the main streets gave us a feel of how the locals live and yet minutes of all of the sites. The rooms vary in sizes yet every room is clean and with a refrigerator. Let the staff get to know you and they will bend over backwards to make sure of your every comfort. The breakfasts are fabulous with traditional dishes as well as for the European taste. Addis Ababa is the center of every direction in Ethiopia so after visiting the South, this is a perfect, inexpensive place to regroup. We stayed here 3 different times for 6 or more days and ate dinner here every night. We knew that the food was good, clean and safe to enjoy with a beer. We had some booking problems and they stepped in to make sure that we were okay. One was our return trip to the US from Khartoum and the Hugh problem we had getting our transit visa and the overnight bus ticket while we were in the North. We appreciated all the personal attention that they gave to us.||The Big bonus of this hotel is Isreal, the owner of East Africa Eco Tours. Do take his tours. We had Fish as our guide in Omo to visit all the tribes and rented the car and driver to the North. At the end of this trip we had over paid and Isreal worked out a way to reimburse us after we returned to the US. We cannot say enough for such honesty.||You will be in good hands with this combination to insure a fabulous, unforgatible trip.

user_reviews.Name: Eric Godec
user_reviews.Description: I have read previous reviews. I have stayed a few times and never any problems. The staff is great and helpful, even remembered my name after one year. The hotel is not bad and currently they are renovating. Keep in mind in Ethiopia power does go out, even water sometimes, but hotel has backup power on site. Please if you are not happy with something see the daytime staff, they will do their best to remedy the situation. Just because you do not see something does not mean they do not have it, ask them. The hotel will also pickup and drop you at airport. I will definitely stay again

user_reviews.Name: belten
user_reviews.Description: i was stay 3 night in north addis the staff was vary fraind and the room was confort  rasaurant is varry clean They do airport pick up and delivery with a few days stay. Being off of the main streets gave us a feel of how the locals live and yet minutes of all of the sites. The rooms vary in sizes yet every room is clean and with a refrigerator. Let the staff get to know you and they will bend over backwards to make sure of your every comfort. The breakfasts are fabulous with traditiona and varry nice i relly happy

user_reviews.Name: 983patriciao
user_reviews.Description: I stayed here for three nights and found this hotel to be very nice. It was more then my expections as the price was very reasonable (hostel rates). I had a free breakfast and wifi. I also got the free courtesy bus very early to the airport. The coffee was excellent in the cafe and the meals in the restaurant were enjoyable even when there was a blackout. Staff came around with candles. I highly recommend this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Scott Dusek
user_reviews.Description: The staff at this hotel are absolutely amazing. They are both friendly and helpful. We loved the location as it is in a quieter area that allowed us to see a bit or real life in Ethiopia but still an easy walk or cheap taxi to the main attractions of Addis Ababa. We ended up staying a few extra days because it was so comfortable (great bed!) and the food at their restaurant was great.

title: Soramba Hotel and Wellness Center | Piazza | ሶራምባ ሆቴል | ፒያሳ
address: 2QR2+69M Soramba Hotel and Wellness Center | Piazza | ሶራምባ ሆቴል | ፒያሳ, A3, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Warm rooms in an informal hotel with a spa area, a fitness room & a rustic restaurant.

owner.name: Soramba Hotel and Wellness Center | Piazza | ሶራምባ ሆቴል | ፒያሳ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Hareg Y A
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed at this hotel for 20 days, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish. The customer service was exceptional — every staff member I met was friendly, professional, and always ready to help with a smile.

The food was amazing, especially the breakfast, which was included and offered a great variety of delicious options each morning. The gym was well-equipped and perfect for keeping up with my fitness routine during my stay.
Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The staff truly made me feel at home. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for great service, comfort, and quality in every detail!

user_reviews.Name: Gezahgn Demelash Ejigu
user_reviews.Description:
I have stayed at this hotel four times, solely because of its convenient location and good room prices. However, my most recent stay has convinced me I will not be returning.

While the laundry service is excellent and the security guards are friendly and professional, the overall service is the worst I've experienced in Addis Ababa. The staff at reception and the waiters are consistently arrogant and unhelpful. Furthermore, the breakfast is of very poor quality.

Unfortunately, the bad service and amenities far outweigh the good price. I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone.

user_reviews.Name: Wander43273731653
user_reviews.Description: I  enjoyed my stay at Soramba Hotel in  Addis during my recent visit to Ethiopia. Soramba is indeed an exceptional hotel managed by professionally well qualified and extremely dedicated and caring staff. It is a fabulous place to stay be it for business or pleasure. A professionally trained hotel staff is ready to give you exceptional hospitality with a great customer friendly attitude. The management staff is on every floor of the hotel to make sure the hotel is operating smoothly. One other thing, Soramba Hotel  has one of the strongest and most reliable internet connectivity in town, amazing ! I was impressed with the complete fully equipped state of the art fitness center with sophisticated modern engineering design. It is really fun to workout there. The hotel must be proud of its resort style amenities, it is a great vacation spot. Soramba has also a special cultural restaurant where authentic traditional Ethiopian food is served, I am definitely going back !

user_reviews.Name: Godwin Bonge Muhwezi
user_reviews.Description: I had a brief overlay courtesy of Ethiopian Airlines for a connecting flight. The beds were not comfortable. Although located on the main road it was next to slums in Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: Yohannes Tesefaye
user_reviews.Description:
Outstanding Facilities – The pool, spa, and gym were top-notch. Loved the traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony in the lobby!
Delicious Food – The breakfast buffet had a mix of international and local dishes—the injera and kitefo were delicious.

user_reviews.Name: Sharon Chepkoech
user_reviews.Description: I didn't like the services at all .had bad experience. Wouldn't recommend, rude staff

user_reviews.Name: Chris P
user_reviews.Description: Didn't stay, but live in the area and use the restaurant regularly. The food is divine, restaurant service perfect, I am always delighted. Only disappointment is the cashier trying to short-change you at the end, which leaves a bad feeling as you leave. Check your change. (If management wish to follow up, I had this treatment 23rd May evening.)

user_reviews.Name: Gloria Dick Udoh
user_reviews.Description: Hotel looks good however there were details that are suppose to have been checked in the room before handing out to a guest. The intercom wasn't working hence you would have to go down to the reception if you need anything and also the front desk staff had to come knocking to inform us about breakfast instead of using the intercom. The telephone shower was leaking splashing water   everywhere when bathing. The hand dryer wasn't working, couldn't use it . The smoke detector was missing from the room although the base was there but must have been taken out when it was faulty and wasn't returned back. This is for Room 403. The food and service at the restaurant was excellent, they were able to provide quality breakfast as early as 0521am to those leaving at 06am.

title: Semien Hotel
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Relaxed hotel offering a restaurant, a gym & a sauna, plus simple quarters with balconies.

user_reviews.Name: Jerusalem Agonafer
user_reviews.Description: I truly appreciate the  service at Semien Hotel! The staff are friendly, attentive, and always make you feel welcome. The food is absolutely delicious, freshly prepared, and served with care—and the prices are very affordable. The General Manager is also very supportive and ensures that everything runs smoothly, which really makes a difference. Semien Hotel is a place I would highly recommend, both for families and for anyone looking to enjoy a fresh and tasty lunch in a warm and comfortable atmosphere.

user_reviews.Name: Mohamed M.Qawdhan
user_reviews.Description: I was stay 16 days with semien hotel and it's was very well and appreciate

user_reviews.Name: yaredw
user_reviews.Description: Rooms are okay for the price. Good service. Their breakfast is better than similar hotels in Addis. Service is good. Very friendly and cooperative staff. They to have good Wi-Fi. But they removed the routers from every floor. For more than a month no Wi-Fi.

user_reviews.Name: ValerieS363
user_reviews.Description: Stayed there twice over a two year period of time with mission group from church. Rooms were adequate and we appreciated the cleanliness, flush toilets and hot showers. ||||Towels are thin, so bring your own if you want the thick ones you may have at home.||||Rooms are small, but this isn't a place you spend much time in your room.||||Restaurant downstairs has full and good menu. Hot buffet breakfast everyday, however many items are not suited for American GI tracts since they are washed in Ethiopian water not bottled water. There are many choices of broiled, grilled, baked or boiled items for lunch and dinner. Hard boiled eggs available every morning, as well as hot tea and coffee. Hot tomato soup with croutons was especially good as well as spaghetti. ||||Macchiato available in lounge. Bottled water readily available||||Reception staff will change dollars for you.||||Massages are available in small room downstairs and are quite good, though I wouldn't actually call it a "spa". ||||Inexpensive hotel. If you want a better/ business hotel by American standards, go to Sheraton in Addis Ababa instead, but price will be significantly higher. The Semien has personality and is down to earth.

user_reviews.Name: dukie01
user_reviews.Description: I stayed for four nights here and had a decent experience.  If you have other options (are willing to pay more), you can do better, but for the price it's about what I expected.  The wifi was elusive, even in the lobby sometimes.  The room itself was spartan, with an adequate bed and a small tv.  The hotel's age showed in the fact that all of the electrical outlets were protruding from the concrete walls.  It also got pretty cold at night, but there were extra blankets provided.  Shower, bathroom, and housekeeping--no complaints.  ||||While the hotel does have credit card machines, they weren't working while I was there.  It sounds like this has been true for others, either because the connection is unreliable, or because they cheat the exchange rate in asking for cash (my total bill was ~$192 when converted from birr, but they asked for $200 USD, new bills only).  There is an ATM just outside the hotel though, so that could have been avoided.  One other off-putting moment was when the inside door knob/lever broke clean off of the door my first morning.  Thankfully I had the door open already, and thankfully it was replaced with a stronger model by the end of the day.||||On the bright side, Semien is very well-staffed for a smaller hotel--from the desk to the bar, the restaurant, and the front door.  I'm a bit skeptical about the claim of 24-hour room service, but there are definitely folks around the lobby 24 hours in case anything comes up.  Staff were generally cheery, and the level of English spoken varied from person to person.  The breakfast buffet was above average (with injera!), but I might avoid the dinner buffet and order a-la-carte if eating dinner there.

user_reviews.Name: 722DavidL722
user_reviews.Description: First experience at lunch buffet and no complaints. Good service, plenty of variety to choose from; salads to start followed by hot dishes and fruit to finish. Reasonable fixed price. I had never been before but will definitely go again. Helpful parking.

user_reviews.Name: hassaneini2019
user_reviews.Description: Good Hotel with small but clean single rooms with hot water.||The Wi-Fi worked in my room and I had a tv with few international channels ||The food is very nice even if you try the local dishes ,, I really like it ||The only thing I could not understand when they asked to keep my passport in the reception till my checking out ! I could not understand why as it’s my first time to face this request !

user_reviews.Name: Jason4hr
user_reviews.Description: I stayed for 4 days.  The price is reasonable for Addis Ababa - USD 50/night for a single room with breakfast.  I was on the street side, so it can be a bit noisy.  I would agree that it is a bit run down...but the rooms are clean, I had running hot water and getting laundry done was relatively inexpensive.  I tried the wifi, which didn't work.

title: Monarch Parkview Hotel
address: 2QG3+MM Monarch Parkview Hotel, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Relaxed quarters in a polished hotel featuring a rooftop bar & a French restaurant, plus a spa.

user_reviews.Name: mohamedhG5950JJ
user_reviews.Description: I stayed for a week in monarch.  It was an outstanding experience.  The staff.  The front desk was very helpful.  And the room was clean and they gave me a very nice view.  The staff is friendly beyond expectations. And thr breakfast is delicious everyday sometimes different.  Compliments to the chef . also that floor manager  mr.joseph dereje .He always comes and check on me and ask if i needed anything . |I really enjoyed my stay there

user_reviews.Name: jibe2019
user_reviews.Description: Rooms are perfect. Very clean and spacious. Restaurant on the Roof-top is a must for any customers and golden youth from Addis.|À spécial thanks to Kassawmar (room service) and Josef (manager) for there dedication. But the whole team is very efficient and welcoming !

user_reviews.Name: Charles Gyamfi Ofori
user_reviews.Description: It's not your typical five star accomodation facility. But it's well manageable. Staff are friendly and room is quite comfy. Although it doesn't have an AC because Ethiopia is generally cold. You request for one but it may not come and you'll get used to the room afterwards..at least it happened to me. Food is relatively okay depending on your taste.

user_reviews.Name: mohammedsA3073PN
user_reviews.Description: Breakfast was definitely a highlight of my stay and that’s mostly thanks to Yoseph He was incredibly friendly, attentive, and always made sure everyone felt welcome and taken care of. His positive attitude and great service really stood out. Big thanks to Yoseph and the whole breakfast team for starting each day with a smile.

user_reviews.Name: Sally Mburu
user_reviews.Description:
I  recently had the pleasure of staying at this hotel, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience from start to finish! The food was absolutely delicious, and the staff went above and beyond to ensure our needs were met.

One staff member who truly stood out was Joseph, a young man with a big smile and an even bigger heart. He would constantly check in on us, asking if we needed anything and running to get it for us without hesitation. His dedication and enthusiasm were truly impressive!

The receptionist was also incredibly kind and helpful, making our check-in process seamless and welcoming. The entire staff was client-focused and hardworking, making us feel like we were the only guests.

The ambience of the hotel was lovely, with a warm and inviting atmosphere that made me feel right at home. From the decor to the lighting, everything was perfectly curated to create a relaxing and comfortable environment.

I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a wonderful stay with exceptional service.

Thank you to Joseph and the entire staff for making our stay so memorable!" 5/5 stars!

To the management, Joseph is an employee you need to retain here . Do everything, anything to retain him including a salary review. Thanks

user_reviews.Name: 919vicu
user_reviews.Description: Like everything else at Monarch Parkview, the breakfast buffet was expansive, very attentive and almost like coming to breakfast with the family. I stayed 19 days and at here 18 times. Solid work Joseph and staff.

user_reviews.Name: Cittolin Sander
user_reviews.Description:
I’m in Addis Ababa for an 11-night stay, and so far this experience has been completely unacceptable. I arrived on December 2, and from day one the room had obvious issues: half of the lights didn’t work (I let that go), but the shower was not working, which is not something you can “ignore” in a hotel.

The next morning at 8:00 AM, I went to reception and reported the shower problem. I was told it would be fixed. After a full day of work, I came back around 7:00 PM and nothing had been done. I went back to reception again, and only then they spent about 45 minutes trying to “find a solution,” finally deciding to move me to another room. But honestly, it’s outrageous that I notify you at 8:00 AM and I’m only switching rooms around 8:00 PM. No compensation, no upgrade, no gesture at all, which is standard in hospitality when the hotel fails to provide basic services. I work in hospitality myself, so I know what good service looks like. This wasn’t it.

And tonight was the final straw: it is currently 1AM and an alarm has been ringing for over an hour. I called reception once and was told it would be handled. 20 minutes later, still nothing, so I called again to ask when it would stop. The receptionist told me, “Can you come down?”,  meaning go down 10 floors at 12.30 AM. Absolutely not. Then she hung up on me. I needed to call them AGAIN 10mn later.

Also, on Booking it says there is a fitness center, but it’s half under work/upgrade, which should be clearly communicated before booking....

The only positive thing I can say is that the F&B team is excellent: welcoming, warm, smiling, and professional. Unfortunately, that’s the only department that seems to care. ps : the rooftop is beautiful.

user_reviews.Name: C6783DQjoshuac
user_reviews.Description: We had an amazing experience with the breakfast buffet. Joseph was so kind and helpful, he made sure everything went smooth.We highly recommend this place.

title: Betsi Bed and Breakfast
address: In front of The National Museum of Ethiopia, King George VI St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: In front of The National Museum of Ethiopia, King George VI St

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
I was surprised by this B&B's unusual location inside a hospital, but the service was outstanding. The staff responded quickly to questions and immediately resolved any issues that arose. A simple but warm breakfast was served every morning, power outages were almost non-existent and the Wi-Fi connection was reliable. The spacious, quiet rooms had a calm atmosphere, making for a relaxing stay. The only drawback is that payment is strictly limited to cash in US dollars, with no Visa or debit cards accepted, which can be inconvenient. However, this also means that the guests tend to be steady and considerate. The prices are very affordable compared to those in the local area, the housekeeper was wonderfully friendly, and it is one of the few places I would gladly return to.

Note that there is actually no shared kitchen.

# Addis Ababa # Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Tomoya Nomizo
user_reviews.Description:
It’s located between the city center and a local residential area, so the location isn’t bad. Bus routes are limited, but there’s a stop nearby. However, it’s quite hard to find the first time you go—the taxi driver couldn’t get there. We also didn’t know in advance that the hotel was located inside a hospital.

The back of the room faces a school, so it’s rather noisy in the morning. On weekends, loud music from the neighboring shop continues until morning. Whether you find these sounds noisy or simply part of the city’s lively atmosphere depends on your perspective.

The room was relatively clean and well maintained, though there was no housekeeping or bed-making during the stay. Perhaps towels could have been replaced and trash collected upon request. The female staff member was pleasant and hardworking, but communication wasn’t smooth since she didn’t speak English. Still, I had a good impression of her attitude and effort.

Breakfast was the same every day—bread, tea, and fried eggs. There was no butter or jam for the bread until a French guest requested it, and even then, the portion was quite small. Since this place promotes itself as a “bed and breakfast,” I think this should be improved.

Wi-Fi was available but very weak—just enough for sending and receiving text messages. This may not be the hotel’s fault but rather due to the underdeveloped infrastructure in Addis Ababa.

Although not directly related to the hotel, the security guard at the hospital entrance was a truly wonderful person. Meeting him was one of the highlights of this trip. We even shared a meal together—injera.

The location itself isn’t bad, but there are quite a few scammers in the surrounding area. We were victims of a small scam ourselves, and I often felt that people were eyeing our wallets. However, how one perceives such experiences depends on each traveler’s sense of safety, what they seek in travel, and their travel skills.

The hotel owner seemed honest and sincere. I think he’s also a doctor at the hospital where the hotel is located. He wasn’t always at the front desk, but when contacted, he would return. This sometimes caused delays, and we had to wait for him to arrive. However, communication was smooth and problem-free overall. He’s a genuinely nice guy.

There is an airport transfer service, but unlike in many other countries or regions, it isn’t free. It’s apparently cheaper than taking a taxi, but we weren’t informed of it upon arrival, so we couldn’t use it then. On departure, the driver was nearly an hour late, and the car was very small, old, and uncomfortable. Although the driver was serious and polite, his speeding made me feel unsafe.

Overall, my stay in Addis Ababa, including this hotel, was enjoyable but not comfortable. Still, whether one seeks comfort while traveling depends on personal values. I would consider staying at this hotel again.

user_reviews.Name: Danny days
user_reviews.Description: From the moment I arrived, the hospitality was absolutely top-notch. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help with a warm smile. The bottom floor is a hospital so it’s super clean and quiet! The location is unbeatable central, and close to everything you could possibly need. Famous museum across the street. Every tourist attraction and restaurants literally 5-10 minutes away! I also felt completely safe  throughout my stay because of how well secured the building is. This made the experience even better. Also they have better WiFi than most places in Addis if you need internet. I highly recommend this bed and breakfast. Forgot their names but I would have included them here! Thank you guys!

user_reviews.Name: Ali Ibrahim
user_reviews.Description:
Location perfect...room its like a hospital..breakfast very basic ( eggs and tea)...
MUSIC and very Loud at night from the close neighbourhood.
Would recommend if you need something cheap and well located.

user_reviews.Name: Maria Achilleia
user_reviews.Description: Betsi Bed and Breakfast is one floor hotel in the 3rd floor of a clinic. The location is central, opposite to the National museum but the museum is under construction as the road in front of the hotel thus no lights on the streets which makes it scary to walk there if it’s dark. The breakfast was poor and the room though very spacious it was very noisy as there is a very busy neighborhood exactly next to it. The clean lady was friendly and always around.

user_reviews.Name: Rahel T. D.
user_reviews.Description:
Great accommodation in the center of Addis!
Ask for a quiet room because two bars/restaurants will bother you otherwise, with their non-stop blasting music. This is beyond the control of the B&B manager, who tried to make them stop more than once. But please notice that this is literally the only downside of this accommodation!
Other than that, at Betsi B&B you will find impeccable service, kindness, availability and spotless rooms!
I forgot to take pics in the room, but the ones you see online perfectly portray what will expect you.

Beware that there is no clear sign on the side of the building or on the street, just look for the white building with a dark red line on top: you will see the sign for the "Christmas International brain and spine center", which is located on the ground floor of the same building, while the B&B is on the 3rd floor.

user_reviews.Name: Tomas Hidde Hoekstra
user_reviews.Description:
Stayed for multiple days and had a great experience! Definitely recommend this bed and breakfast.

The rooms are clean, spacious and comfortable. The staff is amazing. Biruk picked me up from the airport and we made a little detour to show me around the area, telling stories about Addis. All the time he was available for questions and more info. Also the area is great, many bars and restaurants close by.

user_reviews.Name: Agnieszka Wawreszuk
user_reviews.Description: Good experience! Clean rooms, very nice staff, good location (but under construction). Good value of money. Recommend!

title: Nemudat Hotel
address: 2QX2+PXM Nemudat Hotel, Senegal St, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

owner.name: Sarem International Hotel & Spa | Semen Mazegaja | ሳሬም ኢንተርናሽናል ሆቴልና ስፓ | ሰሜን ማዘጋጃ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Chalachew Tesfa Tessema
user_reviews.Description:
Subject: Appreciation for the Excellent Service and Hospitality at Sarem International Hotel

Dear Mr. Seid and the Sarem International Hotel Team,

I am writing to express my deep appreciation for the outstanding hospitality and service I experienced at Sarem International Hotel in Addis Ababa.

I have read that some online reviews mention negative experiences such as technical malfunctions, issues with elevators or smartcards, limited customer service, or cleanliness concerns. However, my personal experience was completely different and far more positive.

During my stay, everything worked smoothly, and the staff demonstrated great professionalism, respect, and genuine kindness. The management, led by Mr. Seid, showed strong leadership and dedication to ensuring guests feel comfortable and welcome. My room was clean, spacious, and well-prepared, and the overall atmosphere in the hotel was warm and inviting.

I was particularly impressed by how the hotel team treated guests with care and patience, responding quickly and politely to every request. This level of attention clearly shows that the Sarem International Hotel values customer satisfaction and constantly strives for excellence.

While every hotel may face occasional technical challenges, the true measure of quality lies in how the staff and management handle them — and in this regard, your hotel excels.

I would like to sincerely thank you once again for your exceptional hospitality and kindness. I will happily recommend Sarem International Hotel to my friends, family, and colleagues who plan to visit Addis Ababa.

Warm regards,
Chalachew Tesfa

user_reviews.Name: Axum Cake
user_reviews.Description: First of all, after we reserve our room we need to wait more than 2 hours to enter, because of what they called room preparations. Secondly they have a very bad wifi connection with multiple choices and was very difficult to connect. The people in the restaurant were very good and nice but the food 👎👎👎👎 vegetable without seasoning and rice without test😩😩😩. user_reviews.Description:
I spent close to a month at Danakil Hotel, in Addis Ababa/Finfinne, Ethiopia sometime in March/April, 2024. It was a new hotel located in the heart of the City. They celebrated their second anniversary while I was there.
My first negative impression on my arrival was the poor appearance of the front/main entrance of the hotel. I expressed what I felt to the biggest boss, who was on site when I arrived. He said that it was going to be renovated soon. I witnessed it (the renovation) taking place during my stay at the hotel.
That being a minor dark spot of the Hotel, the interiors of it (the lobby, the restaurant, the hallways, the rooms) were all so neat.
Being located in the heart of the City (Piassa), it is convenient for almost everything.
Disruptions of power and water supplies are among the chronic problems of the City. But, I did not experience any of these when I stayed at the Hotel. What I noticed was that the Hotel has its own replacements for both, that kick in as the disruptions happen.
Above all, the well-built team work of the staff from bottom up, or vice-versa, was so impressive. They act as one. Any question raised by a guest is answered by anybody around you; and, in most cases, satisfactorily. There is no such thing as, “This is not my job”.
The rates for the rooms were relatively fair; and housekeepings were perfect (during my stay). But, flexibilities are inevitable.
One last point: Most of my friends whom I invited for lunch/dinner at the Hotel were not happy with the preparation of the TRADITIONAL meals in particular. Some openly told me their dissatisfaction; mentioning that they know a lot of much better restaurants.
Overall, I liked Danakil; and I won’t think of any other place if/when I go back to Ethiopia.
Tesfaye Dh. Kumsa.
