user_reviews.Name: Dr. Andrew Odhiambo
user_reviews.Description:
A Layover Experience at Grand Eliana Hotel - Addis Ababa ⭐⭐

If you’ve ever had a long layover in Addis Ababa courtesy of Ethiopian Airlines, you might just find yourself at the Grand Eliana Hotel. That’s where I ended up on my journey from Nairobi to Abuja. Let me take you through my experience – the good, the bad, and the definitely not so grand.

The Airport Pickup Confusion 🚐

Let’s start from the beginning. My long layover began with what I thought would be a straightforward pickup from Bole International Airport. Spoiler alert: it wasn’t. The pickup was disorganized, slow, and outdated – I mean, they were literally using manual lists. It took over 2 hours to get to the hotel from the time we landed, and some fellow passengers took almost 4 hours! Ethiopian efficiency? Not quite.

A Bright Lobby & Quick Check-In ✨

Once at the hotel, things seemed to look up. The lobby was surprisingly refreshing – bright, clean, and welcoming. The check-in was impressively fast too, thanks to the staff already having our details. Passport, key, passport, key – done! The elevators worked without a hitch, and despite the chaos, the staff did their best to keep things moving.

My Room on the 8th Floor 🚪

Now, to the room itself. After a minor hiccup with the keycard, I was given a manual key. Stepping inside, I noticed the room was spacious but a bit gloomy due to poor lighting. The bed was the room’s saving grace – soft, clean sheets, and a mattress that made me forget the long wait. I actually slept quite well.

The Bathroom Horror 😬

Now, here’s where things went south. The bathroom was, frankly, disgusting. Dirty shower floor, a cockroach making itself at home, and just an overall unclean vibe. Towels at small and poor quality. I couldn’t bring myself to use the shower, and just opted for a quick wipe the next morning.

Room Amenities - A Mixed Bag 🛋️

The room had some good features like a spacious balcony with a great night view of Addis Ababa. The TV, however, was a joke – a tiny little screen that felt more like a microscope. Plus, Wi-Fi? Forget it. It was virtually non-existent.

Dinner Disappointment 🍽️

Dinner time arrived with high hopes. Sadly, it was another letdown. The food was cold – potatoes, rice, fish – all served without any real stew. Just some basic salad and fruits. The soda and wine were the only redeeming factors. Staff at the dining area looked overworked and stressed. I ate what I could, had some wine, and called it a night.

Leaving the Next Morning 🕰️

The next morning, I skipped breakfast (after the dinner experience, I wasn’t risking it). The pickup back to the airport was 30 minutes late, but at this point, that seemed almost acceptable.

Final Thoughts 🤔

I wouldn’t recommend Grand Eliana Hotel for a layover or any stay, honestly. It needs major improvements before I’d consider going back. The bed was comfy, and the view was good, but everything else fell flat. If you have no other choice, you’ll survive, but don’t expect much.

Have You Stayed Here?

If you’ve had a similar (or better!) experience, I’d love to hear from you. Drop a comment and share your thoughts! And if you found this review helpful, please like and recommend it to others. Don’t forget to check out my photos to see for yourself!

user_reviews.Name: MKRA
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is pretty close to the airport, approximately 15-20min drive with traffic. It is also in a good location and within walking distance to Edna mall. ||There is no gym at the hotel but i did find one behind Edna mall that was equipped well and includes a swimming pool.||||All the staff speak English and are very helpful and accommodating, including the chef. We only used the restaurant for breakfast. There is a continental breakfast available as well as some local delicacies. I simply loved the fresh papaya juice and local cuisine. They also have an omelette bar which I took advantage of.||The room is very clean and comfortable (we were given a choice of rooms to view and selected the best fit). As the hotel faces a busy street, it can get noisy from the hustle and bustle of the daily trade. The beds are super comfortable. The rooms come with tea making facilities and a mini fridge. There is also a safe in the closet. The shower was great with good water pressure. The rooms are cleaned everyday and the I found the cleaning staff to be professional and honest. The hotel operates a shuttle service that picked us up from the airport and dropped us off on our last day. Adjacent to the hotel entrance is a bank with an ATM.||||Street lighting seems to be an issues around this area so at night it can get pretty dark in some of the surrounding streets that lead up to the hotel. However, I never felt unsafe on the streets. ||||Here is a tip for any travelers visiting Addis, download the uber equivalent called RIDE. I found it to be very convenient and works well.

user_reviews.Name: Fernando Merencio
user_reviews.Description:
My wife and I spent a night in this hotel on a long layover. It was paid by Ethiopian Airlines and what I have to say is that it is a very decent, clean and perfect for a one night of sleep or even two or three. The staff is very kind and helpful too. Dinner was ok, nothing to
complain.  Bathroom clean, nice bed.

user_reviews.Name: kudzai gara
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely amazing customer service. I called Zmama and had the pleasure of speaking with Wondmagegn who is the Night Manager. He was absolutely helpful and helped me with booking the hotel for my Mum. My Mum stayed at the hotel for 13 days and she emphasized on how comfortable, clean and amazing the Hotel was. The staff at Zmama hotel is very customer oriented and helpful. If I ever go to Ethiopia, I’ll definitely stay at this hotel. Thank you for your amazing service and keep it up. Thank you for making my Mum’s visit amazing!

user_reviews.Name: EthiopiaErmias Mezmuroch
user_reviews.Description: Rooms are good, but the breakfast is bad. No varieties at all. Me and My wife went out to some other place to eat breakfast because we couldn't get any thing interesting here. The chef is talkative, but not helpful. My wife's and I have a very good experience in other Hotels, but this one is bad. The server's expect tip every minute they see you. If they don't get it they will ignore you.

user_reviews.Name: NatchezBlues
user_reviews.Description: After booking hotel, I tried to call the telephone number given for the hotel to arrange the free airport shuttle. However, nobody would answer the phone. I had to pay for a taxi to the hotel. I asked the receptionist why nobody was answering the telephone number and she said that is was mistakenly turned off. I then went to my room which I found rather nice and with good attention to detail. Bed and sheeting were of good quality and the room was neat. After taking a nap, i went back to the reception and asked for the location of the fitness center. She replied that it is planned but not ready yet. If I had known this in advance, I would have booked another hotel.

title: Addis Regency Hotel | Piazza | አዲስ ሪጀንሲ ሆቴል | ፒያሳ
address: Benin St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: No-nonsense rooms in a laid-back hotel with free breakfast & Wi-Fi, plus a restaurant.

owner.name: Addis Regency Hotel | Piazza | አዲስ ሪጀንሲ ሆቴል | ፒያሳ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
The location is a bit far from the city centre, but the facilities are very good for the price.

Smiling Staffs, excellent restaurant, which means nice and friendly staff.

Little comfort - no shampoo, toothbrush, hopefully these will be provided.

# Addis Ababa # Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: SazDazzleRazzle
user_reviews.Description: Myself and my partner stayed in this hotel on and off for 10 days whilst we travelled the North of Ethiopia, and we loved this hotel. We had to leave a lot of our luggage and valuables as we travelled, and the hotel kept it secure for us each time. The hotel arranged very early breakfasts for us and shuttle services to the airport. The staff were really friendly and it was all very organised. We ate a lot in the hotel, and the food was always excellent, such a high standard. I recommend the 'Vegetarian Special', although alongside traditional Ethiopian food they offer an array of European foods also. The rooms were always clean and spacious, with huge comfortable beds. There were staff available 24 hours a day, and the hotel had good wifi. We could not fault this hotel, and if we are ever in Addis we will stay again at the Regency.

user_reviews.Name: Danyl1967
user_reviews.Description: We stayed here as our base during an amazing Ethiopian experience. The hotel stored our things between visits (three stays) and gave a warm welcome back each time. The whole team really couldn’t do enough for us. We used the restaurant and bar facilities in the evenings to relax between excursions. They even did all the washing before we went home... with all services very keenly priced. Airport runs for our internal and international flights were all on time, with friendly safe drivers. The entire experience was smooth from start to finish. Many thanks to the management, catering and housekeeping teams. A memorable, happy and authentic stay.

user_reviews.Name: marktO233JB
user_reviews.Description: A nice hotel with one of the best staffs you will ever encounter. Our three rooms were clean and comfortable and the 24 hour restaurant and bar were nice additional features. Breakfast was good as well. More than anything, the staff of this hotel is the number one reason I will stay there again on my next trip to Addis. At every turn they went above and beyond to accommodate our every need beginning with the hotel shuttle driver sticking around Bole airport until midnight after our flights were delayed and our luggage was lost. The Addis Regency took customer service to a whole new level for us. We will be back.

user_reviews.Name: Terje Skjerdal
user_reviews.Description: Good room, large soft bed, very clean. The airport transfer is free and fully reliable (a reason in itself to choose this hotel). Not sure how they do it, but wireless Internet is quick and reliable, in contrast to other hotels in the city. Have stayed here many times.

user_reviews.Name: bddblink182
user_reviews.Description: This hotel is an absolute gem.  It is a 5 Star hotel with 5 star staff with 5 star food and 5 star service.  The manager (His name translation literally means "Mr. Wonderful") personally ensures that every guest feels like family.  Mr. Wonderful takes pride in knowing every name of his guests and will personally look out for your well-being and safety during your stay in Addis.  The food was incredible, especially the breakfast spread that comes with deliciously STRONG coffee!  The location of this hotel is perfectly placed next to a tiny colorful coffee house  (buna bet - coffee shop) that is often full of friendly locals, many who speak English.  Next to this coffee shop is a quaint bakery full of cookies, pastries, and donuts (Bombolino).  This area is VERY SAFE and has alleys surrounding the hotel full of local shops, barbers, spices, schools, and local friendlies.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this hotel to anyone traveling to Addis Ababa.  Everything is affordable to travelers and they have a VERY VERY good tour guide that provides safe trips anywhere you want to go!  We were able to visit all of the beautiful surrounding areas that this country has to offer.

user_reviews.Name: TripMember06092015
user_reviews.Description: It’s ranked as top choice here not without a reason.  The price is reasonable, the place is clean, and the staff is the best of this hotel: very friendly and accommodating.  ||The hotel is hidden inside an narrow street off the main road.  It is a bit dark around at night and it is not so convenient for public transport.  It looks like that it is more a residential neighbourhood nearby and there is virtually no shop around other than one or two street stalls selling water and soft drinks etc.  The plus side of the location is that it is a escape from the busy (and often chaotic) city.

user_reviews.Name: EmpressJ
user_reviews.Description: Had a 12-hour layover overnight in Ethiopia for our connection flight to Tanzania. Needed a hotel that was close to the airport to shower and sleep. Addis Regency was about 10-15 mins away (beware of traffic in the mornings, give yourself extra travelling time). The airport pick-up was smooth, just had to wait, the check-in was smooth for the most part. The room was very basic, not a 4 or 5 star. The water pressure was very low in our room, almost a drip and the hot water took about 10 minutes to finally come out the "shower". As stated in other reviews, there is a club close by, and the music goes on until the early hours (not ideal when you are jet-lagged and trying to catch some sleep).||Nonetheless, the staff is really friendly. I wouldn't stay here for more than one- night, but it was adequate for the price paid.

title: Keba Guest House (INN)
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Anthony Bolton
user_reviews.Description: I highly recommend staying at Keba Guest House. For the price this place over exceeded my expectations. It was clean, quiet and relaxing. The Host along with the hostesses was very kind and provided great service. The food was amazing and I just couldn't believe how incredibly they accommodated me. That is a place that I will be definitely going back to when I go back to Addis Ababa Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Arone Tamene
user_reviews.Description: Very nice hotel and I will really love it. I highly recommend to anyone who is going to addis!

user_reviews.Name: NC
user_reviews.Description: The staff was very friendly and accommodating. They were very helpful in terms of helping arrange taxis and giving advice about the city. The food was great as well. The wide view of the city from my balcony was nice.

user_reviews.Name: Kk Kk
user_reviews.Description: Oh its gorgeous hotel I have been to and it has nice rooms,good service and friendly stuffs ,it has restaurant you can order food and there is  kitchen you can cook your own food.

user_reviews.Name: Admas Kebede
user_reviews.Description: Great team with great amenities. Definitely recommend staying here if you are looking for a cosy place to stay in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Jarso Gedecho
user_reviews.Description: Very excellent iam hapy

user_reviews.Name: Ahmed adam
user_reviews.Description: It was à good place to live and stuffs were so kind and helpful,So friendly stuffs

user_reviews.Name: Queeneth Obobaifo
user_reviews.Description: Ethiopians are hospitable

title: Ghion Hotel | Stadium
address: 2Q76+F3H Ghion Hotel | Stadium, Ras Desta Damtew St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Unassuming rooms in a laid-back hotel offering gardens, 3 eateries & an Olympic-size outdoor pool.

user_reviews.Name: Honey ta D
user_reviews.Description:
The hotel has abundant area but the food service quality varies on a daily basis. The restrooms inaddition to being inadequate in number, have shortage & absence of water most of the time.
On the bright side, most of the facilitators/waiters/waitresses/technicians are very cooperative, sweet and kind. They should be given a raise for keeping the place going with their warmth even with all the maintenance required but give due attention to the kitchen lagging to serve meals. The waiters "supervisor" needs training to be able to work under stress/pressure/rush hour so she can influence the staffs positively. Prepare special curtains for trainings using projector so the notes can be viewed properly during the room's exposure to sunlight. Waiting to see you excel during my next visit. Good Luck!

user_reviews.Name: Alpha Omega
user_reviews.Description: I know this hotel build 50 to 60 years ago the service mentality old not inviting or bad communication. This is one place government it should not be in hotel business at all. The employ watching YouTube behind the counter and we have to yel for service. I heard a customer eating lunch he ask for Wifi PW they told him only for room gust and he walked away from customer rudely. They should learn from surrounding hotels. BAD service👎 the natural setup and location is very good. Not coming up for sure.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Kassa
user_reviews.Description: A hotel that was established during the emperor's time but still intact. We have tried the traditional restaurant, tekul. We tried two types of tibs and a beef steak. Everything was delicious. The service was great and the staff were quite attentive. The place has traditional vibes and is suitable for large groups. Although the place is quiet, the food is great, the place is clean and the service is great. The price is also fair for the quality of food they serve. I don't think people have the right perception of this place. I think it is worth a try and definitely a beautiful experience.

user_reviews.Name: Amsale Michael
user_reviews.Description:
We would like to say thank you to the manager, Bereket, if it wasn't for your pleasant approach and assistance, we wouldn't have stayed for 45 days. The entire reception staff, Asnake, the house keeping crew, thank you for everything.
While the hotel is in central location to the airport and other destinations, it needs an overhaul renovation, and updated bathroom and rooms.  The outside gardens are still well kept except for the water fountains.  The location of the rooms away from Addis Ababa's traffic and noise is a plus. Again we thank everyone who's involved during our stay.

user_reviews.Name: Sunrise Driving School Mez (Mez)
user_reviews.Description: Extremely poor hospitality & service at the Tukul/traditional dinning hall. We took our seat in dinning hall and waited for about 20 min, there’s no one to ask us, and we changed our table and moved outside at the veranda, another 10 minutes passed, no one showed up; and finally we should call this lady standing little away who was staring at us. She brought us the menu and ordered one from the list; she didn’t even turn her face to us to say “we don’t have that meal”, leave alone to accompany her words with “sorry” and/or give us other options. Honestly speaking, I was so very happy that that specific Tibs we ordered wasn’t available, as her facial expression and gesture was very disturbing and don’t think I would eat that food comfortably. Terrible!

user_reviews.Name: Kerim Fedlu
user_reviews.Description:
An Oldies but Goodies Hotel with a balance between charm and functionality. The lush garden, swimming pool, and spa services offer a serene escape amidst the city bustle. While the accommodations maintain a classic vibe, they're clean and comfortable. The affordability is a definite plus, making it accessible to budget-conscious travelers.
The highlight of this establishment is undoubtedly its picturesque garden, providing a tranquil setting for relaxation and leisurely strolls. The swimming pool offers a refreshing dip on hot days, and the spa services provide a touch of luxury without breaking the bank.
However, there are areas for improvement. Some aspects of the hotel could benefit from modernization to enhance the overall guest experience. Additionally, while the staff is friendly, there's room for improvement in terms of efficiency and responsiveness.
Overall, Oldies but Goodies Hotel offers good value for the price, with its beautiful garden, swimming pool, and affordable spa services. It's a solid option for those seeking a peaceful retreat without sacrificing too much on comfort.

user_reviews.Name: Tamirat Alemu
user_reviews.Description: Ghion Hotel offers a unique blend of comfort and culture in the heart of Addis Ababa. The hotel features spacious rooms that are clean and well-maintained, providing a relaxing atmosphere for both business and leisure travelers. Guests appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, always ready to assist with any needs. The on-site restaurant serves a variety of local and international dishes, showcasing Ethiopian cuisine, which is a highlight for many visitors. The beautiful gardens surrounding the hotel create a peaceful retreat from the city's hustle and bustle. Additionally, its convenient location near major attractions and business districts makes it an ideal choice for travelers. While the hotel may benefit from some modern updates, its charm and hospitality make it a worthwhile stay. Overall, Ghion Hotel is a great option for anyone looking to experience genuine Ethiopian hospitality in a comfortable setting.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Debebe
user_reviews.Description:
The Ghion Cottage restaurant is just amazing... Great traditional food with very attentive staff.
One of their specialities is call ENFELE... The taste is our of this world. Please try it.

title: Churchill Hotel
address: 2QG2+8QX Churchill Hotel, Churchill Ave, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Simple rooms in a laid-back hotel with a restaurant, a bar & an exercise room, plus free parking.

user_reviews.Name: Yibrah Aregawi
user_reviews.Description: I’m having a breakfast with my brother for a successful mission after one year with the help of God. In the legend Hotel for the Legend Memories.

user_reviews.Name: Matthew Koss
user_reviews.Description: My stay at the Churchill Hotel was great. My room was large, neat, and very accommodating. The staff was very friendly and happy to assist me at anytime during the day or night. On top of that, the room service always responsive and the food at the restaurant was so good that i could not get enough of it. The area was safe and close to most of the places i wanted to go either by walking or a short taxi ride. The staff was also very knowledgeable of the surrounding area and had many good suggestions.

user_reviews.Name: Lazaros Kokkalis
user_reviews.Description:
It used to be a beautiful and luxurious hotel, now it needs renovation and new sheets and towels because the ones in the rooms have scratches. I paid €40 for 1 night in this room.
On the plus side the size of the room and the bed, as well as the good dinner for only €5

user_reviews.Name: Edith Aiyede
user_reviews.Description: Lovely hotel, pleasant staff, central and safe location. The amenities are good and working. It was a transit hotel for me and I didn't get the chance to explore much but it gave me a restful and peaceful night. The view from the restaurant balcony was amazing at night and I got to take some lovely pictures. Rooms in some Adis-Ababa hotels typically do not have air conditioners, I believe because of the cold weather. Overall, thumbs up. There was this really meek, gentle, hardworking man that attended to us both at the check-in, restaurant and check-out, he was very helpful. Kudos to Ethiopia Air for that choice.

user_reviews.Name: Yubi Endale
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is right in the middle of city, and the views from the rooms are amazing – you can see the whole city! The rooms are comfortable and great size. Hotel also has a great restaurant (with cultural and western menu options) where you can order room service or sit in and enjoy. The staff were also very helpful and professional.

user_reviews.Name: naomigirma
user_reviews.Description: The hotel was amazing. Location is very central and the price was very reasonable. Having a restaurant with a full bar was absolutely nice and convenient. There was a delicious buffet style breakfast available in the morning. Full menu for the restaurant was also available. We ordered food that was not on the menu a few times and the restaurant was very accommodating. The staff here was very attentive, friendly and  always around as needed. We were here for only a couple weeks but we were able to get our laundry done clothes pressed. My sisters and I were able to get our hair done at the salon located in the hotel. But the actual hotel and experience was a 4.9 out of 5 . I loved it.

user_reviews.Name: zeeshan vlogs
user_reviews.Description:
Some of the staff was a bit rude, however majority was good.
Hotel is a bit expensive.  No negotiation,  if some one booked on your behalf and your are not familiar.

No muslim shower to wash your washroom.
Tissue paper is availble through out country.

user_reviews.Name: Habinuchi Owhondah
user_reviews.Description: I stayed here when transiting through Addis as my original hotel Skylight Hotel was fully booked and so I thrown to Churchill hotel. I did not like the hotel. The food was not fresh and warm but I managed it for both dinner and breakfast. The room below par, I could find the air conditioning in the room. Well I had less than six hours to stay there so I just made do and in the morning I left for the airport. Ethiopian Airlines need to do a better job at managing the hotel bookings so that they do discomfort their customers and offer their esteemed customers such abysmal service.

title: Caravan Hotel | Haya Hulet | ካራቫን ሆቴል | ሃያ ሁለት
address: Mike Leyland St, Addis Ababa 0132, Ethiopia
description: Elegant, warm-hued rooms with free Wi-Fi & breakfast, along with refined dining.

owner.name: Caravan Hotel | Haya Hulet | ካራቫን ሆቴል | ሃያ ሁለት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: wegderes gudaey
user_reviews.Description: When you come to take rest in this hotel one of the best it’s really very silent and when you’re going to walk, it’s not far from the main road. They have a nice room and they have good bread and in the evening you’re going to enjoy very much.

user_reviews.Name: Hbe Lovely fashion
user_reviews.Description: well this is a very well recommend  hotel staffs kinds touch your heart by their Africa materials and yes their was indeed hot water an excellent buffet as well as their view and the chef please give me your number to call for events the food 100 and above also the payment is good thanks for your service and very soon I will be coming.

user_reviews.Name: Yesak 2024
user_reviews.Description: love it great service like the food the outdoor place wow. and i will come again i staying her can not wait to bring great people ATM right out the door and the rooms bravo and yes their is hot water do not understand why people say their is not but me and the other do not say that and book her

user_reviews.Name: yannickcF8948KW
user_reviews.Description: Great location and great value. The rooms are perfect and the staff is amazing. They gladly helped us with our requests. ATMs are just next the front door, so no need to move from the hotel to withdraw the money. I'll definitely come back here next time in Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: W5246XHmariok
user_reviews.Description: The conditions of the rooms have really gone down. Nice place to stay, nice food and affordable price 5 minutes drive to airport. I like Caravan and its location, but they need to invest in new mattresses. Room was fine, had everything we needed. Bedside lamp wasn’t working though.

user_reviews.Name: Arone Tamene
user_reviews.Description: One of the best hotel in Addis Abeba. I will highly recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Aarushi Kashyap
user_reviews.Description: Far below an average hotel, wouldn't have stayed here if our travel agency didn't have a collaboration. No hot water, no toiletries, nobody at the reception after 9pm, no option to call anyone, dingy room, lights & TV not working

user_reviews.Name: Susan E
user_reviews.Description: This is a terrible hotel. My family and I woke up to shower at 6am and there was no hot water. We were told it was finished and that it would take 2 hrs to get hot water and that my family and I had to make do with buckets of water. This hotel is a shambles. Avoid at all costs.

title: Simple Guest House & Furnished Apartment with Kitchen
address: Semen mazegaja, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Simple Guest House & Furnished Apartment with Kitchen (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Bethelhem Mengesha
user_reviews.Description: This place was a 10 out of 10 for me, the host was super nice and welcoming, the rooms were so clean, location was super convenient. I Definitely recommend it!!!

user_reviews.Name: Doria Mesfin
user_reviews.Description: My stay at Simple guest house was truly wonderful! The staff were incredibly welcoming and attentive, making sure every detail was perfect. The rooms were clean and beautifully designed. The location was convenient and overall, I couldn't have asked for a better experience. I would definitely recommend this guest house to anyone looking for comfort and good internet connection.

user_reviews.Name: Jesse (Pastor *Not 501c3*)
user_reviews.Description: The place is big with kitchenet and with great prices. The service and staff are outstandingly nice and respectful.

user_reviews.Name: Yonatan Million
user_reviews.Description: The rooms were clean and spotless. The beds were quite cozy and reasonably priced. I've had a great time and will most likely return.

user_reviews.Name: Rebecca Tedla
user_reviews.Description: This place is very clean and convenient location. The stuff were very friendly and helpful. Enjoyed our stay .

user_reviews.Name: leoul tadele
user_reviews.Description: It was a great stay, the room and bathroom was really clean and the customer service was amazing. I would definitely recommend!

user_reviews.Name: United Manche
user_reviews.Description: I had an amazing time. All the staffs are very nice and welcoming. The prices are also amazing. I’ll definitely be back when I come to Addis Ababa next time.

user_reviews.Name: Melat Getachew
user_reviews.Description: Great apartment! We enjoyed staying in the apartment which was spacious, comfortable and clean! Will definitely stay here again!

title: Panorama
address: 2Q92+MXG Panorama, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

title: Tirar International Hotel Lideta
address: Sao Thome & Principe St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Modest rooms, some with city views, in a casual hotel offering dining, a bar & an airport shuttle.

user_reviews.Name: Nidra Hammond
user_reviews.Description: Had a disappointing experience in this hotel as a transit passenger. First off, it was a long drive from the airport late at night. Also, one of the staff was highly unprofessional in his conduct, which led to I and my travelling companion to immediately book another hotel and leave the same night. The rooms need to be worked on, and, most importantly, unprofessional staff should be cautioned and retrained if needed. Front desk staff, concierge, and manager on duty were really helpful in addressing our concerns.

user_reviews.Name: Philip Opperman
user_reviews.Description: Layover caused by Ethiopian Airways. Was booked at another hotel then regretably changed last minutes to this place. Very friendly staff services, rooms are old and noisy from corridor movement and talks. Ice cold shower. Room was cold too as it was raining. Food was cold but tasty.

user_reviews.Name: heinrich baatjes
user_reviews.Description:
Interesting hotel in dire need of a cosmetic and plumbing upgrade. I was in room 501.
The intricate wooden tile floors is definitely a feature worth saving. The bathrooms need the poor plumbing and those horrible shower cubicle modernised.
The room was clean, the sheets crisp but the pillows felt like wooden slabs under my head. The furniture is made of a dark wood, good quality and with very intricate patterns. This spot of beauty is easily overlooked if you look at the room as a whole.

The real stars in this hotel are the waiters and concierge. They get 5 🌟
The service in the restaurant is truly hospitable, efficient, mindful and they make you feel welcome and make sure you are well fed.
The concierge made sure we all got wake up calls, he ran to each room to make sure you do not miss the airport bus. Well done guys!!!!

PS: if anyone has an email address for this hotel please share

user_reviews.Name: En Mafo
user_reviews.Description: Very big and comfortable beds, availability of hot water in rooms.  The lift is is good order.  The service is great and the staff speak Fuentes English. There is availability of a pickup a day drop off van.  Food prices are moderate. Desert is great.  The view from the front porches are great

user_reviews.Name: Adel Yabrody (DJ)
user_reviews.Description: The service is fine, but the Shuttle didn't even arrive that we had to take our own taxi from the airport to the hotel. The rooms where fine but there were a lot of cockroaches and the shower was broken. I changed the room 5 times and it was the same in every single room. I gotta say though, the staff were amazing and we had a good time with them!

user_reviews.Name: anilk258
user_reviews.Description: I stayed here on 13/12/19 during my long layover in Addis Ababa, courtesy Ethiopian airlines. Hotel is neat, check-in very fast. Rooms are spacious, clean with luggage storage & lockers. Shower enclosure too small n leaking.||Staff was very polite, a good bar & restaurant. No traffic noise as the front road not very busy. They have massage and sauna which is very cheap n good. Just for 300 Ethiopian birr I got massage for full  body for one hour, including sauna.||Would recommend for solo travelers.

user_reviews.Name: Hermela G
user_reviews.Description: The staff here is awesome, very helpful and polite. The food is very good and fresh. My room was always clean during my stay.

user_reviews.Name: Clément Di Roma
user_reviews.Description: Well located and service is very good, staff is very friendly, food is OK. But the quality of the rooms isn't great. No hot water pressure and old equipment. Fairly noisy. But for the price it's OK!

title: Checkinn Hotel
address: H2O, Bole atlas Chechnya road in-front of club, Addis Ababa 0000, Ethiopia
description: Casual hotel offering a breakfast buffet, a restaurant & a bar, plus event space & parking.

complete_address.street: H2O, Bole atlas Chechnya road in-front of club

user_reviews.Name: Tife Adigun
user_reviews.Description:
The rooms are clean, comfortable, and overall very pleasant. However, I want to share my experience as someone who stayed here as a transit guest placed by Ethiopian Airlines.

We are a family of five. Four of us received hotel vouchers, and the fifth person is our 3-month-old baby. When we arrived, the front desk showed us a list with all our names, including the baby’s and asked for her age. I clarified twice that she was only 3 months old even when she asked if the obviously small baby is 1 year old.

Our vouchers clearly stated that we were entitled to dinner and breakfast. When we went for dinner and began ordering, a lady stood beside us and asked whether my 3-month-old would be eating as well. I explained (again) that she only breastfeeds. She left, and the staff member taking our order continued.

When the food arrived, they brought 3 plates of food but made my other two kids share one plate of pasta and a 50cl Fanta. That upset me, because we paid full ticket fees for these children, the same as adults. It also became obvious they were monitoring what we ordered, seemingly to ensure the baby wasn’t included.

Breakfast was another uncomfortable moment. It was a buffet, and we asked if eggs were available. The lady said yes, but that the kitchen had to make them which seemed normal based on how we were served the previous night. After waiting, the waiter member from dinner came over and told us they don’t make omelettes for “transit guests.” I just nodded, already tired of the situation.

He then asked for our room number, went to check the room, and returned with something we supposedly left behind. That caught me off guard because he had been working as waitstaff, I still don’t understand the purpose of checking the room right at that moment.

Overall, I honestly don’t know what to make of this experience. The hotel itself is nice, but the treatment of transit guests felt unnecessarily monitored, restrictive, and uncomfortable.

Do better.
Your transit guests are still guests, and Ethiopian Airlines is paying you for a service. A little respect and consistency would go a long way.

user_reviews.Name: Ahmed Ebrahim
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great stay at CheckInn Hotel. The rooms are neat and clean, and I was really impressed by the internet speed,each room even has its own access point!

The room includes a comfortable chair and table, making it perfect for digital nomads or anyone working remotely. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: schehrezadap
user_reviews.Description: As a solo frmale traveler, i've found this hotel to be exceptional. Workers were super kind and always open to answer any questions i may had. |Relating the price, super affordable and the room was clean and all the comodities worked.

user_reviews.Name: R9623NGhannahw
user_reviews.Description: The staff are extremely friendly, kind, helpful. Very efficient and considerate. The hotel was in beautiful condition. The room was immaculate. I’ve got nothing but really good things to say.

user_reviews.Name: S5704INmichaeln
user_reviews.Description: The room was in great condition and the staff very friendly. They are keen on security and safety of their clients. The front office was quick to assist even providing directions on where I could find things around Addis. I will be back.

user_reviews.Name: Zinna Senbetta
user_reviews.Description: My husband and I stayed here for a week and had a very positive experience! Customer service was excellent - they are responsive on WhatsApp and in person to all requests and the airport shuttle pickup is very convenient. The rooms are clean and modern and room service is convenient. The Ethiopian coffee in the lobby is delicious and the hotel breakfast was very tasty. Location is also great walking distance to great restaurants and cafes and Dagi's spa. Be aware though there is lots of construction happening just next door and the road leading to the hotel entrance is unfinished.

user_reviews.Name: Meron Mekonnen
user_reviews.Description: We had such a cozy night, the room was clean, the staffs were friendly. The only reason I am not giving it a 5 start is because there was a miscommunication which was inconvenient for us during check in and check out. Otherwise it’s a good place.

user_reviews.Name: mohamedmE3069YH
user_reviews.Description: Really  one of the best hotels ever had seen.. everything is perfect..big thanks for all the staff 🙏🙏.. keep and going ahead

user_reviews.Name: Tewodros Dugasa
user_reviews.Description: I stayed for a couple of days at the hotel. My plan was to do my remote work from there, however the hotel does not have a functioning electric generator and there is no electricity or wifi during times of power outage. Elevators are inaccessible and the whole hotel is in pitch black. I would not recommend anyone to stay at this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: 114betelhemg
user_reviews.Description: stayed at Sunland International Hotel in Addisu Gebya in June 2025 and was disappointed by a significant issue with receiving my receipt. On Friday, June 27, I requested my receipt and was told it would be ready, but on Sunday, June 29, I waited over two hours at the front desk with no resolution. The staff cited a printer problem, but no alternative solutions, like a digital or handwritten receipt, were offered despite my follow-ups. This delay was frustrating and inconvenient, especially for business travelers needing documentation. While the hotel’s facilities are decent and some staff are friendly, this experience highlighted poor service coordination. I hope management addresses these operational issues to improve guest experiences.

user_reviews.Name: Trip.com Member
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is old but well maintained however the location is a little bit far from the city center. The staff are very friendly and happy to help anytime

user_reviews.Name: Sufiyaan Mohammed
user_reviews.Description: The worst of the reception service. Don't try this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Trip.com Member
user_reviews.Description: Best Hotel I've stayed at in Addis Ababa.Unfortunately due to Foot and Leg Injuries; had to stay in Room for majority of time. Personnel very helpful for Room Service..and assisting in pushing my wheelchair.Highly recommended for anyone who is thinking of visiting Addis Ababa.

user_reviews.Name: Mekdelawit Aklilu
user_reviews.Description: The room is very nice and roomy, it was rainy season and kind of cold weather. Stayed there for two nights with no hot water. We were told it will be fix but no body showed up. The breakfast is not buffets you have to order from the vwry few choices. and the test was OK. Not a big fan of breakfast but hot water is what I expected. Over all good service. Nice people.

user_reviews.Name: Natnael Tadesse
user_reviews.Description:
What a nice hotel with a very friendly nice staff.
The rooms are great too and I found the price fair.
Plenty of taxi at the entrance 👌

user_reviews.Name: P2989DHkristinas
user_reviews.Description: The hotell has kind and helpfull, service minded  management and staff, Good size comfortable rooms. Nice, good size lobby. Good local food served for breakfast. |Shops, restaurants and market with local spices and honey among other things close by.

title: The Grand Palace Hotel
address: Guinea Conakry St, Addis Ababa 5710, Ethiopia
description: Elegant rooms & suites, some with kitchenettes, in a high-end hotel with a restaurant & a spa.

user_reviews.Name: Sabine Russek
user_reviews.Description:
We stayed at Grand Palace Hotel twice during our trip around Ethiopia.

It was a nice place to land and get used to the city. It has a very elegant reception and the kitchen is open 24/7! The breakfast menu is delicious. The staff is really friendly too.

We left our big suitcases there while we went up north and south and it worked perfectly. The only problem are the rooms.

We got the family room, which was great and exactly what we needed but we think it needed more objects, specially the bathrooms: no floor mat, no hand towels, no hand soap holders, the extra duvets in the cupboard to use when it gets cold ( and it does!) dont even have a duvet cover.

They also said we had a safe box and we didnt. So they had to bring one.

When the manager asked me about feedback I told them all of this but when we stayed there after our two weeks trip, the issues were still not fixed. They are easy to fix things so I encourage the hotel to do it soon!!!

user_reviews.Name: AbuDhabiSwithers
user_reviews.Description: Booking.com lists the Grand Palace as a five star hotel, but it was suspiciously cheap compared to other five star hotels in Addis Ababa.||My suspicions were confirmed when my airport pick-up didn't turn up, some of the staff weren't very helpful and my room felt very dated and lacked basic things like a fridge, curtains that are as wide as the window etc.||On the plus side, the location is excellent with lots of good restaurants and bars nearby, and the breakfast was great. ||So set your expectations for "good three star" and you'll be fine. If you really want five star then accept that you'll need to pay three times the price and go to the Hyatt just down the road.

user_reviews.Name: L C
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I stayed here twice during my trip to Ethiopia, and it truly felt like a calm, elegant base in Addis. The rooms are clean and spacious, with great showers and very comfortable beds. The staff are professional, warm, and helpful, they even kept my main suitcase safely while I was in Lalibela.

The location is perfect: you can walk almost everywhere, and there are great spots nearby like Little China and Mezzeh Salad Bar, both super convenient for quick meals. Everything about this hotel made my stay easy and pleasant. I love it, and will definitely be back here during my future stays in Addis!

user_reviews.Name: Dev Singh
user_reviews.Description: Hotel infrastructure is awesome. staff is polite. All information provided properly at reception. Food quality is good. Service is good. Room cleanliness is good. They have less toiletries is the washroom and bathroom are less spacious.

user_reviews.Name: E. Arthur Phillips
user_reviews.Description: The staff are very polite and helpful. The breakfast was fresh with good variety and flavour. Electricity went off at least once per day but usually for less than 3 minutes at a time. I stayed in a single room and the place was simple clean but the bathroom finish was a bit rough in terms of the shower and the sink. There was no air conditioning or heating in the room. Fortunately it was cool to chilly rather than hot. The usual expected bathrokm amenities were present. The foyer and dining area are well appointed. There no parking or disabled access with frequent vehicular congestion on the street outside. The service, the food and the price commend my experience here.

user_reviews.Name: T6598SYhassana
user_reviews.Description: Grand Palace has excellent customer service. People are very friendly, and the food is always delicious. The breakfast buffet is superb, with a large variety to select from. I would recommend this to all types of travellers, including business and holiday travellers. Enjoy your next stay.

user_reviews.Name: 924dinahn
user_reviews.Description: The hot shower is amazing , the rooms are well maintained and big in size . The view at the balcony is breathtaking and the staff services are amazing. The food is delicious and the location access to banks , parks and museums is quite impressive. I would definitely recommend

user_reviews.Name: Derek Braun
user_reviews.Description: Great location, beatiful lobby and entryway.  The service was excellent.  A minor miscommunication with our room assignment but everything was made right.  Rooms/ bathrooms were clean and comfortable.  The breakfast food menu needs a complete revision. Transportation to the airport.  Overall, great experience, will be staying here again!

title: Stayeasy Hotel | Haya Hulet | ስቴ ኢዚ ሆቴል | ሃያ ሁለት
address: Haile Gebre Silase St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Unpretentious budget hotel offering an international restaurant & a bar, plus parking.

owner.name: Stayeasy Hotel | Haya Hulet | ስቴ ኢዚ ሆቴል | ሃያ ሁለት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Trvljhn
user_reviews.Description: I stayed here for almost two weeks in September 2019. For the price, it is a good deal. It’s particularly good if you will be there less than a week because otherwise you may start to tire of the lack of variety on the breakfast buffet or tire of having your bathroom get soaked every time you take a shower (to be fair, that’s not unique to the hotel; it’s a pretty standard design in Ethiopia). If you are wanting a fancy hotel experience, then go elsewhere (and pay a lot more). But, if you are a budget-minded traveler looking for a clean hotel, this is a really good fit. I would stay again.

user_reviews.Name: snowythepyro
user_reviews.Description: We booked this place ourselves after looking for a good hotel for a 23 hour layover. After landing at 9am, we were met by our transfer driver as arranged, our room was already ready, and we could just enjoy the locality. I was feeling delicate so in the end we didn't actually go out, but ate in the hotel restaurant. It was a good meal, very recommended. We had a good night's sleep and our transfer was ready first thing in the morning. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: HeleneQuebec
user_reviews.Description: Very good price, free buffet-breakfast, restaurant open 24hres, super clean rooms, wi-fi router on each floor, free airport shuttle, quiet place as it's located 100m from the main road, few steps from  the green line city train,  excellent  customer service, this place is more than perfect for 1 ou 10 days staying!   I really feel like home.  Mr Lemma the gen. mgr do everything  for your stay be perfect. ||I highly recommand this hotel.  ||Helene, Canada

user_reviews.Name: rfalckphoto
user_reviews.Description: I wish I could write a better review for this hotel given that the staff is very friendly.||I had booked two nights through Expedia.  I had contacted them prior to my arrival to let them know that I would be arriving early in the morning as my flight arrived just passed midnight.  It took a couple of emails for them to understand the time and day I was arriving (I assume that was a matter of timing being treated differently in Ethiopia)||They offered a free airport pickup,  which I appreciated.||I was given a room on the fourth floor right below a water pump which was noisy the entire night.  I asked for a change of room, but they were full ( good for them).|They accommodated a change of room for the following night.||I extended my stay for a third night which I did it in person ( not through Expedia).  They would not honor the same rate as I had for the first two nights (they charged $15 more),  which was a disappointment.

user_reviews.Name: HaitiAfrica
user_reviews.Description: It was our first trip to Ethiopia. My husband and I were obviously anxious and a bit nervous about our trip but we were presently surprised how easy our stay was from beginning to end. On arrival the shuttle van was there to pick us up which was very comforting. It was a short and scenic root from the airport to the hotel. We were staying in the country for a month and had plans to visit different regions but make Addis our base. Our guide recommended other hotels on our return back to Addis but we were so impressed with the level of service at Stay Easy, we decided to make it our host hotel for the entire trip. ||||Centrally located to the bustling city of Addis, all of the major cultural and historical attractions were a taxis ride away. We even met a taxis driver through the hotel that we used for most of our trip. He also organically became our City guide. The hotel concierge even offered me his personal mobile phone to use to keep connected to the driver. ||||The food is amazing and very inexpensive. Ethiopian Cabernet wine from Rift Valley, which was a true discovery for us is. At this hotel, It’s only served by the bottle. Their buffet provides a variety of options which includes traditional Ethiopian breakfast and an omelette bar. Everything is fresh. ||||The rooms and bathrooms are a bit small but they are cleaned daily. WiFi is on every floor and is not as strong but we were there on vacation and didn’t rely on the internet as much. ||||Overall, just as the title of the hotel, our stay was more than easy it was home. Every staff member treated us like a Queen and a King and a Sister and Brother.  ||||It’s a great place to take a stroll and feel like a local. Lastly, with the current pandemic situation, everyone wore a mask 24.7. They also arranged for us to get a COVID test in preparation of our departure in which they provided free shuttle service. The test was around $13 US and took 24 hrs. for the results. ||||I would definitely recommend STAY EASY if you are looking for comfort, affordability, great service and a great location.

user_reviews.Name: Mfmsworld
user_reviews.Description: My first time staying here, I stayed for two months. I've probably stayed here over 20 times over the past 4 years. It's my second home in addis. I recommend it to all my friends.The staff are so accommodating, the location is central, and the place is super clean. I now have a home in addis, but I still stay here anytime I stay out late. Also, I swear they have the best vegan food and their kitchen is VERY clean. Their shiro is better than tsige shiro and azmera shiro. The fasting fitfit and fasting spaghetti with tomato sauce are also on point. I even order food from them when I'm not staying there. Again this is a no frills type of place..nothing fancy, but I genuinely feel like its way better than all those higher rated hotels near Edna mall. Stay here!

user_reviews.Name: debworton
user_reviews.Description: We used to stay at the Stay Easy a few years ago when we lived in Ethiopia. Pleased to report that it is still a good choice. Location is 100m from the tram stop at Getfam which will get you to Macanegna and Meskel Square, and is good for buses to Bole, Arat Kilo and beyond. It is also handy for the airport.  ||OK, the Stay Easy is tucked up a tiny little side street but don't let that put you off. It is up the unmade road 50m just past the Axum Hotel (which all the taxi drivers know) in the direction of the Holiday Hotel.  Both the Axum and Holiday have big illuminated signs so you should have no trouble, even at night. There is a bank virtually on the corner with handy ATMs.||The staff are incredibly helpful and breakfast is good. However, the rooms are small and if you are travelling with a lot of luggage you might want to consider a superior room.  Another drawback is that, as with so many buildings in Ethiopia, there is no lift/elevator so you might get a bit of extra exercise ;-)

user_reviews.Name: ዳግማዊ ሰለሞን
user_reviews.Description: What a small hotel with a great hospitable service. The staffs are very friendly and actively working to satisfy guests. It is really beyond my expectations. The standard room is small sized but, it was clean and attractive. We have also found a nicely prepared guest feedback writting paper. We also liked the complemetary breakfast. The price is fair. We had a nice and memorable stay. We will definately come back.

title: Debre Damo Hotel | haya hulet | ደብረ ዳሞ ሆቴል | ሀያ ሁለት

user_reviews.Name: gasabag
user_reviews.Description: Excellent hotel services. People at the reception  and gym. Kind people always ready to attend guest's request. Restaurant is good youbwill always get something you can select depending on your culture.  The security people are humble and always ready to help. The guest relation Seble is always ready to assist when you need it. I recommend this nice hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Shahadat Hossain
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Demo Hotel, and it was truly a wonderful experience! 🏨

The rooms were clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated. The staff were extremely polite, helpful, and always ready to assist with a smile. The food was excellent — the breakfast had a great variety of items, all fresh and delicious. 🍳

The location is also perfect, close to all the key places in the city.
Overall, if you’re looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay, Demo Hotel is absolutely a great choice! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

user_reviews.Name: faith maina
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed here for a month. I really enjoyed my time here. The staff were really amazing and mostly the ones at the restaurant. The room was always cleaned very often. I got to try out different traditional foods while at the hotel and I can say I loved it.
My only concern was the poor internet connection. As a foreigner, the only way I could reach out to my family was via WhatsApp before I could purchase a local line. The internet would get so slow for a better part of my stay there and whenever I asked, I was told to give it sometime it's gonna be back. Please work on this.
Otherwise, everything else was amazing

user_reviews.Name: erardm2025
user_reviews.Description: The room is superb, my breakfast was good and Ms Seble Guest Relation was very professional thanks for the service you afford me 🙏

user_reviews.Name: Aleem Shah
user_reviews.Description:
I really had a good stay at this hotel. Staff is cooperative and nice. Good restaurant with rich Ethiopian food and nice rooms. It is located on a main road near market to shop as well.
Don't miss their breakfast.

user_reviews.Name: habiibaa2025
user_reviews.Description: Hotel is nice room and food best |They treat there customers well internet good|I had tried the gym they have a traners every thing is goodthanks

user_reviews.Name: queni2025
user_reviews.Description: I came with my friend and we were happy by the service food was good |Room was nice the people who are inside the hotel was helpful thanks

user_reviews.Name: STEWART PETER MATOVU
user_reviews.Description: The night I was there, I slept on the 8th flow. I could see the beauty of the whole of Addis Ababa. This hotel has good customer care and good looking self-contained rooms. Though the power sockets were not friendly to charge phones or laptops, this should perhaps be revised for complete comfort.

title: Stay Easy Plus Hotel/ስቴይ ኢዚ ፕላስ ሆቴል
address: 3P8M+33J Stay Easy Plus Hotel/ስቴይ ኢዚ ፕላስ ሆቴል, Beside Total Petrol Station, Addisu Gebeya, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
