complete_address.street: 3P8M+33J Beside Total Petrol Station, Addisu Gebeya

user_reviews.Name: mohidenb2025
user_reviews.Description: My stay at Stay Easy Plus Addis Ababa was overwhelmingly positive, and it's a place I would confidently recommend to other travelers.||||From the moment I arrived, the staff were the highlight of my experience. The front desk team was professional and efficient during check-in, and the concierge offered excellent advice for getting around and finding local restaurants. They always greeted me with a smile and were quick to assist with any request.||||I stayed in a Standard Queen Room. It was modern, spacious, and, most importantly, impeccably clean. The bed was very comfortable, with quality linens that ensured a good night's sleep after long days of meetings. The blackout curtains were also very effective. The room was well-equipped with a flat-screen TV, a safe, and a mini-fridge. The free Wi-Fi was fast and reliable throughout the hotel, which was crucial for my work.||||The bathroom was modern and generally well-maintained. The water pressure in the shower was great, though I did experience a couple of instances where the water temperature wavered unexpectedly between warm and cool. The toiletries provided were basic but sufficient.||||The hotel's location in Addis Ababa is quite convenient. It was easy to get a taxi, and it felt like a safe area. While it's not directly in the bustling heart of the city like Bole, it offers a bit more peace and quiet, with several good coffee shops and restaurants within a short walking distance.||||I had breakfast included in my rate. The selection was decent, featuring a mix of Ethiopian staples like injera with shiro, as well as continental options like pastries, eggs, and fruit. The coffee, as you'd expect in Ethiopia, was excellent. My only minor critique is that the hot buffet items were very similar each day, and a little more variety would have been welcome.

user_reviews.Name: Trail15830170635
user_reviews.Description: My stay here was truly wonderful. The location was perfect, the atmosphere was relaxing, and the staff were incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout my visit. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, making the whole experience even better.|I enjoyed every moment and genuinely appreciated the level of care and attention to detail. This place exceeded my expectations, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable stay

user_reviews.Name: feysal2025
user_reviews.Description: My experience with Stay Easy hotel is very fantastic. The location is good. The atmosphere is excellent. The room is very clean. The value is good. I don’t have any noise problem. The service is very very great. The amenities good for me. The property is situated in a convenient location for me. I am satisfied in this hotel. I am recommended stay easy hotel for anyone who want to staying in hotel in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: davidaJ7226ES
user_reviews.Description: The hotel was quite nice, we liked staying there. Positive points were:|- The staff was friendly, and was happy to help us if we needed anything.|- They provided us with an electric heater when we complained our room was too cold.|- Breakfast included local cuisine, sweets, freshly made omelets, waffles or pancakes.|- They provided a free shuttle to pick us up and to drop us off at the airport which was very helpful.|- Good housekeeping, clean room.||Things we were neutral about:|- It's a bit out of the way from the rest of the city, but it was still easy to get by throught the taxi apps ||Unfortunately, a few things weighted down on the experience:|- Our room had a very bad sewage smell that came from the bathroom. Other friends staying at this hotel did not have the same issue so maybe we got unlucky on our floor.|- When we first arrived at the hotel there was only one towel available, so we had to ask for an extra (only on the first day of our stay)

user_reviews.Name: Alazar.M Mekonen
user_reviews.Description: I attended the hotel as a wedding guest. The hall was outstanding and so was their staff. The esthetic starting from the lobby to the restaurant and the hall were all modern, catchy and well put. They also had plenty of parking available for guests. From my perspective the hotel is outstanding the only thing is the location. Had this been around Bole or somewhere closer it would have done numbers, regardless I loved the hotel and their cooperative staff.

user_reviews.Name: Annie Jtone
user_reviews.Description: We visited this hotel and it was by far the best experience for our entire trip. The staff goes above and beyond to ensure they provide quality service. They are always pleasant when providing service. The atmosphere is warm and comforting. Highly suggested if you want to experience the culture.

user_reviews.Name: emilyjK571LA
user_reviews.Description: The room was modern and up to date, the staff were friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again. It is a bit out of the way but with the help of ride share apps getting around Addis was easy.

user_reviews.Name: akamerel
user_reviews.Description: We stayed for 4 nights and the rooms were good. The food and service was also good and in all  value for money!  We wouldn't mind a return visit

title: Jupiter International Hotel | Kazanchis | ጁፒተር ኢንተርናሽናል ሆቴል | ካዛንቺስ
address: 2Q89+V7C Jupiter International Hotel | Kazanchis | ጁፒተር ኢንተርናሽናል ሆቴል | ካዛንቺስ, Tito St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Casual hotel offering dining & a bar with live music, plus free breakfast & local/airport shuttles.

owner.name: Jupiter International Hotel | Kazanchis | ጁፒተር ኢንተርናሽናል ሆቴል | ካዛንቺስ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Kanchan P. Adhikari
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed for three nights and had a wonderful experience. The location is excellent, the hotel is clean, and the room was spacious with very comfortable and clean beds. Breakfast was great, and I also had lunch and dinner, the food was delicious.

The front desk staff were very helpful and kindly provided me with early check-in after a long journey, which I really appreciated. The gym, sauna, and relaxation facilities were impressive even better than many 5-star hotels I’ve stayed at.

Highly recommended for a comfortable and relaxing stay! 👍

user_reviews.Name: anonymous333
user_reviews.Description:
Ethiopian Airlines arranged this hotel for me in transit.
I was transferred from the airport to the hotel by a van with other people.
Check-in was smooth and the hotel room was spacious. However, it seemed a bit old and simple.
Breakfast was free, but the buffet had very little variety and I could hardly eat anything.
The reception staff was not polite, so don't expect perfect service. However, I won't complain because I was staying there for free.

user_reviews.Name: CR2015BXL
user_reviews.Description: Stayed here five nights. UNECA around the corner. Room (bed) OK. That’s about it. No hot water after 9am. Very low water pressure. Breakfast buffet literally empty after 8:30am. No service at all: tables not cleaned, no cups, coffee etc provided. Staff just standing there chatting. Reception soso. Renovations ongoing, noise during day. Definitely needs renovation. Not impressed for price.

user_reviews.Name: Hansjörg Oeltzschner
user_reviews.Description: The whole night there had been a lot of noise by a nearby generator and in front of the hotel terrasse there is an ugly dump site of building material and opposite of the hotel is a big construction site. The lobby is very poor and heavily used. I  can not recommend this hotel!

user_reviews.Name: jeremy dannheisser
user_reviews.Description: We had a layover in Addis Ababa and managed to change to the Jupiter Hotel. What a pleasure. The traffic from the airport was insane (almost 1 hour for 2km) however when we arrived the staff were amazing. The front desk asked us if we wanted quiet or a view and then when we got to the room, phoned to see that we were happy. Very clean and very comfortable, it was a very pleasant overnight stay. The organised airport transfer back was on time. I would recommend it absolutely

user_reviews.Name: richardpW4329WP
user_reviews.Description: Everything went well with my stay of four nights for a business trip: efficient airport shuttle transfer both ways, my room was upgraded to deluxe without asking, great breakfast buffet, kindly gifted a pack of Ethiopian coffee to take home, internet worked throughout with no problems, sauna and gym to unwind, and a decent menu of local and international food in the restaurant. Highlights: warm and friendly staff at all times; spotless room cleaned to the highest standard; relaxing in the sauna.

user_reviews.Name: Munyaradzi Nyamande
user_reviews.Description: Amazing place. Had a corner room with great views of the city. Witnessed the Great Ethiopian run from my room

user_reviews.Name: Tourist Gobe
user_reviews.Description:
I had a wonderful experience at Jupiter Hotel in Addis Ababa. The hotel is very well located in Bole, close to the airport, restaurants, and shopping areas, which makes it very convenient for travelers.

The staff are warm, professional, and always ready to help with a smile.. The breakfast buffet had a great variety of Ethiopian and international options—fresh, delicious, and filling.

What I especially liked was the cozy atmosphere and the attention to detail in service. The hotel also provides reliable airport shuttle service and fast Wi-Fi, which made my stay even easier.

Whether for business or leisure, I highly recommend Jupiter Hotel. It combines modern comfort with genuine Ethiopian hospitality.

title: Radisson Blu Hotel, Addis Ababa
address: 17/18, Kazanchis Business District Kirkos Subcity, 1000, Ethiopia
description: Contemporary pick with free Wi-Fi & breakfast, plus brasserie-style dining, a gym & spa services.

user_reviews.Name: youssefk643
user_reviews.Description: The experience was good in total. |Selamawit who shares with us the Ethiopian Coffee at the main terrace, was absolutely amazing. |She came with us after her working hours to visit and grab some souvenirs.|She didn’t grab any tipp for that, she was genuinely helpful and really welcoming. |She made our stay better and it was an amazing encounter to meet her. |Hope to see Selamawit again in our next business trip

user_reviews.Name: Nadia Olson
user_reviews.Description: We had a wonderful stay in between our in country trips. The staff were helpful, friendly and very accomodating. It was wonderful to be able to use the SPA, great therapists,.good treatment and wonderful staff. Would definitely stay again.

user_reviews.Name: Zani Ethiopia
user_reviews.Description:
I had an amazing experience at this hotel! From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, welcoming very professional. The check-in process was smooth, and I was pleasantly surprised by how clean and spacious the room was.

The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the room had all the amenities I needed — fast Wi-Fi, complimentary water, and a beautiful view. Housekeeping did an excellent job every day.

user_reviews.Name: Melanie Mchinzi
user_reviews.Description: I had a great stay, friendly staff from housekeeping all the way to the porters. Good breakfast and lunch and very clean rooms. Azarias at reception exceeded my expectations at checkout and went out of his way to ensure my shuttle pick ups were settled. I will definitely stay there again. Good corporate space if you have meetings in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Jaubert Yelkouni
user_reviews.Description:
I was truly impressed with my stay at the Radisson Blu in Addis Ababa.
I would like to express my deepest appreciation to Yegle from the restaurant team for his outstanding professionalism, kindness, and courtesy.
My sincere thanks also go to Tesfeye, the driver, for his constant availability and warm attitude.
A big shout-out to all the staff!

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Getachew
user_reviews.Description: I had an amazing experience at the Radisson Blu thanks to Lidiya at the reception. She was warm, professional, and incredibly attentive. From the moment I arrived, she made me feel welcomed and valued. Her friendly attitude and efficient service truly elevated my stay. Thank you, Lidiya, for your outstanding hospitality!

user_reviews.Name: Sthe Ntlhabane
user_reviews.Description:
I had an extremely distressing experience at the Radisson Blu Hotel at Addis Ababa. During our stay, my friends wallet  was stolen, and what was most disappointing was the complete lack of empathy, concern, or willingness from the hotel staff to assist us during this traumatic incident.

In addition, the handling of our airport shuttle arrangements was highly unprofessional. Our travel agent requested a payment link for the shuttle, but the hotel failed to respond. On the night before our departure, we approached reception to confirm the payment, only to be told that our agent had not paid and that the payment link is not working because there is no network

The situation escalated further when hotel staff requested our agent’s credit card details, which we clearly stated would be illegal and inappropriate to share. When we asked for the hotel’s bank account details to make payment, we were told that they were not allowed to share them and that we should instead swipe a card on site to pay for the shuttle as they are doing us favor by asking for our credit card details. The name of the person at the reception is Lidiya

Overall, the experience was chaotic, poorly managed, and deeply unsettling. At no point did we feel supported or cared for as guests. Instead, we were made to feel like outsiders, left to navigate a stressful and unsafe situation on our own. This fell far below the standard of service one would expect from a hotel of this calibre.

user_reviews.Name: Subhash Gunatilaka
user_reviews.Description: I went to Addis Ababa on holiday for one week and stayed at the Raddison Blu. The accommodation was excellent and I cannot speak highly enough of the staff  who made me feel at home with their incredibly warm nature. Every morning I received the warmest welcome from Etsegenet and Haymanot at breakfast, which was always a great start to the day. I would also like to say a special thank you to Ketema and his team for their kindness and perfect hospitality. Namely David, Habtamu, Mintesinot, Yaregal and many others.

title: HomeTown Addis Hotel
address: Cape Verde St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Cmarcelk
user_reviews.Description: We spent a couple of nights at Hometown in December 2019 and really enjoyed our stay. The rooms are very comfortable and clean, breakfast buffet is fantastic, and Wi-Fi is really good!|And the overall service is great. Equally important, it's in a great location, with onsite bar and restaurant, as well as a multitude of nearby options for great local and international food/cafe etc. the owners Kirubel, at hometown Addis were amazing, and looked after us like family Staff is more than willing to set you up with transportation or directions. Awesome value. Nothing was too much for them. We highly recommend and are very thankful|

user_reviews.Name: My1000MilesTV
user_reviews.Description: Clean room, very helpful staff and the most comfy hotel bed I have slept in so far. Fridge in the room was great, but I missed a desk and a chair (there was no place to sit except for on the bed). No AC, but that was ok because it was not hot in the night. The breakfast could be better. Boring selection of food, although great coffee. Overall a great value stay!

user_reviews.Name: Mr Sunzela
user_reviews.Description:
Nice hotel with very friendly staff and an exceptional manager who really cares about his guests. The rooms are nice and mostly clean, only the carpets should undergo a proper cleaning as they have many stains.

I stayed here several times, of which one time, the Wifi didn't work for 2 weeks which was very unfortunate. All other times there were no internet issues though.

The restaurant is not to recommend, I ordered Pasta with tomato sauce and vegetables, and got plain pasta with vegetables, but no sauce. Many dishes are not available. The buffet in the morning changes and is okay, however, for reasons I don't understand, the hot dishes such as fried vegetables or eggs are in warming boxes, but without any heat, so it was cold each time I went to breakfast, no matter at which hour.

Considering the price, the location, the rooms and the staff I would still come back here anytime.

user_reviews.Name: danielhaile
user_reviews.Description: Stayed at this hotel for a little over 3 weeks and it definitely made our stay much more comfortable. Very clean rooms, staff is friendly, and front desk/management are extremely accommodating. The location is near Edna mall, popular restaurants/bars around Bole, and 10-15 minutes from the airport. I would definitely recommend this hotel to first-time travellers in Ethiopia, and will be returning myself for my next trip.

user_reviews.Name: Marianne-Loic
user_reviews.Description: We wouldn't recommend the hotel as we had a terrible experience all the way apart from when the manager took the matters into his own hands. The staff is absolutely unfriendly: when we checked in we were barely told where our room was, we had to carry the luggage all the way to the third floor (which is alright but you wouldn't expect that from a 3 star hotel). The room didn't have towels, paper toilet and the room door wouldn't close and open properly. We had to ask several times for the staff to move us to another room, after they had a few laughs they finally moved us to another one. In the morning they have a poor breakfast buffet thus we asked for eggs for breakfast. When they arrived uncooked and we requested to have them cooked longer the waiter raised his eyes and was rude to us. Finally when we requested cabs, the reception arranged us rides that 2 times out of three ended up terribly. 2 didn't know their way so we had to direct them around, 2 surcharged us, and the cherry on the cake : one had a cockroach on the passenger seats and bumped his car. You would expect from a hotel to have minimum customer service, friendly staff and reliable recommendation in terms of transportation. We were supposed to stay 6 days, we immediately changed hotel the next day.

user_reviews.Name: D. Mwosh
user_reviews.Description:
This is one of those place you definitely want to put up your executive staff if your planing business in Addis. the Facilities here are very good plus the occasional thing we all ask WiFi .the best you will find plus has good speed. If you fell like unwinding a little they have their own bar ,and if the bar isn't enough for you night clubs aren't far from the Hotel.
Good customer service with exceptional skills.

user_reviews.Name: Mo Aumann
user_reviews.Description:
Great location close to the bustling southern part of Addis. Burger restaurant, Pizzeria and rooftop bar just next door! Approx. 10 minutes drive to the airport. Attentive staff, good accommodation for good rates compared with others in Addis. Good to know: loud steel workshop in the same street, so head out early.
No elevator. Book breakfast after checking what's available.

user_reviews.Name: Latiesha Johnson
user_reviews.Description:
I initially only booked 3 nights because of the mixed reviews, but my 3 night stay turned into an 11 night stay because Kerubel and the entire staff was so kind accommodating.  My late night check-in was easy.  The next morning when I went down to get some introductory information for Addis Kerubel showed extreme hospitality and was very personable.  He offered me breakfast even though I had missed breakfast by about 30 minutes.  He also gave me good information on where to get my SIM card and how to stay safe around the city.  I was in one of the larger rooms.  I had a comfortable work desk, two chairs and a small table.  The wardrobe had plenty shelves to unpack and the room also had a refrigerator.  The hot water was consistent and the water pressure in the shower was strong.  I had several meals at the hotel because I was mostly in my room working and the food was consistently really good and very reasonably priced.

Things to note:
1.	If you need airport transfer on arrival make sure you speak to someone and confirm.  I booked last minute so I didn’t have a lot of time to arrange the shuttle pick up.  On the 6th I called and didn’t get an answer so I sent a message thru Expedia about needing shuttle pickup at 12:15am on the 8th.  When I landed and called I was told the shuttle had to be pre-arranged and that they didn’t have anybody to pick me up. I took a taxi because I read in another review that the ride should have been 150-200 Birr.  I was over charged 400 Birr so be sure to confirm taxi rates before you ride.
2.	There is no lift but there was someone available to carry my luggage to my 3rd floor room when I arrived and to bring my luggage down for my departure.
3.	If you are sensitive to noise there is the constant running of machinery at the shop next door from about 9am – 5pm.  I am sensitive to noise but it wasn’t that bad if I had the window closed.
4.	There is no air conditioning or heat, but I didn’t find this to be a problem. During the day the temps were about 75 degrees and the room stayed comfortable.  At night the temps dipped to the 50’s but the bedding was plenty to keep me warm.
5.	The power outages that people speak of in other reviews are city wide so you will experience this no matter what hotel you stay at.  They didn’t last too long.

title: Elsol Hotel-Addis Ababa
address: 2Q7M+3V4 Elsol Hotel-Addis Ababa, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Nate ናትናኤል
user_reviews.Description:
I have stayed in many hotels before, but this one is very special. All the rooms are very clean, and the staff are very helpful. A big thank you to the amazing Betty for going above and beyond, she showed me all the rooms and amenities, answered all my questions, helped me order dinner late at night, and even gave me a phone charger when I really needed one. I am very grateful for her kindness and support.

Of course, there are a few ways to make the guest experience even better. First, phones should be available in all rooms. Second, it might be better to call this place a “guest house” since it doesn’t serve food or drinks apart from the complimentary breakfast, which I must say was DELICIOUS. Lastly, adding some paintings in the rooms and at the reception, and using the reception TV to show guests the available amenities, would make the place even more welcoming.

One more thing, the website mentions that this hotel has a spa, which is misleading. I hope the owner updates this information. On a positive note, the wedding hall is ABSOLUTELY BEAUTIFUL!! Another suggestion would be to provide an ashtray in each room to prevent guests from leaving cigarette butts and ashes in the flower pots.

I really can’t wait to stay here again on my next trip. This place definitely deserves 10 stars!

user_reviews.Name: Arone Tamene
user_reviews.Description: The best hotel  and very peaceful the rooms are clean with delicious morning breakfast. If you want to spend a great time with your family or alone, the best place to stay!! I highly recommend !!

user_reviews.Name: G. Ivan Bascon
user_reviews.Description:
Not excellent, but a good stay. The staff at the desk, front door, and cleaning service were very attentive, friendly, and considerate. I appreciate their work very much. The hotel lobby is spacious and looks very good. The room also looked very decent. They also give free coffee in the morning, but it is limited to only one cup.

However, the hotel sometimes would have power outages, no water due to a broken pump, and very spotty wifi connection. Dogs would also be barking early in the morning that would wake me up.

user_reviews.Name: bereket yohannes
user_reviews.Description: I have experienced a very good time here I had a great time. Everything was comfortable and attractive and worth the price. All the services were complete and I was able to find what I needed. The best hospitality and welcoming employes, and the most peaceful and clean rooms, with a great breakfast in the morning. If you want to spend a great time with your family or alone, the first place i recommend is Elsol Hotel. It is 10/10.

user_reviews.Name: Eden Alemayehu
user_reviews.Description: Such loving staffs they have an clean rooms 😍

user_reviews.Name: Tarik Sotalei
user_reviews.Description: A great staff, clean rooms,  comfortable beds and a yummy breakfast

user_reviews.Name: adnan musid.
user_reviews.Description: "I had a wonderful stay at ELSOL Hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff were incredibly welcoming and helpful, making check-in a smooth and pleasant experience. The room was comfortable, clean, and well-maintained, with all the amenities I needed for a relaxing stay. I especially appreciated the costumes service. The location was also perfect for exploring the area, with many attractions and restaurants nearby. I will definitely recommend this hotel to friends and family and look forward to returning in the future. Thank you for making my trip so enjoyable.

user_reviews.Name: Freddy Voorhees
user_reviews.Description:
Elsol Hotel was exactly what we needed during our stay in Addis. It's a new establishment, with well appointed rooms and facilities, which also happen to be extremely clean and comfortable.

The staff were amazing and everything from check-in, breakfast, and check-out was done with a warm and friendly smile.

It's a great value for money hotel in Addis, and we'll definitely be back next time we're in town.

title: Getfam Hotel
address: Haile Geberesilassie Street, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Polished hotel with city views & a free airport shuttle, plus a spa, an indoor pool & a restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: dave Yohannes
user_reviews.Description:
Unfortunately, my stay at Getfam Hotel was negatively affected by the receptionist’s behavior. During my interaction at the front desk, the receptionist was unfriendly, unhelpful, and spoke in an unprofessional manner. I did not feel welcomed as a guest, and my questions were not handled properly.
I was visiting my girlfriend during her layover in Addis Ababa, and she was accommodated at this hotel by Ethiopian Airlines. When I arrived to meet her, I was asked to pay an additional USD 20, which I accepted, as I understand hotel policies. However, the following morning I was informed that I had to leave the hotel by 8:00 a.m., and I was also asked to pay another USD 20 for breakfast. This did not seem reasonable to me, especially given the short stay. While the food may be good, I found the price excessive under the circumstances.
Overall, the hotel itself is worth staying at, but my experience was negatively impacted by the front desk staff on duty at that time. I do not wish to generalize, as I believe other staff members on different shifts may be more professional.

user_reviews.Name: Beauty Belinda Mwiinga
user_reviews.Description:
Been here twice and i would come back a thousanf times!
Fresh food everyday all day!
Friendly, cheerful and hardworking staff! They make you feel like the most important guest they have received. All this is always consistent!!

user_reviews.Name: Jörg Haas
user_reviews.Description: Hotel with good quality and reasonable prices. Could be qualified as 3 to 4 star hotel. Staff is well trained and polite, the rooms clean and well functioning. Location is a bit difficult, a loud street at the front.

user_reviews.Name: Tabish Shahid
user_reviews.Description: Best hotel in Addis Ababa! The staff is extremely cooperative and helpful in every way. Even the security guards accompany you at night to ensure safety. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Chukwuemeka Nwegbu
user_reviews.Description: The staff were wonderful and super helpful. The waitresses would anticipate my needs before I even voice it out. Zemeni is my favorite.

user_reviews.Name: Cally Morgan
user_reviews.Description:
Overnight stop when flights were delayed - hotel allocated by Ethiopian Airlines.

Very basic food and rooms but found the staff friendly and accommodating.

Used the Spa for a full body massage and the salon for my mani and pedi and was extremely satisfied

Was cautioned not to leave the hotel as my safety alone in the streets outside could not be guaranteed, so to while away the time went to the Spa in the hotel and probably had one of my best full body massages ever

user_reviews.Name: Michael Zhuwao
user_reviews.Description: It's a nice and neat hotel. Their rooms are clean although some parts are falling apart and could use some repairs. Overall satisfied with service.

user_reviews.Name: Aleya Noel
user_reviews.Description:
I was given this hotel during a long layover in Addis with Ethiopian airlines. It's definitely fine-- clean *enough*, but it's seen better days. Everything is a bit worn down and old; in the room, lampshades were falling apart, and some wall paneling wasn't in the best shape. There are holes in the bathroom walls and ceilings leading to no where-- a sign that repairs were made without proper cleanup.
The food was good, lots to choose from with a very attentive staff.
If I had to stay here during a layover again, I wouldn't be upset, but I wouldn't pay for a room in this hotel.

title: NEW DAY HOTEL | Hayahulet | ኒው ዴይ ሆቴል | ሃያሁለት
address: 2Q6P+CX7 NEW DAY HOTEL | Hayahulet | ኒው ዴይ ሆቴል | ሃያሁለት, 22 Mazoria Djibouti Street, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Unpretentious hotel offering informal rooms & suites, as well as a restaurant & a bar.

owner.name: NEW DAY HOTEL | Hayahulet | ኒው ዴይ ሆቴል | ሃያሁለት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: GORDHAN SINGH
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful hotel..room are big and nice very clean all staff are so friendly we all....restaurant also nice for Vegetarians also....we will back again.....nice service.....only need to change all towels... other all are so nice..

user_reviews.Name: jehad Alqahtani
user_reviews.Description: Great hotel and great staff… I stayed there so many times and I feel that they are my family

user_reviews.Name: Esther
user_reviews.Description: The place is dirty and outdated. Found many hairs in my bed, the room was missing a curtain and there was loud music outside until 3am. Could hear my neighbours and the elevator through the thin walls. Breakfast was terrible as wel. Staff was also unhelpful. When checking in at 11pm they could not inform us about breakfast or pickup time the next morning. Instead, they called to the room at 6:40 rudely waking us up. At 8am the staff tried to rush us to the bus while we ended up waiting in the bus for 40 minutes before we finally left to the airport.

user_reviews.Name: OnAnAdventure8
user_reviews.Description: I was on an overnight stay there, so the hotel is relatively quite far from the airport and we went down some very dark small streets to get there...then the dinner staff seemed unprepared for our arrival, so after waiting a long time for the van, we had to wait a long time for the dinner (which was 4 types of carbohydrates -_-) The room itself was fine but most frustratingly, for a hotel that Ethiopian airlines is using for their overnights, they only wanted to do one shuttle in the morning for 12 people going back to the airport, EVEN THOUGH our flights were spread out over several hours, seemingly because it would save them money? Their night manager and receptionist gave me opposite information and options, they were incredibly unwelcoming and passive aggressive, not accommodating at all.

user_reviews.Name: Teresa Franze
user_reviews.Description: We spent 4 weeks in Newdays hotel. The staff have been exceptional in making sure our stay was comfortable and enjoyable.  We have been pleasantly surprised by their excellent customer service in so many ways. We felt at home  and could achieve so much of the purpose we came to Addis for. The only downside are some of the shops nearby who play music very loudly until 9.30 pm, but other than that, we highly recommend this hotel, it is that good!

user_reviews.Name: Amir Moosavi
user_reviews.Description:
I spent there several times. I was happy with them. But this time they made me so sad and upset. Cuz i had a group of clients and according to my last experiences i thought they will give some discount to me. I arranged everything according to this. But they behaved so restricted and they charged me 50% more than last time. I didn’t have any other choice so I decided to stay again.
But it will be my last time to come this hotel. The staffs are good but the management is so bad. They don’t know how to respect with their old clients to keep them. Next time never i will come here again.

user_reviews.Name: Littlest Ghost
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is located in a very noisy area and is not very sound proof. The rooms are clean, and the food at the restaurant is absolutely fantastic. However, the elevator was incredibly slow, it was faster to carry the luggage up the stairs. The shower head in the room wasn't working, if you opened it to big it would spray water over the top of the shower. The water took forever to heat up and the temperature was hard to control. The wifi was really bad, with most of the time having no connection.

user_reviews.Name: John Cimir
user_reviews.Description:
Had to stay there for a night. The staff are very friendly and helpful, they do their best but many of them still have a language barrier.

Hotel itself is a budget friendly city hotel, shouldn't expect much. It is not located in a fancy neighborhood but 10 minutes to the Airport.

title: Tafach Hotel
address: 2Q92+MXG Tafach Hotel, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Johnny Tsegaye
user_reviews.Description:
Greetings,
As owner of this hotel I welcome everyone with a hospitable and enjoyable stay thats affordable, clean and lively.

user_reviews.Name: Nati Abe
user_reviews.Description: Was a great experience. Best price in town

user_reviews.Name: Maedot Afework
user_reviews.Description: Amazing experience and great hospitality!

user_reviews.Name: Micki
user_reviews.Description: Clean rooms and very hospitalble

title: De Leopol Hotel - Bambis | ዲ ሊዮፖል ሆቴል - ባምቢስ
address: Bambis, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: De Leopol Hotel - Bambis | ዲ ሊዮፖል ሆቴል - ባምቢስ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Q3245GYleilam
user_reviews.Description: We came with with our band and children.  It was exceptional.  Staff were friendly.   Food was GREAT. Loved the rooms.... Very spacious and loved the fact that every fixture was working top notch.  LOVE AND RESPECT TO ALL THE STAFF AND MANAGEMENT!!

user_reviews.Name: Abinet Adelahu (AA)
user_reviews.Description: I went there to attend the recent bazar and it was amazing. They had free coctails and a lot of items for sale. Out of those items were, cookies, cloathes, cups, furnitures, and other decorating items. They had quality and beautiful materials there. The hotel was also great. I suggest that you all go there and visit that place. Plus it's located at a suitable area for everything. I hope you enjoy your stay there.

user_reviews.Name: AVA Mineral Water
user_reviews.Description:
The worst hotel to have weeding the  food very bad . barely 3 coke or Fanta on table  for 10 people. even though we paid for gold service buffet staff bad abusive only salad main course very bad I would not suggest to anyone to make weeding there very bad experience.
It was so sad for the groom and bride they destroy their weeding.

user_reviews.Name: Zoe Nat
user_reviews.Description:
Very Disappointed – Please Be Cautious If You’re Booking Your Wedding Here

I had my wedding at this venue on July 19, and it was a huge disappointment.

First of all, some of our personal items were stolen, including a traditional Kurt and an entire 16kg cake, which was never served. When dinner started, one of our friends—who had also had a wedding at this venue warned us to double-check everything. Thankfully, we did, because we discovered serious issues.

We invited 300 guests, but the venue only prepared for 249 people we were missing 51 plates and drinks! This is completely unacceptable for such a large and well-known hotel. I have never seen such a lack of professionalism or care from a venue of this size.

The management was completely unresponsive and showed zero interest in resolving these issues. It felt like they only cared about taking our money, not about delivering the service they promised.

The only person who tried to help was the sales manager, Gelila. She did her best, and we appreciate her efforts, but she was the only one on the team who showed any responsibility.

If you’re planning a wedding here, please make sure your family checks everything carefully—every plate, every drink, every item—because we would never expect such poor service from a supposedly high-end hotel.

user_reviews.Name: 19imperialm
user_reviews.Description: Location is central to everything. Very pleasant and helpful staff; excellent customer service. Rooms are very clean and comfortable. Good breakfast too.

user_reviews.Name: Sanjana Raaina
user_reviews.Description: Worst hotel I have ever stayed at. Rooms are absolutely filthy and disgusting. No ACs, too many mosquitoes and worst of all rude behaviour by manager. No help provided when complaints were made and I am not a fussy person. Lift doesn’t work, maintenance is so so bad. I would never wish this hotel even upon my worst enemy. Sofas have mould, toilets are dirty. Just disgusting.

user_reviews.Name: Dr. Khalid
user_reviews.Description: Best hotel. it is always my choice when I come to Addis All the staff are very friendly and helpful. The manager ( Angelina) is the kindest person who always asks about my  comfort .

user_reviews.Name: Yonas Barke
user_reviews.Description:
I had the pleasure of staying at De Leopol Hotel with my family for a couple of weeks, and our experience was truly wonderful. The hotel staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful, ensuring that our stay was comfortable and enjoyable.

The amenities were excellent, and the hotel's location was highly convenient. One of the highlights was the complimentary breakfast, which offered a fantastic variety of both traditional Ethiopian dishes and international selections.

I will definitely consider staying here again in the future and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great hotel experience.

title: Comfort Zone Hotel | ኮምፈርት ዞን ሆቴል ሃያሁለት
address: 2Q5J+J8P Comfort Zone Hotel | ኮምፈርት ዞን ሆቴል ሃያሁለት, Mickey Leland St, Addis Ababa 9292, Ethiopia

owner.name: Comfort Zone Hotel | ኮምፈርት ዞን ሆቴል ሃያሁለት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: demetrie2022
user_reviews.Description: My stay at the Wudasie Castle Hotel has been amazing!!! When I first walked into the doors of the hotel, I was greeted and welcomed by staff! After paying for the cost of my stay, I was handed the keys to my room. When I entered my room, It felt like I was home! The colors of the room and decor brings a warm feeling that brings comfortability and peace! Everything was clean, sanitized, and organized. The bed was so comfortable that I almost wanted to skip out on my planned activities just to lay down and relax in it! ||The highlight of my stay was experiencing Christmas with the staff. I’m from America and Christmas was on December 25th. I was invited down to the lobby to enjoy some Ethiopian traditions with staff. I got to experience a “coffee break,” where everyone drank coffee, ate bread and popcorn. The bread was so fluffy and moist that it almost feels like you’re chewing on some clouds or pillows lol. That’s how good it was!!! It was my first time having coffee ever and I must say it was amazing! Although, I am not coffee drinker, when I’m at Wudasie Castle Hotel, I will be drinking the coffee!!||Last but not least, I recommend Wudasie Castle Hotel to anyone looking to stay in a comfortable hotel that reminds them of home. The prices are great if you are someone not trying to break the bank. It comes with delicious breakfast every morning as well! If you get hungry during the day, It is located near lots of food restaurants/spots to eat! Customer Service was a 20/10!! From the moment I walked in until I left, Staff always were welcoming, respectful, and as the people in your home would, treat you like family. They will help you out with anything you need! I never knew a hotel could make you feel like you’re home!!

user_reviews.Name: RCherries
user_reviews.Description: I enjoyed my stay. The front desk and lobby were nice. My room was big for a single, and nicely furnished. ||The staff members were always friendly and happy to help. ||I ate at the restaurant several times. Always good. Good coffee, too.||The location is not a regular tourist location. It's more like a local neighborhood. I was able to walk to anything I needed.||I would definitely recommend, and stay again.

user_reviews.Name: mccormack08
user_reviews.Description: My son recently stayed at the Wudasie Castel Hotel in Edinburgh for 9 days from Dec 14th 2019. He was on his own and got into a little difficulty with some local tourist guides. My son is also Deaf and uses sign language, so communciation was difficult and he was taken advantage of. The manager of this hotel was incredible and I cannot thank him enough. Not only did he provide support to my son, by letting him borrow a hotel mobile (my son's mobile phone was stolen on his second day which caused him considerable distress), but he intervened with the two guides and provided reassurance to my son and a safe, place to stay. I do not know what he would have done without this kind and thoughful man's assistance (he even ensured that my son was driven to the airport safely on his final day) and I hope to visit Addis Ababa one day and thank him in person.||||The rest of the review is being dictated by my son. He says that it was very clean, friendly, accessible to the airport, very good value for money, helpful. The food was also very good adn the views form the roog were ' great'. He adds that a woman was showign off Ethiopian coffee in teh hotel adn he tried some. It was delicious.

user_reviews.Name: dennise901
user_reviews.Description: My first time in Ethiopia.  I was picked up late on a Saturday night.  The driver was very informative and I settle in nicely at the hotel after checking in with a good receptionist.  I was surprised to see such night activity in the streets below.  I decided to stay inside after a long flight from Boston Massachusetts, USA.  I did enjoy a good breakfast the next morning and the lounge was adequate for having coffee and tea the following day.  The room was large and outfitted with local decor.  The WiFi was adequate and the services good.  My only issue was the noise level at night.  Weekend nights are active until 2 AM and if you prefer to sleep at night you should ask for a room higher up in the hotel and away from the street side.  I like the location as it was on the main road and close to my office where I work when in Addis.  Overall, I give it a good rating.

user_reviews.Name: Isaac Moges
user_reviews.Description:
Wudasie Castle Hotel | Hayahulet | ውዳሴ
I like it very much. It fill like home, away from home. Staff and management are very nice and extremely helpful. Respective, they're willing to help. They taking care of you like your own family,  They also offer free WiFi and airport shuttle. There's also a wonderful breakfast with nice varieties. They also offer shuttle services for local runs at a small fee. The rooms are big and have a balcony for a great view of the city from the balcony. Also nice for chilling in the evening. The bed is very comfortable for a great night sleep. The sheets are clean and the bed side lamps are amazing. The location of the hotel is nice. Not very far from the airport or the main city areas. Local restaurants are also within walking distance. Some bars and clubs are close by too if you fancy wild nightouts. Other occupants here are varied but I think made up of tourists mostly. It's a nice avenue for a great connection and conversation The cost of accomodation here is also very affordable. You don't have to break a bank to have a good time in Addis Ababa if you choose this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: F. A
user_reviews.Description:
Only positive, the staff were absolutely great! Friendly, helpful and very polite.

Nothing works!!
Wifi - not working, was told for a day it was getting fixed, to finally be fixed then not work in our room!!
Cable TV does not exist, first night we were told it was getting fixed that night, then got told 3 days later that infact the hotel had not paid the bill therefore had been disconnected. When it came to pay for the stay, though the availability was clearly stated on the website, their card machine did not work- had to do international transfer to ourselves, go to the bank and get cash (this was a lot of work and avoidable stress).

The breakfast is average, though the menu says fruit included it was unavailable. The kitchen was often closed so unable to eat at the hotel.

Couldn’t sleep, surrounded by bars and clubs so noisy 24/7 and windows are not soundproof.

Extremely dim rooms, couple of the lights did not work, so come evening the room was quiet dark.

The room lacks many things. Despite stating on website, no bathroom amenities were supplied, stingy on the toilet paper, no tea or coffee making equipment in the rooms.

Would never stay here again or recommend to anyone.

user_reviews.Name: Solomon Shiwabaw Mulu
user_reviews.Description:
Well, the receptionist of the hotel is welcoming and helpful. The hotel has a credit card payment option.
However, the hotel is not as exact as what you could see a bunch of pictures in the reservation sites, maybe those pictures belong to when the hotel was launched.
The toilet stinks, there could be no hot water sometimes so don't be surprised, even you can't balance the hot and cold water lol.

Well, breakfast is included. It's not that much hard to find the location of the hotel and it's not too far from the city center or the airport. They have a free pick up and drop up service from and to the airport.

user_reviews.Name: 133lizj
user_reviews.Description: Very standard for the price. The rooms were clean. I could only give it 2 stars because of its location. We stayed there for 1 night. We did not sleep all night due to the fact it is located next to a bar/disco. I must say the staff members are amazing, very helpful and friendly. The driver was remarkable.

title: Elilly Hotel
address: 2Q79+VMJ Elilly Hotel, Guinea Conakry St, Addis Ababa 9568, Ethiopia
description: Simple accommodations in an elegant hotel with 6 bars & restaurants, plus a spa & an outdoor pool.

user_reviews.Name: jacquelinetheresam
user_reviews.Description: This could be a lovely hotel but the rooms are tired and the linen and towels are of poor quality.  I stayed in a room in the B Block and moved to one in the A Block.  Although the A Block is marginally better and is accessed by a lovely lift, the rooms are still not good enough.  The bathrooms are overlooked by neighbouring buildings so require some sort of opaque covering on the windows, so long as this let light in as the rooms are generally quite dark and the lighting is inadequate.  I saw sparks coming off the sockets when I plugged things in and there's no air conditioning, windows or ventilation unless you open the doors to what seems to be a balcony, but with no furniture and also closely overlooked. The food in the restaurants and at breakfast is not very good either.  But this hotel has a good location, a nice entrance and lounge area really lovely staff. The lounge cafe serves a lovely local tea with ginger and other spices.  I particularly liked one of the housekeepers whose name I think was Beisa (not sure of the spelling) who dealt with issues quite quickly and very professionally. Wifi is first class so I was able to work which was an added bonus. This is a hotel with a lot of potential but it needs a lot of work.  The owners must not get complacent due to its location opposite the UN EAC compound so that it always has a supply of guests.  It needs to offer its guests something better.

user_reviews.Name: Wiz Awaz
user_reviews.Description:
I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for the wonderful experience I had during my recent stay. It was truly great to relax peacefully and enjoy some leisure time.

I would especially like to commend your staff, particularly the reception Taye Solomon and his team. They were absolutely amazing and contributed significantly to making my stay so pleasant.

Thank you once again for the excellent service. I look forward to visiting again in the future.

user_reviews.Name: liwangzhangz
user_reviews.Description: During my stay, I liked how calm everything felt. It was the ideal place to relax and forget about the stresses of daily life. The entire area reflects comfort. The lights and friendly staff made it feel like a place where you could truly relax. The staff took really good care of everything.

user_reviews.Name: Sathish Vijayan
user_reviews.Description: This hotel doesn’t have Air Conditioning. They will trick you with the one which they have a split AC but they won’t provide a remote hence you can’t use them and they won’t provide a fan as well. Rooms will be dirty and sophisticated. There won’t be power from midnight to morning & during the day the power will be on and off. Their Manager Tewodres (Teddy) won’t help you with anything but just pure fake promises. This hotel doesn’t respect customer satisfaction, all they need is your money. Staying in this hotel is a nightmare and pure wasted of money. Pathetic breakfast. This hotel is not a 4 Star one but a 2 Star below average hotel. Old rooms with broken items.

user_reviews.Name: Andy Hicks
user_reviews.Description: The staff here are wonderful. However, the rooms are definitely not 5 star - perhaps 2 to 3. Specifically, without air con or even just simple fans, mosquitos are a real problem since the windows don’t have screens. Simply supplying fans to the rooms would resolve this.

user_reviews.Name: J5147GSruthh
user_reviews.Description: Elilly is really an awful hotel. Check-in is a disaster. Expect to take anywhere between 60-90 minutes to check in. Meanwhile, you will have to stand at reception without any update as to what is happening or any reasons for delay. Staff are inexperienced and none of their systems work: bookings were cancelled, key cards for rooms did not work, my room had no wi-fi, TV did not work, there is no airconditioning, some people even had rooms without towels. One of our group was kept waiting for 2 hours in the middle of the night before being sent off to another equally mediocre hotel. About a decade ago, this was a reasonable five-star hotel. Now, it should not merit two stars. Avoid this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Ali Radman
user_reviews.Description:
Excellent location, Excellent customer service and support, clean and i will return again in the coming future. I recommend Elilly hotel to all travels who wants to to enjoy the real hospitality in style.
Thanks to the management and all the staff and support who made our vacation a success 🙌

user_reviews.Name: Paradise469490
user_reviews.Description: The rooms were nicely lit, comfortable, clean, and beautifully decorated. Staff are friendly and hospitable. Food was delicious and atmosphere pleasant. I enjoyed my stay here.

title: Nahusenay Hotel
address: 3P5Q+284 Nahusenay Hotel, Addisu Gebeya, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Lalam Ermi
user_reviews.Description:
I am extremely disappointed with the level of service I received at this hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff showed a lack of professionalism, attention, and basic customer care. Requests were ignored, communication was poor, and the overall attitude of the service team was completely unacceptable.

A hotel should make guests feel welcomed and respected, but instead I experienced the opposite. This experience was frustrating, inconvenient, and far below the standards expected from any hotel.

seriously improve their service and staff training!!!Nov 24 /11am

user_reviews.Name: girum Yilma
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been to Nahusenay hotel a couple of times and always enjoyed it. The food is tasty and the service is friendly.I liked chicken berest even It’s a nice place for a small group or a date night.thanks Lidya to recommend me the place

user_reviews.Name: mazin Ali
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is wonderful and the staff are very friendly. The hotel is quiet and away from the noise.

user_reviews.Name: nebil ahmed
user_reviews.Description: The place is good. But doesn't have a generator, at the time i was there there wasn't water for shower.

user_reviews.Name: Mohamed Elhadi
user_reviews.Description: Excellent service and great rooms, everything is perfect ,The place and the food

user_reviews.Name: Amare Adbaru
user_reviews.Description: Great spot for a small and medium wedding

user_reviews.Name: BEIMNET GUTA
user_reviews.Description: Excellent service and great room

user_reviews.Name: Paulos Nedaw
user_reviews.Description: absolutely fantastic spot to hangout in.

title: SOCIAL HOUSE ADDIS ABABA | ሶሻል ሀውስ አዲስ አበባ
address: Mickey land street, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: SOCIAL HOUSE ADDIS ABABA | ሶሻል ሀውስ አዲስ አበባ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Insos Jawa Get Lost Safely
user_reviews.Description:
We had such a wonderful experience at Social House that we decided to extend our stay and upgrade to a larger room. We stayed in both a King Room and a Junior Suite, which gave us a great perspective on the property.

The staff here is truly exceptional—friendly, efficient, and quick to respond to any issues. When our window wouldn't close properly, they fixed it right away. The hotel offers unbeatable value for money; for the price, the service and quality are outstanding. We also loved the food served at the restaurant, and our son really enjoyed the drawing sessions held on Saturdays.

The rooms themselves are a mixed experience. Our King Room, while a bit smaller than expected, was very quiet, had an extra-large bed, and came with a lovely balcony. The Junior Suite was incredibly spacious, with a large terrace, a kitchen, and a dining area. Having our breakfast delivered to the room was a great convenience.

However, we did encounter a few issues. Our King Room was quiet, but we were surprised by the significant noise in the Junior Suite, which was not as peaceful. We were woken up by loud music at 4 a.m. several times and even by construction noise at 2 a.m. on one night. The internet was often inconsistent, making the TV unusable. A power outage also caused some of our electronics and lamps to burn out. While the staff was quick to help, some repairs took a few days. The bathrooms in both rooms felt narrow, and our shower head was broken. We also noticed the dining chairs in the suite were in disrepair and the kitchen lacked utensils. Lastly, getting our luggage to the top floor without a lift was a challenge, though the staff was very helpful.

Despite these challenges, we truly enjoyed our stay at Social House. It’s a great find that provides a high-quality experience for the price, and the excellent staff makes all the difference.

user_reviews.Name: Guido Lanfranchi
user_reviews.Description: Great place, with cozy environment, very hospitable staff and a really nice atmosphere! Excellent quality price ratio, super recommended!! Only little negative note is internet that doesn't always work super smoothly

user_reviews.Name: Malak Azemco
user_reviews.Description: The bathroom bulb is not working nor is the water heater. They have been working on them for an hour while we are in the proberty. Taking from our privacy. They offered another room which is of lower facilities than the one we are having. Even with this much of time nothing is working, they are saying they may fix it tommorow. The room has no refrigrator, no boiler, not even a spoon, plate or a cup. Moreover, if I want to ask for something I have to go down 2 floors in stairs as there isnt a hotline phone. At the beginning, I went down to asked for someone to come and check those infunctional stuff. They didnt come. After a while, I went down again. To be honest, the staff in general, but specialy the reception girl is nice. But I guess the organization, maintenance, and administration is disastrous

user_reviews.Name: joseph alecio
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to stay the entrance is a bit hidden, rooms have good Internet, hot water and clean. There is no shuttle service included in the booking just an fyi

user_reviews.Name: Joseph Leo
user_reviews.Description:
This is a far nicer guesthouse than we were expecting. Even though the rooms are relatively basic, the building and facilities are very nice and we especially enjoyed the large indoor dining area and outdoor courtyard. We were not expecting the free morning breakfast but it was exceptional and we sampled something different from the menu every morning. We also enjoyed the location as there are some small neighbourhoods nearby where we enjoyed spending most of our first days in Addis.

-- I am aware that other reviews have expressed disappointments with their stay here, however, our experience superb. The staff especially, from the manager and reception and every single server and cleaning staff were all kind and generous. Thank you all.

user_reviews.Name: Sara O
user_reviews.Description:
The manager and the chef in the mornings made my entire stay perfect! They catered to my vegan diet on request by preparing some amazing food for me. Very kind manager helped me out with international calls to the airline when I had an issue. As a female solo traveler, this place felt very safe and the manager gave me tips on what to do around the city.

The aesthetic of the place is very modern and charming. It’s also right in the middle of the city with access to the main roads just a few min walk away.

Rooms are comfortable. I stayed for 8 days and would definitely return!

user_reviews.Name: Mo Ishag
user_reviews.Description:
Terrible hotel and terrible experience! Staff are lazy and non welcoming and very rude!

Rooms have cockroaches.

Next to a construction site.

Manager is always busy with issues (more important than you!)..

They don’t take your concerns in a serious nor caring manner. They only care about getting their bill paid!!

Food is under expectations.

And don’t forget the clogged bathroom showers. Always!

Totally non-recommended and waste of money.

user_reviews.Name: Fedor Ivanov
user_reviews.Description: Digital Nomads! Warning for you. The internet they have is horrible. It's so slow, it's worse then not having any. In that case you at least won't hope

title: Grandlagar hotel Mexico
address: 2Q72+J9G Grandlagar hotel Mexico, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: R
user_reviews.Description:
Don’t choose this hotel. It’s is the most disgusting 🤮 place I have ever seen. People who work at reception are lazy and they don’t know what to do & how to fix the problem. Surprisingly the owner also told u she don’t know what to do if something happen😂🤦‍♀️. They’re unprofessional, and selfish.
Guys let me tell u my story, I stay in this hotel more than eight days but in different weeks with in a month. Their price to the rent varies every week for the same room . The break fast is included but at 7 am only “firfir”left. If u are lucky u will get coin size pancake 😂😂😂. The only reason I stay there was when I was out of the country my husband reserved the hotel and after I reach there I was sick.
The day before yesterday we reserve 2 double rooms and 1 single room I don’t want to stay there but my dad has heart problem so he can’t not use stairs and they have an elevator and good location for the hospital. But our decision was wrong the room that is given to my dad and mom has a problem. The rest room was not clean and the toilet was full of …🤮 it’s not working at all. My mom realized after 2 hr of stay and she told me,  then we try to explain to them but nobody want to talk with u and the owner 🙈 try to hide her self😂. But the issue was serious for us so we wait her for more than an hours imagine she is in the building and it’s almost 10 pm. Finally I told her the problem but she told me I’m late to report this. Then I said ok can u change the room for my family because my dad is diabetic too so he used restroom frequently. Then she said if u want to change ur room just pay another 2200 birr. And she bring another brilliant idea that is “or they can use bucket 🪣 as a restroom 🚽”. Imagine u pay 2200 birr for the room with out toilet and disgusting smell 🤮 🤮 . Guys I just want let u know that this hotel is scam. Even there restaurant is expensive but their food doesn’t test good. If u stay there don’t use the restaurant there are a variety of restaurants in walking distance. Check everything in the room while u pay including 🚽😂. Grand lager hotel is FAKE!

user_reviews.Name: Lou 1Love
user_reviews.Description: Best location! Located in the financial district. About quarter mile from the central station (la gare). The rooms are super clean and very reasonably priced. Breakfast is good. have not tried the lunch or dinner menu so can not say much.

user_reviews.Name: Shamsher Iqbal
user_reviews.Description: The staff was very nice and coprative.Atmosfare was very good .specially  the manager is so nice. person she was very coprative.i recommend  this hotel to every one

user_reviews.Name: Sami Samile
user_reviews.Description: That’s me amir from London I stay a week almost this hotel is so clean . Stuff is amazing so kinds & frindely & security is  highly secure beds is so comfortable location is central to all activities I really recommended to visit this hotel I forget internet so good in restaurants & both rooms. I get this hotel recommendation one of my colleagues that is true so excellent with the price convenient.

user_reviews.Name: LIGHT HUM
user_reviews.Description:
I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Adis Ababa. It is clean, center, secure, and provides a peaceful environment for a restful sleep. The staff are also well-trained and possess exceptional communication skills.

Teferi

user_reviews.Name: Ghirmay Negussie
user_reviews.Description:
Very good Hotel,is in the center of Addis,clean,efficient.
The staff are very kind honest,helpful,I reccomend,price is reasonable.
You feel as if you are at your home.

user_reviews.Name: Lalo
user_reviews.Description: Nice clean and quiet .Centrally located in Addis financial district in downtown addis.A few blocks from the historic Central station (grand la gare ) which was built by the French over a century ago.

user_reviews.Name: Jeff Richards
user_reviews.Description: Clean and quiet, great atmosphere for dining. Close to airport. Friendly staff, great macchiatos. Good value for the money

title: Kuriftu Entoto Resort and Spa
address: 3PHV+73 Kuriftu Entoto Resort and Spa, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Patrick Beard
user_reviews.Description:
I believe I have found one of the national treasures of Ethiopia!
After several days of working in a prison medical clinic I took our team to this resort. I had heard it was good, but it was more than good - it was amazing!
The air is clean and cool. It is located on a mountain that overlooks Addis Ababa, But you feel that you were in the countryside. The permanent tented camp is clean and comfortable. The staff is extremely accommodating. The restaurant is open 24 hours and has a good variety of dishes to offer. The included breakfast buffet was as good as anything I've had at the Hilton. And if you are interested there are lots of activities like a zip line and horseback riding. Our team thoroughly enjoyed the spa. World class massage in a beautiful environment. And I'm not just saying this, I had some of the best Buna in all of Ethiopia at reception.

Can you tell I love this place? I would give it 10 stars if that was possible.

One last note - security and concierge was everywhere. At night our ladies were escorted to their tents. Very nice touch!

user_reviews.Name: hannagirma 1627
user_reviews.Description: I had an adventurous and memorable time. I never thought I’d find such a peaceful and green spot in Addis. The view of the city was fantastic. The restaurants served delicious food special thanks to Yared. The staff were very polite and humble.

user_reviews.Name: Blaine (ብሌን)
user_reviews.Description: Such a beautiful and peaceful place! The staff were so kind, attentive and welcoming. I went to relax by myself and I felt safe and welcomed to places I went to. Reliable internet, electricity and water. The food was delicious. Highly recommend for anyone who would like to enjoy the weather and the relaxing vibes of Entoto. It will probably be one of my sanctuary every time I go to visit Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful place with serene jungle vibes and fresh air perfect escape! The view is absolutely stunning, especially at sunset. Getting there takes time, but they’ll arrange a ride from the gate to the resort if you call them. Once you arrive, the warm welcome and friendly service make it worth it. Food is decent, view steals the show!

user_reviews.Name: mamush Adane
user_reviews.Description: I had the worst jacuzzi ever! It’s very unclean and doesn’t even have power, and the bed is my second worst it’s not even fixed well and tried to reach reception and they told me it’s every room!

user_reviews.Name: Oksana Specht
user_reviews.Description: Roman was a great server! We enjoyed the service of all the staff and we loved our experience.

user_reviews.Name: Yohannes Tewoldeberhan Tsehai
user_reviews.Description: Had an amazing yoga and meditation retreat and delicious veggie and hummus bowl for lunch thanks to Weini and Mahi!

user_reviews.Name: mirali doshi
user_reviews.Description:
The place is nice . However the service and management is extremely poor. They start cleaning jacuzzi at 4 pm . So you have to use jacuzzi in the sun before 4. And they don't have milk for breakfast. So you can't have cappuccino macchiato etc . We had a baby with us , we could get her milk because they were out of milk .

So please think twice before visiting the place as you might be deprived of basic services after paying full money

title: Mazeki Addis Boutique Hotel
address: Addis Ababa, Bole Sub city Behind Capital Hotel and Spa, 50 m off the Bulgaria Embassy 27687, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: Addis Ababa, Bole Sub city Behind Capital Hotel and Spa, 50 m off the Bulgaria Embassy 27687

user_reviews.Name: Alice Lam
user_reviews.Description:
The hotel lobby is beautiful and the complimentary breakfast is quite nice for the price. The staff is also quite pleasant and helpful.
The room itself was decent but we were tormented by mosquitos at night, even if we keep the windows closed (we literally killed 30 in one evening). It was also very loud outside, as our room was facing a bar which played loud music until morning hours. We experienced mosquitos at other hotels in Addis but it's especially bad in the particular room we stayed.

user_reviews.Name: Gemadi Bekuto
user_reviews.Description: This place was okay. They say they offer a shuttle but no shuttle showed up at the time of my arrival. I asked for the driver’s number before I arrived but there was no number provided. I had to pay 1000 birr to get a ride from a taxi driver. What’s more maddening is that they kicked me out of my room the same day that I checked in. I was supposed to check in at midnight on the 17th and check out at midnight on the 18th (picture attached below). But instead they rushed me out of my room before midday on the 17th. When I requested that the manager talk with me, he/she refused. Really poor service and I will not recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Abubakar Noor
user_reviews.Description:
It is a wonderful place to stay in Addis. The staff are very polite and helpful. The breakfast was also nice, not many options but served with care and hospitality.

The rooms are spacious and quiet.

The hotel manager was an awesome guy. And the airport shuttle service is really helpful as well.

I have stayed multiple times and I hope to come back to Mazeki when I visit Addis.

user_reviews.Name: isaiah michael
user_reviews.Description: The hotel has a nice service and quick-to-respond staff. However, the shower had no curtains even though there was a rod hung up.

user_reviews.Name: Jurek Szimmuck
user_reviews.Description: Price Performance was excellent. Rooms are spacious and clean. Still some things missing like television or shower curtain. But the service was brilliant. Breakfast was good with national and international options. They offered us to order breakfast to the room! They were very flexible with our booking and storing luggage. One funny downpoint which can be forgiven easily, the rooms were equipped for one person (one pillow, one towel) but they helped us immediately.

user_reviews.Name: Ivan Idiodi
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is ok, staff are nice and ready to help make your stay comfortable. Food is good with different options. The rooms are spacious, however cleaning can be improved. If you are a traveller passing through Addis, you can get a socket adapter in order to charge your device.

user_reviews.Name: Mohaiminul Muntasir
user_reviews.Description: Nice place to stay. They have airport shuttle and complimentary breakfast.

user_reviews.Name: Abdellah Regragui
user_reviews.Description: Excellent service. Free airport shuttle, wifi and breakfast. Ideal location. Clean, comfortable room. Friendly, courteous staff. All excellent.

title: Debre Damo Hotel, Addis Ababa
address: 2Q8P+M3G Debre Damo Hotel, Addis Ababa, Hayahulet Mazoria, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Givson Obang
user_reviews.Description: i was having a wonderful time am happy too see this the room the food and the customer service were amazing am gonna busy you while i be in addis

user_reviews.Name: Farrukh Hyder
user_reviews.Description:
Rooms were neat, clean and organized but food was not upto the mark.
They need to improve in food section.

user_reviews.Name: Arone Tamene
user_reviews.Description: This is one of the best hotel in Addis to anyone who goes there I will highly recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Ahmad Ibraheem
user_reviews.Description: I had a fantastic stay at this hotel. The rooms were spacious and comfortable, offering breathtaking views. The staff was attentive and went above and beyond to ensure a pleasant stay. The amenities, from the landscape to the dining, were top-notch. The location was also perfect, with easy access to attractions. Overall, it's a wonderful choice for both business and leisure travelers, and I can't wait to return for another exceptional experience.

user_reviews.Name: Alon Diamant
user_reviews.Description:
Maybe it was because I arrived via Ethiopian Airlines when my flight was delayed, but they put me in the worst room I could imagine. Dirty rug, dirty bathroom, window to a garbage filled roof (with someone's used pill blisterpack being the highlight), the room was run-down and the walls and ceiling were breaking down. At least the bed was fine. It kind of reminded me of a cheap hotel I slept in, around 2012, in Honduras near the main bus terminal.

By the way, the shared areas were dirty too. Near the stairs was a small courtyard that was full of empty plastic bottles and other garbage. They didn't clean it for a while, clearly. (See video.) So maybe it wasn't just because I was in a cheap bad room.

As for the staff, the airport shuttle staff was nice, but the hotel staff was ridiculously rude. I arrived at 7am (after waiting from 10pm the previous day, to 5am, to get a hotel voucher from Ethiopian Airlines), dead tired, and when at 8am I asked the reception staff for a toothbrush, she suddenly asked me what my room number was, checked her papers then said I have to leave at 9am. What?? I just arrived an hour ago. She then said, okay - 11am. I couldn't believe it. I didn't even rest 10 mins in the room, it wasn't even ready, I had to wait in the breakfast area. They were already trying to get me to leave so the airline could pay them for another person. And my next flight was at 7pm! Did she really expect me to go back, after 9 hours wait for the room, to wait another 12 hours in the airport? I told her, no way, I am not leaving before 4pm, I am going to resr. And she gave me a sour stare and said okay fine, and said she will send me the toothbrush to the room. Which she eventually did. In general that was their attitude, all about money and you are an inconvenience to them.

The breakfast was warmed up pancakes and cake from the day before, maybe some other cooked stuff I couldn't recognise, and some bread and jam. It was all stale of course. I ate very little, but the coffee and milk were fine. I skipped lunch. No idea how that was.

In general, this was one of of the worst hotels I have ever been in, there were many hostels (yes, with dorms and shared bathrooms, not even hotels but hostels) that I stayed in which were leagues cleaner, more comfortable and more modern and nice. Not to mention friendlier.

If you stay, I hope you don't come via the airline, maybe your experience will be different. Good luck!

user_reviews.Name: Omoseyindemi Omowunmi
user_reviews.Description: The hotel boasts an elegant reception, but the service falls short. Encountered a roach in the room, and the front desk seems indifferent about airport shuttle arrangements, lacking proper planning. Called for the concierge to help with my luggage from the 5th floor , I had over 4 bags, waited for close to 20mins after the call and they never came . I had to struggle to get my luggage to the elevator. The breakfast experience is disappointing, with an untidy spread, dirty plates, and shabby tablecloths, among other unsightly issues. The bartender at the bar was super helpful and friendly.

user_reviews.Name: Tata Conde
user_reviews.Description: I like every thing in this hotel i like the all service

user_reviews.Name: Ilide Henrietta
user_reviews.Description: Happy to be here and I enjoy very much
