user_reviews.Name: Zegeye Sisay
user_reviews.Description: Our stay at the Residence Hotel & Apartment/Olympia was great! The room was clean & comfortable. The staff and their services was fantastic! The fast WiFi, the location were perfect and a huge plus. The breakfast service was incredible.

user_reviews.Name: Andy
user_reviews.Description:
The staff  members Hanna, Alem & Tigist are very friendly and helpful, always greeting me with a smile, going above and beyond to assist with any requests.
The breakfast is delicious, with options to choose and their makiato incredibly good.
The guy who is serving breakfast, whose name is Getu, is very polite and kind. He well knows how to treat customers. Thank you Getish.
The location itself is  great for public transportation and shopping malls.
I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable experience.
Andy

user_reviews.Name: CurtA82
user_reviews.Description: This was a pretty decent hotel. Yes, its on a dirt road, a bit off the beaten track but its still relatively easy to find. The rooms are really big and comfortable. We didn't have AC in our room, which I know can be deal breaker for some but for us it was fine. You are in Addis, so you will hear noise with the windows open but I'm not sure where you can escape that. We checked in early in the morning and paid an additional $50- some hotels will waive this if you're lucky but we fully expected to pay. Everyone was really nice and pleasant and there's a little seating area outside the front of the hotel where you can have a drink and despite being in a built up area, you do get the sun. The breakfast was so so. There is adequate choice but obviously the ingredients they use in Ethiopia are different so bread/toast, croissants are not what I'm used to but still completely fine. I would recommend the omelets- they maybe a bit overcooked for some people but I personally think they're the best thing on the menu. The shuttle bus to and from the airport is very convenient and depending on demand, will leave/arrive whenever you want it to. ||||We had a full day city tour with Desii, including some of the key sites/attractions in the city and a food tour where we were taken to places that we probably wouldn't have stumbled across ourselves but were very very good. You can contact Desii at desale.dorze1@gmail.com, +251940198738

user_reviews.Name: Mihireatab B.
user_reviews.Description:
We recently had the pleasure of staying at The Residence apartment hotel for 16 days, and I can confidently say that it was an exceptional experience. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by the front desk lead, Massresha, and his colleagues. Their hospitality and attentiveness were truly remarkable, and they made our stay all the more enjoyable.

Massresha, in particular, was a standout member of the hotel staff. He was incredibly friendly, accommodating, and always went above and beyond to ensure our comfort. He was always available to answer any questions we had and offered helpful recommendations for things to do and see in the local area.

The apartment itself was spacious, comfortable, and beautifully decorated. The daily housekeeping service was exceptional, and we were always impressed by the attention to detail shown by the staff.

Overall, our stay at The Residence was truly unforgettable, and that's all thanks to Massresha and his colleagues. We appreciate all their hard work and dedication to making our stay a memorable one. We look forward to returning to this hotel in the future and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a luxurious and comfortable stay in the area.

user_reviews.Name: Nyivuru Resper
user_reviews.Description:
My stay at the Resident Suite in Addis Ababa was truly exceptional. The room was not only amazing but also equipped with everything I needed, including an ironing board, flat iron, hairdryer, and fridge, among other things, making my stay incredibly comfortable.

The customer service was outstanding, with prompt and attentive assistance for all my needs, including breakfast served in the room by a wonderful chef. The receptionist, whose name I unfortunately forgot to ask for, was incredibly helpful. I wholeheartedly recommend the Resident Suite to anyone visiting Addis Ababa.

Thank you, The Resident Suite, for making my stay so memorable and comfortable.

user_reviews.Name: Michelle CPT
user_reviews.Description: A great option in Addis.  For transit, it is very conveniently located close to the airport. Rooms are very spacious with huge bed, seating and work areas, and en suite bathroom. The staff are friendly and helpful. Decor is quite dated, but is in much better condition than the other hotels I've stayed in Addis. Plus lovely touches like a traditional Ethiopian throw on the bed.

user_reviews.Name: GraysonK
user_reviews.Description: The property is old and dusty but perhaps that was part of its charm.  Don’t expect any luxuries. Don’t expect the staff to understand or speak English perfectly. Don’t expect AC or for the hotel to provide a fan. ||The property is located off a dirt alley about 400 meters from main drag. The local residences surrounding the property all have multiple dogs which bark in unison all night long with each passer by the alley. There are roosters that start cranking up around 4 am.  Bottom line...bring ear plugs or crank up the white noise app on your smart phone.  ||The breakfast was very basic but being free it was priced right. The ordinary menu was adequate and priced well. Local Ethiopian Beers are priced below a dollar in the restaurant so you can’t go wrong with trying the various choices over course of the stay. ||The Indian restaurant nearby is good. The VERY local cuisine restaurant around the corner specialized in goat and was very good for the more adventurous gastrophiles.  ||||

user_reviews.Name: Q7796SHjessicam
user_reviews.Description: So comfy! Such nice and accommodating staff! The rooms are huge, very comfortable, and affordable at the same time. I will definitely stay here again - they have been so great, I've felt welcome, and as a constant business traveler that isn't always the case. And I love the room.

user_reviews.Name: marsettt
user_reviews.Description: I loved the experience. It was clean, quiet and close to the airport. The staff was very hospitable, I'm definitely coming here again

user_reviews.Name: Manuel Silva Gallego
user_reviews.Description:
Booked a room with Booking, it was confirmed, when I got there they said they had no rooms available.

Answering to C Fun: I booked from Sat 15th to Sunday 16th. I message the hotel on Saturday to warn that I was landing in Addis next day at 6.45am, and my intention was to have just a place to rest until checkout time 12pm. I called them and they confirmed that my room would be available at 7am on Sunday 16th. When you book a room it should be blocked for you until checkout time, which is 12pm in the following day but they just gave my room away even though they confirmed over the phone that it was ok to go there for just a few hours and be able to get some rest.

user_reviews.Name: NB135
user_reviews.Description: The rooms are large and clean with comfortable beds and always had hot water in the shower. At reception the staff were helpful and the manager was very friendly on the way from and to the airport during the drive of the free shuttle. Breakfast is good and the WiFi worked ok once the government turned the internet back on. There were a few bugs crawling around in my room at different times (not only a couple of mosquitoes) but at this price I will not complain. I plan on returning for my next business trip to Addis.||||The restaurant serves reasonable food at all times through the day and the strong coffee I had with breakfast was really nice.

user_reviews.Name: Marcello304
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is new, the bedrooms are big and very clean (the cleanning was amazing!). The staff is very kind and ready to help. The owner, Kassech, was an excellent hostess and made us feel home. The restaurant has good prices and the food is most of the times good. Breakfast is good, but they often forget to bring something you asked. And they take too long to prepare it. The street looks dangerous, specially at night. But I will certainly come back!

user_reviews.Name: Curious16447852871
user_reviews.Description: I have visited a lot of hotels here and this takes the best spot. The hotel is clean and tidy, the staff is extremely friendly and i had a good time overall! |The hotel being in a good location eased my worries of travel and i had very good meals in the hotel. Appreciated!

user_reviews.Name: Emi Stikkelman
user_reviews.Description: We loved this hotel in Addis. It's in a nice location and we had the deluxe double room, it's huge! Beds and everything is very comfortable and the breakfast is good. They have a good coffee machine too. Highly recommended to stay here.

user_reviews.Name: Nicholas Barton
user_reviews.Description: Clean mid-range hotel with comfortable beds, hot water and breakfast included. The restaurant is open 24 hours, so no matter when you get back to the hotel you can get a bite to eat. The manager was very friendly on the drive to and from the airport during the free airport shuttle. There were some bugs crawling round my room on one day, but at this price I am not complaining.

user_reviews.Name: Johannes Coetzee
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is very neat and well-maintained. The owner, his wife, security and the staff goes beyond measure to make your stay pleasurable. They operate 24 hours and are willing to help with every request you might have. I exprienced warmth and a close-knit family environment. For the price I paid, I will definitely recommend!

user_reviews.Description:
I'd give them zero stars if possible.

Filthy rooms, stained linen. Musty pillows.
Food is gross - pertpetual stew vibes.

Staff are scammers - they refused to let us board the paid shuttle unless we paid SAR50 (it was paid for by ethiopian airlines as it was an unplanned stopover. We were too tired and desperate to fight so just paid up)

View from the window was decent though.

user_reviews.Description: This hotel located in the middle of the city of Bole... 20 min drive from the airport. The hot water in the shower doesn't work. They provided 2 little bottles of water and that's all. My experience wasn't good with them.

user_reviews.Name: lizn932
user_reviews.Description: DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL. It's a very rough basic 1 star at best. Dangerous wiring, smelly rooms, dirty sheets, bathroom needs total refit, didn't dare use dirty shower, had to ask for towels. We had no choice to stay as got dumped here by airline late at night. Breakfast dire, cold coffee, chipped cups, plastic plates. Staff not helpful at all.

user_reviews.Name: The City’s Spots
user_reviews.Description: Went for the spa and swimming service and it was great. Just needs a little work on the speed of the services.

user_reviews.Name: Iain Needham
user_reviews.Description: This is the worst hotel I've ever stayed in. The rooms smell, are extremely dirty, dangerous (wires sticking out of walls) and noisy. The food was almost inedible. This is where we were put by Ethiopian airways for missing a flight we had no control over. Wifi was also awful.

user_reviews.Name: Curtis
user_reviews.Description: This hotel was recommended to me. The first room was infested with roaches everywhere. I immediately grabbed my bag to check out they offered me another room this time a junior suite. This time I dropped my bag and went to the restaurant. When I returned I went to the restaurant and again infested with roaches. I checked out and booked at another hotel. I asked for a refund but they said they have no money and would have a manager call me in the morning. I'm not saying the hotel is a bad hotel. I just don't live with pest. If they fumigate the rooms it would be good for customers. I cannot recommend this hotel and I will dispute the charges if I do not receive a refund. The location is nice the food was not good in the restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Natnael Tadesse
user_reviews.Description: Excellent location and a classy place. A bit unprofessional when it comes to staff  communication and for some reason their cinema seems to be out of order with no notice (It happened to me twice). Overall, Its a pretty good place

user_reviews.Description: We booked the hall for 400 people with their Golden Premium catering service, and it was good.

user_reviews.Name: Mesay Shanka
user_reviews.Description:
I spent a few days at Vibes Hotel & Spa and overall really enjoyed my stay. They offer an airport shuttle, which was very convenient. The employees are great, friendly and helpful throughout my visit. The rooms are clean and comfortable, and you get free access to the spa. We paid extra for the Moroccan bath and massage, which were worth it. The only downside is the hairdressers; they’re not the best.
Overall, I highly recommend this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: 500hannyb
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful stay at Vibes Hotel. The staff were friendly, professional, and always ready to help. My room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The overall atmosphere was relaxing, and I felt well taken care of throughout my stay. I truly appreciate the service and the room view is amazing would definitely come back again

user_reviews.Name: Lily B
user_reviews.Description:
FROM A FAVORITE TO DISSAPOINTMENT: VIBE HOTEL SHOCKING DECLINE

​My first visit to Vibe Hotel two years ago was a fantastic experience. The place had great energy, it was clean, and everything was wonderful. It was for this reason I was so excited to return. Unfortunately, my second visit was a complete shock, and I'm left questioning how a place can decline so drastically.
​The unwelcoming experience began the moment we arrived. The receptionist, Meskerem, was incredibly rude and dismissive. Her dry, unwelcoming attitude made us feel like an inconvenience rather than paying guests.
​The room itself was a complete disaster. It was not only overpriced but also had a distinct, unpleasant odor. To make matters worse, the bedsheets were wet, making the bed cold and uncomfortable. When I called the front desk about this shocking discovery, they offered an unacceptable excuse, claiming the iron was broken and the weather was to blame for the lack of dry sheets. This is not the standard of service I would expect from any hotel.
​The overall lack of care was most evident in the bathroom. It was absolutely disgusting. The shower had a significant drainage issue, causing water to flood the floor and create a small pool. Additionally, the hand sink was completely non-functional.
​It is disheartening to see a hotel I once loved fall into such a state of disrepair. The lack of proper management and basic maintenance is apparent throughout the property. Save yourself the trouble and book your stay elsewhere. This hotel is not worth the risk.

user_reviews.Name: Santoo Prasad
user_reviews.Description: Ita very bad experience, hotel staff not caring of any customer, they are providing proper Breakfast. Iwas at hotel since 8.00 am and till 10.30 they are saying room is not clean so we are unable to give roo. Have to wait . Really bits a disgusting hotel and staff as well . Don't prefer this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: leul Worku
user_reviews.Description: I had a fantastic experience at the restaurant of vibes hotel. The food was flavorful, beautifully presented, and clearly made with fresh ingredients. Every dish I tried was cooked to perfection, and the portion sizes were just right. The service was also excellent—friendly, attentive, and fast without feeling rushed. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, making it a great spot for a casual meal or a special occasion. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quality dining experience.

user_reviews.Name: Roberto Cazzamalli
user_reviews.Description: Just hit the hotel by chance due to a long layover (hotel was picked-uo by the flight company) but I must admit that it's been a very nice surprise! Room are very moder and clean, breakfast was really good with hand-made cooking and fresh juice of mango and beetroot, plus the staff are very nice and welcoming. Special thanks to Zema that offered me also an espresso!

user_reviews.Name: Habte Worku
user_reviews.Description: We used Vibes for the first time. The service was amazing! The food presentation was very beautiful and very professional service. Thank you Zena Mark's for amazing professional service. Our guest were so pleased with the service. We recommend the service to anyone!

user_reviews.Name: Leul Worku
user_reviews.Description:
I recently stayed at Vibes Hotel and Spa, and I can't recommend it enough. The rooms were spotless, modern, and incredibly comfortable—exactly what you want after a long day of exploring. I especially appreciated the thoughtful touches like soft lighting, quality linens, and plenty of space to relax.

One of the highlights of my stay was the spa area. The sauna was clean, well-maintained, and the perfect place to unwind. It really added an extra level of relaxation to the whole experience.

But what truly set this hotel apart was the city tour they offered. It wasn’t just the usual sightseeing—it felt personal, insightful, and really helped me connect with the culture and hidden gems of the city. The guide was knowledgeable and engaging, and I got to see places I never would’ve discovered on my own.

Vibes Hotel and Spa lives up to its name—it's all about the atmosphere, the experience, and the attention to detail. I’d absolutely stay here again.

user_reviews.Name: Sheldon Emmanuel
user_reviews.Description: A very nice hotel, spotlessly clean, all the necessary amenities and centrally located. Rooms of decent size, and many have balconies with large, almost floor to ceiling glass sliding doors. Very fast wifi. Many local cafes and eateries, wide choice of excellent Ethiopian beers & food at super cheap cost. Short drive away to the airport and the city centre, both very accessible. Owner & staff helpful and proactive. Highly recommend this hotel as a great base to explore Addis for a fantastic price.

user_reviews.Name: Jessicanynke
user_reviews.Description: Hotel is located in a bit of a quiet area. Staff is really friendly and they clean your room on daily base. WiFi connection is really good!! Restaurant is good and very flexible. They cook the dish you would like to eat!||Some things that might be improved: locker and a refrigerator on the room would be nice. Also shower was a bit broken but was nice warm water to use!

user_reviews.Name: addisin2019
user_reviews.Description: AG Palace Hotel is located at heart of Addis in 22 Mazoria, one the best locations to get to anywhere in the city very easily. Rooms are squeaky clean and offer great view of the surrounding from the balcony. Excellent internet service with a very high speed wifi at any location in the hotel. The breakfast that comes with the room is eclectic, extremely tasty and most importantly has the feel and wholesomeness of a home cooked meal. Starting from my arrival to the day I checked out, I was treated to a high quality personalized service with smile and great attitude from all the staff. I was pleasantly surprised to find such a fantastic hotel in this part of Addis for a very reasonable price. AG Palace is a gem in Addis. Go check it out!

user_reviews.Name: traveho251
user_reviews.Description: I discovered Ag Palace Hotel after browsing through reviews and rankings on tripadvisor. Ag Palace Hotel seemed like good value for the price. Reviews about the hotel's Internet connection were fairly good, which is important to me since I require reliable Internet connection for my line of work. ||||After checking into my room at about 6 PM I noticed the TV was very small (about 24 inches or less resembling a computer monitor) and only a couple of channels were operational. Moreover, the sliding door next to my fourth floor balcony would not completely close, slightly causing cold air to enter the room. Most importantly, the WiFi in my room was non-functional on both my laptop and smart phone. ||||I notified the receptionist who asked me to come downstairs to check if the WiFi worked for me in the restaurant, lobby, and/or first floor. The Internet connection was intermittent downstairs and very slow with an average speed of less than 50 KB/s (kilobytes per second). The receptionist tried resetting the Internet connection, which did not make a difference. Then her supervisor or manager came over and they both informed me that the WiFi worked fine on their mobile phone. I'm not sure what they consider "fine", but the web pages on my laptop would not completely load at less than 50 KB/s.  ||||After spending close to an hour trying to sort out Internet connection problems I decided Ag Palace Hotel was not worth my time or money and I asked the receptionist and supervisor/manager to provide me with a refund, but they refused. The two said they couldn't refund my money since I booked online, which made no sense to me. ||||As I exited the hotel at about 7:30 PM, there were no taxi cabs in sight and no street lights on the unpaved road next to the hotel. I asked the security guards if one of them could help me find a taxi cab near the main road, but they said they were not supposed to leave the premise. I went back inside the hotel and asked the receptionist if someone could help guide me to the main road so I could find a taxi cab. She jokingly asked me if I was scared to which I replied that I didn't feel safe on an unlit and unpaved road in Addis Ababa after dark. The receptionist then offered to have another hotel worker guide me to the main road. ||||Later the same night, I booked a room at the Monarch Hotel in Bole where I actually found relatively high-speed Internet access. The average speed at the Monarch Hotel was at least 500 KB/s, which is ten times faster than Ag Palace Hotel. Overall, my experience was horrible at Ag Palace Hotel and I will not be returning. I hope this  experience was an isolated incident and not representative of Ag Palace Hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Kittenator1
user_reviews.Description: Hotel was in the Main Street of Gondar. Smooth quick check in and check out. Staffs are nice friendly helpful. Rooms are decent, spacious. WiFi is good in room and at reception. Hot water for shower available. Was a bit noisy due to facing street side when open window. Room service was good and quick. Food is decent. Breakfast has good selection with eggs made to order

user_reviews.Name: W8881THsarahw
user_reviews.Description: AG Palace is a great value for money. I stayed at this hotel for several months. Having stayed at many hotels in Addis over a short period of time, this hotel quickly became my go to hotel. They rooms were good sized with a nice desk area and some even have two balconies. The staff were really helpful and friendly and the management was great. Nice breakfast buffet and food options. Of note, the hotel is off a side road which can be a little difficult to find at first.

user_reviews.Name: Bethel S
user_reviews.Description: I booked this hotel online from the US and realized it’s almost impossible to reach the hotel due to road work. The road to the hotel is dug deep and no cars can get through. I still ended up paying almost $30 for canceling.

user_reviews.Name: Eteyel Yesuf
user_reviews.Description: Its an amazing hoteland iam happy in your hospitality

user_reviews.Name: EgyptianJudge
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at this hotel for almost six months as I was temporarirly working at the UN ECA building just accross the street from the hotel. It's an excellent selection for longer term stays without the hassle of arranging any logistics in Addis. The staff are all wlcoming and cheerful, expecially the nice ladies at the fron desk. Adeuate claning services are provided and the area has excellent returants (try the Itlaina resturant at the same building) and couple of supermarkets. I highly recommend...

user_reviews.Name: Ķurabachew Àbiyu
user_reviews.Description: If you want to had a pleasant time with your loved ones, I kindly recommend you to visit Nigist Towers Hotel and Apartments.

user_reviews.Name: Flurina_Fr
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at Nigist for two weeks in September and loved it. Rooms are clean and provide all amenities necessary, location is very convenient, and I have rarely seen such reliable and fast internet in Addis. The best of all is the staff though, who are incredibly helpful, supportive, caring and reliable. Free pick up from and drop off to the airport is also very nice. Would definitely recommend this place!

user_reviews.Name: Yeneneh Seay
user_reviews.Description: My recent stay at park lane Addis hotel in Addis Ababa was absolutely exceptional! From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed by the friendly and attentive staff. The room was impeccably clean, spacious, and boasted stunning views of the city. The location was perfect, just steps away from high end cafes and restaurants a making it easy to explore. I highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a memorable stay in Addis Ababa.

user_reviews.Name: Abdelkarim BANI MOULOUD
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed  at Parklane Hotel in Addis Ababa from March 3, 2025 to March 5, 2025, and it was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had. I arrived late at 12:30 AM, only to be met by a sleepy, unprofessional receptionist who first claimed I had no reservation, then suddenly found it. He handed me a room key that didn’t work, and when I asked for a new one, I had to wait because he had gone to sleep!
Once I finally got into my room, there was no bottled water. Again, I had to wait because the receptionist had dozed off. When I ordered a simple sandwich, instead of room service, the security guard was sent to get it. His communication was poor, and he seemed more interested in getting a tip than providing service. To top it all off, the sandwich was awful.
On top of all that, the room next to mine was occupied by a group of loud, strange individuals. I have no idea where they were from, but they were extremely noisy, making it impossible to get any rest.
This hotel has terrible customer service, unprofessional staff, and a complete lack of basic hospitality. I would not recommend it to anyone. Avoid at all costs!

Edit: The lady who owns the hotel contacted me, apologized for what happened, and spoke to me in a kind and professional manner. She also offered me a free night and Ethiopian coffee on my next visit to Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Ashenafi Ayaliew

I was working from the hotel w/ regular video meetings, so high speed internet and quiet environment were non-negotiable for me and I found that *consistently* here. What exceeded my expectation is the staff's professionalism, hospitality and responsiveness and how that was consistent throughout my extended stay here.

user_reviews.Description:
Stayed 4 nights with my 15-year-old son – flawless from start to finish. Perfect location, spotless rooms, and incredibly welcoming staff who treat everyone like royalty. They even surprised us with a cake to celebrate our stay.

Food in both the regular and traditional restaurants was fresh, healthy, and beyond delicious. Excellent gym, pool, steam/sauna, and jacuzzi. Special thanks to the reception team – especially Nardos for making us feel at home.

A true 5-star experience. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Thomad Fergusan
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed at Rava Hotel for a few nights during a weekend trip, and I was honestly impressed. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel welcome—they were friendly, approachable, and happy to answer my questions about the area. My room was cozy and clean, with a really comfortable bed and enough space to unpack without feeling cramped. I also liked that there were small touches, like a coffee maker and a few snacks, which made things feel a bit more personal.

The hotel is in a great location, close to some nice cafes and shops, and it was easy to get around without needing a car. Breakfast was simple but tasty, and it had a good mix of options to start the day. One thing I really appreciated was how quiet the hotel felt at night, which made it easy to sleep after long days of sightseeing.

Overall, I had a relaxing and enjoyable stay at Rava Hotel. It felt welcoming without being pretentious, convenient without being crowded, and I would happily stay there again next time I’m in the city.

user_reviews.Name: Sonja Simmons
user_reviews.Description: I have stayed at this hotel on multiple occasions, both alone and with a group. The breakfast is excellent, and the rooms are clean with comfortable beds. The staff is accommodating, and the spa and salon services are exceptional values for the cost. The pool and rooftop dining are also extremely nice amenities. I enjoy the location. A great value all around!

title: Moonlight Addis Hotel
address: Bekelech St, Addis Ababa 1126, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: GrandTour18582366851
user_reviews.Description: After two years of frequent stays, I can no longer recommend this hotel. The language barrier is a major issue; if you don't speak Amharic, expect constant misunderstandings, as the staff struggles with English. The rooms are outdated, with uncomfortable mattresses and worn furniture, making it hard to relax. The shuttle service is unreliable—rarely available when needed, especially for early flights. Additionally, the staff lacks basic customer service skills, which only adds to the frustration. It's clear that management doesn't prioritize guest experience or maintain the property well. Despite my loyalty, I've seen no improvements, and it's time to look elsewhere.

user_reviews.Name: ifiyer2024
user_reviews.Description: Over the past two years, I have been a frequent guest at this Hotel returning regularly due to my travels. Despite various challenges, I often chose to overlook many of the hotel's shortcomings, hoping for improvements that, unfortunately, never came. However, after much consideration, I feel it’s important to share my experiences to help others make an informed decision. |LANGUAGE BARRIER AND COMMUNICATION ISSUES: If you do not speak Amharic, I strongly advise against staying at this hotel. The staff’s inability to communicate in English led to numerous misunderstandings during my stays. Requests were often mishandled or completely ignored, and the staff would frequently blame these errors on "miscommunication." This language barrier significantly diminishes the quality of service you receive and leaves you feeling frustrated and underserved. AGING FACILITIES: The hotel's furniture and bedding are in dire need of an upgrade. The mattresses are uncomfortable, making it difficult to get a good night's sleep, and the blankets and other furniture are clearly aged and worn. It’s quite disappointing to see a hotel neglect such fundamental aspects of guest comfort. |UNRELIABLE SHUTTLE SERVICE: The shuttle service at this hotel is another major issue. Despite being a customer for two years, I could only use the shuttle service twice. On multiple occasions, I was instructed to take a taxi or find another mode of transportation because the shuttle was supposedly "in the garage." This is especially problematic if you have an early morning flight, as you cannot rely on the hotel’s services to get you to the airport on time. |POORLY TRAINED STAFF: The staff at this hotel seem to lack basic customer service training. Their lack of professionalism and inattentiveness further exacerbate the frustrations caused by the language barrier. It’s evident that the staff have not been adequately trained to meet even the most basic standards of hospitality. |LACK OF MANAGEMENT OVERSIGHT: It is apparent that the management or owners of the hotel do not prioritize the guest experience. The continued deterioration of services and facilities, coupled with the lack of attention to guest concerns, suggests a significant neglect in managing the property. This indifference from the management only adds to the overall disappointment. |After two years of hoping for improvement, I can no longer recommend Moonlight Hotel to others.

user_reviews.Name: Samrawit Ghebregiorgis
user_reviews.Description:
The location, the room and the staffs are friendly, but the service is not. We arrived as a family to stay for month of January. We asked through our representative if there is any payment we need to do before we checked in. He was told to not to worry, we can make the payment during check out.

We checked in for 6 room for different times (three for 2 weeks and 3 for one month). We received calls in different time to ask if we were checking out (we already gave them the dates we were staying, and asking to make a payment).

We asked if we can have an extra bed for child, the staffs say they will ask and get back to us, but no respond until we had 4 days left to check out (we stayed for 3 weeks without the bed, once the owner came they want to place the bed).

Breakfast is cold. When you ask something from the menu and if it is out already they will not make it for example french toast. what ever is out needs to be done before they make another one.

The owner changes rules and ways of doing things which makes the hotel not to be reliable. One day he says we need to make payment, another day when we call for room service, the staff will tell us there is no room service starting today (when we ask why, even if we pay the room service, she would say the owner said so)

Fridges are present but does not work, lamps by the beds does not work and watch out for cockroaches now and then.

If you are looking for hotel to stay for more than 2 or 3 days, look for another hotel. This is not The Place!!

user_reviews.Name: M Tes
user_reviews.Description: Great location for transportation,  restaurants and coffee shops within 5-7 minutes walk and still a quite little corner.  The people that work in this little hotel, from top to bottom are five star.  I extended my stay in the hotel because of the beautiful Ethiopian hospitality I received from them.  The three star rating is because little has been invested in the every day wear and tare of the last five years if service.  Pretty much every thing seems like it hasn't been replaced since grand opening.   Owner seems to be involved in micromanagement of the employees rather than quality control and reinvestment. One thing owner has invested in is a community garden library.  It is across from the hotel and if you are in the area please donate a book.

user_reviews.Name: mhg20182018
user_reviews.Description: Not far from the airport and the train station, in quiet small street.||Easy walking distance to the shops and restaurants,  not far by car to the museums, but not in the tourist belt. If you want to see where middle class Ethiopians live then hotel is perfect.||It is family hotel, friendly and helpful staff with reasonable command of English.||The rooms are very clean and comfortable.||The price of the room includes good breakfast. ||The wifi worked well.||The food in the restaurant is simple but very good and not expensive. Pls try the oriental pizza and the Ethiopian red wine!||Our 6 day stay was most enjoyable. Thank you to the owners and the staff.

user_reviews.Name: Ellen Meyn
user_reviews.Description: Excellent hotel in Addis. Best meal I have eaten in Ethiopia. The shower was amazing and the beds are very comfortable. There are stunning views at night from the terrace. The owner and staff provide wonderful service. Best hotel in Addis at an affordable price.

user_reviews.Name: LL12014
user_reviews.Description: I stayed for just one night at this hotel after a long trip throughout the north of Ethiopia. This hotel by far is one of the best I stayed in throughout my travels in Ethiopia. Nice clean comfortable rooms. Great shower. Food was really nice  the best hotel food I had in Ethiopia. Staff are welcoming and very friendly. Overall I can not fault this hotel. A fabulous hotel with everything you need and close proximity to the airport. I highly recommend the hotel you will not be disappointed!

user_reviews.Name: JHNomadic2
user_reviews.Description: This hotel is special. Not because the price is reasonable. Staff is kind and attentive. The English language skill among staff is varied, however, everyone is attentive and they find solutions easily. The food is amazing. Have no worry, this fantastic, clean, honest, and family-environmet is perfect.

user_reviews.Name: Cropdoc
user_reviews.Description: This hotel is a great place to stay at a very affordable price.  The owner was so welcoming and the staff always provided top notch customer service.  This hotel had the best shower I had while visiting Ethiopia.   The hotel restaurant food was excellent too!

user_reviews.Name: Renee Corbett Reddig
user_reviews.Description: Beautiful hotel! Nice shower with decent water pressure. Comfortable bed. The doors into the rooms were challenging and confusing to use. The restaurant is decent but very very quiet.

title: Garden Hills Hotel | ጋርደን ሂልስ ሆቴል
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Garden Hills Hotel | ጋርደን ሂልስ ሆቴል (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: biruk tesfaye
user_reviews.Description:
I had dinner with my wife at Garden Hills Hotel, and it was an excellent experience overall. The food was truly outstanding — delicious, well-prepared, and satisfying. The hotel also offers convenient parking and a pleasant surrounding environment, which added to the comfort of our evening. The service was attentive and professional, making us feel welcome throughout our visit.
The only drawback was the waiting time, as the food took longer than expected to be served. However, once it arrived, the quality certainly lived up to our expectations. With some improvement in service speed, Garden Hills Hotel could offer a near-perfect dining experience.

user_reviews.Name: lidya abebe
user_reviews.Description: i went to this small Italian restaurant in side the hotel, it has a cozy atmosphere, but the experience was mixed. The food was decent—nothing extraordinary, but enjoyable once it arrived. Unfortunately, it took about an hour to get our order, which made the wait feel a bit too long for a casual meal. The staff were polite, but the slow service was disappointing. With faster service, this place could be much better.

user_reviews.Name: bini abe
user_reviews.Description:
My wife and I recently dined at La Tavola in the hotel and overall, we had a pleasant experience.

Food:The dishes we tried were delicious and well-prepared. However, one downside was that the full menu wasn't available during brunch, which limited our options.

Ambience:The atmosphere was decent, though it didn't stand out as particularly special.

Service: The service was great. The staff was attentive and friendly, enhancing our dining experience.

In summary, La Tavola is a solid choice for Italian cuisine, but if you're planning to visit during brunch, be prepared for a limited menu. We look forward to trying it again during regular hours!

user_reviews.Name: Bethlehem Abera
user_reviews.Description: I had the most wonderful experience at La Tavola Italian Restaurant! The chef was absolutely amazinggg every dish was crafted to perfection and the flavors were simply exquisite. The hospitality was equally impressive, making me feel truly welcomed and cared for. From start to finish, it was a five-star dining experience. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Italian food with exceptional service!

user_reviews.Name: Abiyot Beshah
user_reviews.Description: Highly recommend 👌 fair price for the rooms, good food standardized service.

title: Vamos Guest House
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Muhanad Ali
user_reviews.Description:
To be honest, they are the most nice people, they helped us a lot and provided us free food after breakfast hours. BUT, the rooms are terrible, smells really bad, specially the ones on the first floor, you can hear each step on your head from the second floor, also you can hear them taking a shower and the music next to the guest house up to 1 AM or 2 AM. There were insects too.

I believe this is a very unfriendly place for families. They need to work on the place a lot!

But for that price, its a great place I guess!

Again, the owners and people work their are really really nice!

user_reviews.Name: Robin Hood
user_reviews.Description: Super sweet guest house, very clean and everything works. The staff is super friendly and uncomplicated. Best guest ive ever been in👏👏👏 5 stars in any aspects well deserved 💪 definitely coming back here 🤩❤️

user_reviews.Name: Nahom W
user_reviews.Description: Was decent 👍, but no AC and room is too cold.

user_reviews.Name: akynym
user_reviews.Description: I've been staying at Vamos Guest House for more than 1 week, but the service is stellar in terms of staff's support. They take your feedback and comments seriously. The room is very clean, spacious, and sufficiently furnished. Internet connectivity is spotty, but not bad taking into account that internet quality is generally not good in Ethiopia. Hot water is also spotty, but if you let the staffs know of it, they will do their best for improvement. Breakfast is sometimes a buffet but not always. Usually serves eggs (scrambled or omelet) bread, pancakes, french toast, tea or coffee when it is not a buffet. The buffet has more options. They'll also change the towels and linen when you want them to. Free airport pickup is a quality service in Addis Ababa, since taxi is not that cheap anymore. If people are looking for a budget hotel, I believe Vamos Guest House should be in their list.

user_reviews.Name: TorgutPt
user_reviews.Description: I was very happy in my days in Vamos, a prime base to explore Addis Abeba, a city that I liked also, perhaps because I stayed in such a nice guesthouse. Vamos is full of good vibes. Everybody is nice and pleasant. Staff is professional and efficient, and as I said, always smiley and friendly. The manager is a honest fellow who will help the guests, provide information, solve any problem. Actually we really went out of his way to provide me help, in circumstances which do not need to be told here.||||The location is outstanding, one of the the best things here. If you like to walk you can just go to the main spots in the center, it will be around 2-3 km. Otherwise, you have two MRT stations at less than 500 meters. How convenient is this!? And although there is no restaurant in Vamos, there is one next door with a good variety of food and drinks. ||||The surroundings are great, lots of local shops and a friendly atmosphere. ||||The rooms are nice, there is good hot water and the best Internet I had in 20 days in Ethiopia. Breakfast was good, simple but tasty and prepared with love every morning.||||Another great feature: free pick ups and drops off the airport! ||||Nights were quiet and I slept well. Honestly, this is the place to stay in the city and I dare to say, the cost-quality ratio is just unbeatable. I loved it and wanted to stay there in my last night in Ethiopia but fortunately (for them, therefore for me, because they are lovely) they were fully booked.

user_reviews.Name: markdzuckerman
user_reviews.Description: We were stumped facing the myriad of choices for hotels in Ethiopia’s capital. The name Vamos Guest House stood out; it was ironic to see a Spanish language name in Ethiopia! (Turns out It’s close to Mexico Square).||The pictures looked good, location central, close to the downtown district, the metro, a vibrant shopping street, and had very fair rates. We made the booking.||Right after making the reservation, we were contacted by the hotel, inquiring about our flight information. They said we would be picked up: no extra charge, always included. Amazing: a hotel making things easy, right from the start.||After just a couple of days, we realized we were getting far more value than the money we were paying. The breakfasts were great, the rooms tastefully and comfortably furnished. Everything worked: shower, electrical outlets, TV; help with directions, and getting around. Add the airport transfer.||The staff is fully competent, and led by a fellow named Welde who is a hotel management graduate from one of Ethiopia/s fine universities. He knows what he’s doing. His message to staff seems to be, “always exceed their expectations.” ||We can’t wait to go back to Ethiopia, to spend more time in Addis, tour this fascinating country, and rebook a room at the Vamos.

user_reviews.Name: LuluR563
user_reviews.Description: I love this little hotel where I’ve stayed 3 times in Addis. They always take wonderful care of me with airport shuttles, laundry service and even ordering me some dinner when I flew in late. All the staff from the Manager to the cleaners are delightful. Breakfast can be traditional or for me- a delicious omelette with toast, butter and jam and tea. I really recommend this place- mainly because they really care and it shows

user_reviews.Name: Rachie Rach
user_reviews.Description: Travelled in Sep/Oct 2019 (I'm lazy with reviews).The staff are so nice and friendly. Breakfast in the dining area (if you don't sleep in). For a couple of $ you can get your luggage taken to your room. Plenty of restaurants and tea houses around. I absolutely loved it here. That was my first trip to Africa and I look forward to going back.

title: Kuriftu Entoto Adventure Park
address: Inside Entoto Park, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

title: Yadamzewed International Hotel
address: Belay Zeleke Street Around Semien Mazegaja, in front of Kelemework School Addis Ababa, 1000, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: Belay Zeleke Street Around Semien Mazegaja, in front of Kelemework School Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: bethel teklu
user_reviews.Description:
This experience of the hotel was 4/5. The rooms were cleaned i got my food we got to enjoy our stay we were there for 1 month
the places were close. The rooms were beautifully cleaned we even had the cleaner give us a treat before we left. The service was ok. They had to kick us out of the dinning room becuase of a wedding ceremenoy but lucky the bride invited to stay and enjoy. Also the tv was broken it wasent giving sound. Also the the light was broken only 1 light was working when we tryed to contact the about the broken so they dont think it was us and charge us more. We had a wonderful stay be aware that there is no washing machines that we had to go to our aunts house to clean it. It is honeslty up to you of what you decieded of the reviews. I Went on jan 9 2023.

user_reviews.Name: Yared Fantaye
user_reviews.Description:
This is the worst place to be. I don't recommend anyone to this hotel .
During my stay for about a week , house keeping had to knock my room 2 hrs earlier  and woke me up more than 3 times , just because she wanted to go home earlier.
In another case, I once wanted to order food around 10:00pm from the restaurant. After I confirmed with front desk , I called restaurant on  phone # 103 & 104 . Unfortunately neither of the numbers were not answered.
When I call back to the front desk again, the receptionist told me that I have to walk down to the restaurant.
What I found was , light turned off and no one seems to be there . I started calling loud to finaly find out that a guy is sleeping inside the bar counter section.
He denied the fact that  phone was ringing , and reacted arrogantly with no customer service since of humor.
But the worst is this. I once found a room not cleaned right after check in. No house keeping staff was available to clean  or there was no alternate room to move me to. The only option left was refunding . Unfortunately I was supposed to go back next day since there is no one that night with access to refunding my money. The so called manager who claims to,be family to the owner and other two young girls  had to interview me  for more than 20 minutes before diciding refunding. They seem not happy with their work. My attempt to reach the owners to give constructive critics didnt work.

KNOW THAT NO ONE LISTENS TO YOUR COMPLAIN EXCEPT SAYING SORRY AND LAUGH AT YOU.
That is why I have to say , better to look for another place with descent and respectful environment.
YADAMZEWD hotel is not the one.

user_reviews.Name: fraol anbesse
user_reviews.Description: Disappointing experience at Yadamzewed hotel. Ordered the special pizza with all ingredients, but received a beef and tuna pizza with a little of cheese, not even a hint of chicken. The pizza was incredibly dry, making it difficult to even cut with a knife. Rooms were mediocre, falling short of the 'international hotel' standards advertised. Won't be returning.

user_reviews.Name: Eva Chiffon
user_reviews.Description:
importantly, very clean. One can set the thermostat to ones preferred temperature. The wooden floors complete the wonderful ensemble.
Did I mention the dependably fast WiFi?
Just go there if you need a hotel ... it'll be difficult to do better elsewhere.

user_reviews.Name: Hiwot Bekele
user_reviews.Description: This place is the most disgusting dirty hotel I have ever seen!!! 🤮 Poor customer service! They do not allow you to see a room before renting, “it’s their policy”. If you check in and you find out your room is nasty, stained sheets with blood and other stuff God only knows, the sliding doors to the patio does not work and it’s unsafe etc…sorry but no other accommodation! You stay or lose your money! No remorse no nothing nada! TV does not work. Had to put a chair to keep sliding door for my safety. Room has poor internet connection! Walls are unfinished paint or whatever it is. Carpet is so nasty to even walk with you shoes on! I am beyond mortified and will tell any customer to DO NOT STAY IN THIS DUMP!!! Mind you I was tired and all I wanted was a hot shower and a good night sleep, but here I am upset and reviewing this place instead 😡

user_reviews.Name: Tsega Menkir Wiyohannes
user_reviews.Description:
A while ago, on my trip to Addis, I did stay @Yadamzewd Hotel for two weeks.The reception was great; rooms were immaculately clean; with top of the range bathroom and variety of breakfast dishes to choose from which was a great start for my day. Not to mention, enjoying the authentic Gulele scenery over my terrace window.

The only thing missing on my last visit was Spa. Saying that, I enjoyed my stay there. See you soon on my next visit 👍🏾

user_reviews.Name: Nebiyou Belayneh
user_reviews.Description: I stayed for 17 days at this hotel, I travel a lot and stayed in many hotels, I like to write reviews to make sure the guests are getting what they are paying for. From the front desk to the house keeping everyone was amazing. The rooms were very clean and the price was reasonable. Thank you for great service.

user_reviews.Name: Selam K
user_reviews.Description: I have been a customer for this place, but I gave up on them for sooo many reasons. Don’t even waste your money by going to this place.  They have very poor customer service, I don’t even want to mention about the front desk people, generally they are not happy to see any customers. They are mean, and their rooms are soooo dirty.

title: Mad Vervet Hostel - Addis
address: Haya arat, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia
description: Dynamic, down-to-earth hostel offering a guest kitchen & a vibrant lounge, plus regular events.

user_reviews.Name: Omotoke Fatoki
user_reviews.Description:
Mad vervet is if not the only hostel in Addis- Ababa but definitely the most affordable accommodation option for budget travellers.. Located in central location close to Bole..
However the maintenance of the place is quite poor . A lot of amenities needs repair, the rooms are not well cleaned and the sheets and curtains need replacement..
For $10 a night it is a case of you get what you paid for..

The service though is wonderful, very nice and accommodating staff. They are Willing to help & assist you navigate the country.. it’s a hub to meet other travellers & create great connections..

user_reviews.Name: Nomi Romero
user_reviews.Description:
Perfect hub and THE place to stay for all travellers and backpackers.
You meet everybody here, find friends and buddies and get all the required information, numbers and deals you need for your adventures in Ethiopia.
You can even store your luggage here during your tours for free.
Huge green space, save and secure, attached bar, breakfast options and help with anything you might need.
Kiosks, laundry, shops, bars and restaurants just around the corner and so close to the airport.
(If your driver doesn’t know where to go send him to Blue Sky hotel and then guide him by map).

Minus:
- the kitchen is not very well equipped (plates and bowls are hard to find) and most of the time very dirty as guest don’t clean after themselves. Not a place where you would like to prepare your food.
- the bathrooms are very worn down and the showers are creepy.
- most of the time there is no staff (but the guest are always helpful)

user_reviews.Name: Adam Stein
user_reviews.Description:
It's the only hostel in Addis, so it's a good place to meet other travelers. Apart from that, there's little reason to stay here as you can find hotel rooms for what they charge for a dorm bed. Also, they don't allow you to pay in Ethiopian currency and insist on USD or Euro.
The place has a lot of potential, but no one seems to make sure that guests clean up after themselves, so the common area and kitchen can get pretty messy.

user_reviews.Name: Tricia Burbidge
user_reviews.Description: Ride/taxis have a hard time finding it.  Best to book rides through Ride or Feres app so they have navigation on their phone.  No signage otherwise. Short ride from airport.   Staff met me each time.  Could provide more information about hostel services when arrive (like laundry, meal ordering, coffee, trip booking).  Dogs bark at you and whenever anyone arrives.

user_reviews.Name: Meghyem
user_reviews.Description: Amazing place to meet some lovely people ! Staff are so nice and helpful I even left a package that I will get it after 2 months 😎 see you soon guys

user_reviews.Name: Francesca Giovanna Martinez
user_reviews.Description: Great place, especially for a first-timer in the country. It feels very much like a home, and it's a great way to start to understand how to move around. I personally met very interesting people, and loved staying here. (The staff is really great too!! So welcoming and helpful!)

user_reviews.Name: 339gregr
user_reviews.Description: These guys are having a genuine go. It's a solid building, easily discovered. There are private rooms as well as dorms. The kitchen facilities are good. There is a bar and garden area for drying clothes etc., This place is in a quiet neighbourhood.

user_reviews.Name: Jer_J_D
user_reviews.Description: Great option if you’re a budget traveler and you’re just looking for a place close to the airport. The staff were very helpful and friendly. There are cheap places to eat within walking distance, rooms were spacious too. Downsides: no wifi. Taxi drivers don’t seem to know where this place is, even though the location is accurate on Google maps (for some reason they don’t use GPS). And this place may not be ideal if you want to explore Addis, it’s quite far from downtown. Cheap hotels downtown may be a better option.

title: Hyatt Regency Addis Ababa
address: Meskel Square, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Elegant quarters in an upmarket hotel with an outdoor pool & a spa, plus dining, bars & city views.

user_reviews.Name: Cosmopolitan583364
user_reviews.Description: My recent stay at the Hyatt Regency Hotel in Addis Ababa was wonderful. The location is very convenient to go to near by restauranters and shopping centers. Every staff members I met was very friendly and professional. They  go above and beyond to met customer expectations, specially the reception and Club lounge teams.  The rooms and the hotel is very clean at all time. I stayed at this hotel multiple times and I can't wait to come back again. I would strongly recommend it to anyone looking for a awesome and delightful stay.

user_reviews.Name: Uzi Katz
user_reviews.Description: A top class hotel, but unfortunately something is missed. Design using good materials but the final vibe is just OK. Not “spoiling”. Small topics like towels (bad quality), soaps that are hard  to extract from the bottles etc add to this feeling. We were surprised because a few weeks ago at the Hyatt Zanzibar it was the most spoiling and great vibe. We thought same chain of hotels will be similar feel

user_reviews.Name: Mohammed Abdulraheem Alfakih
user_reviews.Description: I am recently staying at this five-star hotel for almost 10 days so far, and it was truly a pleasant experience. The hotel is very clean and well-organized, and the services were of the highest quality. The staff were very elegant and very professionals. The food was exceptional, and I am enjoying every moment of my stay. I highly recommend this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: jacquelinetheresam
user_reviews.Description: Really delightful hotel experience in a good location for cultural sites, shopping and business organisations and in a close enough proximity to the airport.  This hotel is professionally run with lovely staff, rooms, amenities, spa treatments and food and drink.  I was in Ethiopia for a conference but my daughter joined me for a few days and she loved it too. Check in was welcoming and smooth, as was check out, and we'd happily stay there again and recommend this hotel.  The Fendika cultural hub in the basement is an added bonus.  Lovely music, drinks and coffee.

user_reviews.Name: Monika Kowalik
user_reviews.Description: I don’t leave reviews often but here I have to. My stay was simply amazing. The first thing I need to mention is how kind and helpful everyone from the hotel staff is. They made me feel like home, I felt very welcomed and taken care of. The hotel is beautiful, very clean, rooms are great. Also pool area and gym were really nice. Breakfast was amazing, huge choice of options and everything was delicious. Also great restaurants in the hotel. Everything was perfect. Thank you for amazing stay.

user_reviews.Name: Mikyas Atemew
user_reviews.Description:
Dear Hyatt Regency Management,

This hotel is very good. My friends and I visit many hotels in the city, but I would like to say that the Hyatt Regency is the most luxurious. The staff at the Cascara Bar are all friendly and professional. but I am always impressed by the excellent service provided by Solomon Fekadu—he is an outstanding host and always greets everyone with a warm smile. His cocktail knowledge is excellent, and the cleanliness is exceptional.

He is exceptionally professional. Bravo to the entire team!

Best regards,
Atemew Mikyas

user_reviews.Name: netshetp
user_reviews.Description: Wesen!!!! The coffee lady makes my morning experience amazing every single day. She is always welcoming, kind, and attentive, and her coffee is consistently excellent. Her positive energy truly brightens my mornings, and I always look forward to starting my day here because of her.||Wosen (the coffee lady )consistently delivers high-quality service and creates a welcoming experience for customers. Her attention to detail, strong communication skills, and willingness to help others have significantly contributed to customer satisfaction and team success.|Her positive attitude and dedication make a real difference, and she is a valuable asset to the team.

user_reviews.Name: Kulani McCartan-Demie
user_reviews.Description:
A wonderful time spent at Hyatt Regency Addis Ababa!

We hosted the second half of our Zami Collective Ethiopia Retreat at Hyatt and it was a great base to see the arts, music and cultural landscape of Addis Ababa. Rooms were very comfortable and the staff went out of their way to assist with different requests. Since I extended my stay for 8 nights and there was an issue with the shower water draining in my original room, I was upgraded for the rest of my stay and appreciated the manager and front desk (Betiru and Blen both very helpful) going out of their way to assist with this.

We loved visiting Fendika in the evenings and my guests enjoyed the Spa facilities (shoutout to Senait for the massages), and the pool facilities too.

Some standout staff who were helpful during our 8 days:

Betiru - front desk reception
Blen - front desk house
Thompson - concierge
Meron - The Kitchen
Mahlet - The kitchen
Teweldemedhn - The kitchen
Fasil - Room service
Meseret - room service
Weynshet - lobby cafe

We hope to come back next year for our next group retreat.

Warmest,

Kulani on behalf of Zami Collective

title: Sidra International Hotel
address: Haile G, Haile Selassie St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Polished hotel offering refined rooms with breakfast, plus dining, a spa & a rooftop bar.

user_reviews.Name: mikiyas jenbere
user_reviews.Description: Recently me my wife and went to the Sidra International Hotel, We are so happy for every service we got, everyone from the customer service to top management are awesome,  especially the manager Mr. Hamsalework, he is a great person I have ever seen,  we really appreciate your hospitality.  I really recommend this place for quality service. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: laszlow650
user_reviews.Description: Needed to stay in Addis for a day, because we had some issues with a flight delay. The Food and the Service was fantastisch in any way. The Hotel Transfer was easy and very relaxed. The Staff is super friendly and our Room was allready ready in a few minutes. I’d recommend the Sidra Hotel in any way. |Binyam bester Mann💪🏼🤝🏼

user_reviews.Name: Michele Sabelli
user_reviews.Description:
If Kenyan airways is putting you here as a transit passenger (because why else would someone stay here) refuse.

Its a poorly run and maintianed hotel.
Half the lights in the rooms dont work or have bulbs, toilet seat is broken, broken lock on the main door, we got one towel and that had a hole in it.
The food they offer the transit passengers is so poor its not worth eating there, but no options to go elsewhere.

Lots of staff and few patrons yet it takes 30 mins to clear empty cups from tables and looks like tables are wiped from crumbs abd grease onky once a day by the looks of it.

The staff are friendly, but just not well managed.

user_reviews.Name: Noah Daniel
user_reviews.Description: Sidra was amazing! The room was super clean and cozy, with a nice view. Staff were friendly and always ready to help. I really liked the location — close to shops and restaurants but still peaceful at night. Breakfast was great too. Definitely staying here again next time!

user_reviews.Name: Ephrem Abraha
user_reviews.Description: Good food and service. They have great chicken food for healthy food lovers. It is on main road near to Megenagna and Hayahulet, with inside hotel safe parking space and outside coffee ceremony.

user_reviews.Name: Doug Anderson
user_reviews.Description: I stay here every time. The service and facilities and food and value are excellent. But the elevator was broken the whole weekend!

user_reviews.Name: mahlet mekuria
user_reviews.Description: Place is ok. Food was not so bad. The Morocco bath (by Wossen) was really good.

user_reviews.Name: mohammedaY2764YY
user_reviews.Description: After eight years away from my home country, I spent more than three weeks at Sidra hotel on a family vacation. The staff is fantastic and very welcoming. The free breakfast is fantastic, with Ethiopian options and meals for foreigners available, as well as a professional and friendly chef who always ensures his guests are enjoying his food and checks to see if anything is missing. I enjoyed my entire stay there and am already missing the morning steam and sauna with free foot massages from professional girls. The only thing I would suggest for improvement is repairing the shower equipment because it floods the bath room when taking a shower, and the gym equipment at the treadmill is getting old.

title: Platinum Hotel
address: 2Q9W+2MM Platinum Hotel, Equatorial Guinea St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: naderissah
user_reviews.Description: Starting from my arrival I had beautiful experience the security were so welcoming with beautiful smile face. And also I was lost my phone in the hotel car but they were so nice to bring back my phone and also I have good experience in the reception Genet and Rmoina they were so nice to me and helpful and in the restaurant diriba and hailamariam they were so good at there job they are so welcoming and helpful also in the morning seble help me with my breakfast and about the hotel it is the best hotel I feel like home it is clean and neet overall I had the best experience and I wish If I get the chance to do it again. Thank you platinum for making my staying time the best.

user_reviews.Name: perseverantm
user_reviews.Description: For my very first time in Ethiopia , I spent the few hours before my next flight at this hotel and it’s was really good. The staffs are amazing and very friendly. I would recommend it to anyone who is in town.

user_reviews.Name: Amith Kumar Raul
user_reviews.Description:
Simple and very easy to service each and everyone at the hotel.

Loved the vibe and atmosphere. They value our time of layover and make the best of it.

Had real good Ethopian food and coffee!!

Love this guy treated very nicely.

Thanks for taking care of !!

user_reviews.Name: Eliyas Kassaye
user_reviews.Description:
We are currently staying at Platinum Hotel in Addis Ababa for two nights after our wedding ceremony, and honestly, this place has completely blown us away! We didn’t make any special requests or pay anything extra, but the staff surprised us in the sweetest way.

When we went out for lunch, we came back to find our room beautifully cleaned and decorated with rose petals and romantic touches — it feels like something straight out of a movie! 💐✨

Their kindness, attention to detail, and genuine care have made our stay feel so special and personal. The room is cozy, spotless, and comfortable — everything we could have wished for after our big day.

To be honest, we’re even thinking about extending our stay because of how amazing they’ve treated us 😁❤️. Platinum Hotel, you’ve truly won our hearts — thank you for making our wedding celebration unforgettable!

user_reviews.Name: Miguel Stampa
user_reviews.Description: Awesome staff, reception girls are really nice and friendly. The rooms are good too, buffet restaurant great. They have coffee served traditionally in reception. For those under transit you can manage to go out for some visiting organized with driver. Location is good close to airport and center.

user_reviews.Name: mandy sass
user_reviews.Description: We had a good time at this hotel and a very warm welcome. We are grateful to Brook for the hospitality and so thankful for showing us the lovely Ethiopian food and the traditional ways to eat with your hands. We enjoyed it.

user_reviews.Name: M7952XXpeterm
user_reviews.Description: Great dinner at the platinum hotel. Traditional dishes. Best beer of 2025. 24/7 bar/café. Thanks Divina for your assistance !

user_reviews.Name: Erzik Ebrahim
user_reviews.Description: Housekeeping is excellent, rooms are clean, and the location is good with affordable prices. However, room service is very poor—calls often go unanswered for 30+ minutes, and once my tea order was never delivered. Very frustrating

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie Sherwood
user_reviews.Description:
Last week I stayed at this hotel (for two nights separated by a few days). I am a solo American female traveler and I only speak English.

I found all of the staff so friendly, helpful and patient with me. The location is great to walk to places or to get a taxi and the rooms were clean with a comfortable bed and a good shower.

The first night I was there I asked them to wash my clothes as I had been traveling and almost all of the clothes in my small suitcase were dirty. There were many staff members involved and in the end they washed my clothes and I had them back the next morning, I was so grateful!

For breakfast I showed a picture of a traditional Ethiopian breakfast I was hoping they could make for me and yes, they were so very accommodating and made it for me.

They called a taxi for me twice and twice called a beauty spa to book an appointment for me.

The day I checked out I was able to leave my suitcase there while I spent the day sight seeing.

Thank you so much to all of the staff, I enjoyed my time there!

user_reviews.Description: The Mother and Daughter running this establishment are fantastic. They comped our taxi and made our experience very easy. The location is great for walks to nearby malls and it's a quick trip to the airport - approx 15-20 mins if you have an early morning flight. The breakfast has few items but they are 100% delicious. I would recommend this place to any foreign travelers. The rooms were clean and well maintained. Not many channels to watch on TV but who cares - go out for dinner and a show - both of which the staff can direct you to.

user_reviews.Name: Trip.com Member
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at Jano Hotel in Addis Ababa for 3 nights, and I can say it was a very pleasant experience overall! The hotel is very nice – the rooms are spacious, impeccably clean, and tastefully decorated, offering real comfort. The staff was friendly and attentive to details, making me feel welcome from the start. The breakfast was decent, although I would have liked a greater variety of options to make it even more appealing. The only less ideal aspect was the access road, which is quite bad and can be a challenge, but once you arrive at the hotel, everything more than makes up for it. I warmly recommend Jano Hotel to anyone looking for a nice and relaxing spot in Addis at an excellent price-quality ratio!

user_reviews.Name: ChristinaP2127
user_reviews.Description: Jano Hotel was the property I most looked forward to revisiting during my one-month trip in Ethiopia. The rooms are modern and comfortable, making it the perfect place to relax whenever I returned to the capital. Its convenient location near the airport and the efficient shuttle service made every leg of my journey smooth and stress-free.||There are, however, a few areas that could be improved. The bathroom waterproofing isn’t ideal, so it’s hard to keep the floor completely dry. While the front desk and housekeeping staff are friendly and professional, the hotel seems less effective in managing noisy guests late at night. During my roughly one-week total stay, I had to use earplugs on more than half of the nights due to poor sound insulation and loud door noises in the hallway.||Despite these minor issues, Jano Hotel remains a comfortable and recommendable choice. With improvements to the bathroom waterproofing and soundproofing, it could easily become one of the best stays in Addis Ababa.

user_reviews.Name: 102ashenafig
user_reviews.Description: I'm interested in the Jano Hotel at 22 Mazorya. The location sounds promising. I am looking for a hotel that provides clean and comfortable rooms. I hope to see positive reviews about the hotel's amenities, such as Wi-Fi, breakfast options, and helpful staff. I look forward to experiencing a pleasant and memorable stay at the Jano Hotel.

I chose Point Central Hotel even though I didn’t personally know anyone there, yet the service I received and the welcoming smiles made me feel completely at ease. The food was fantastic, and I can’t wait to spend three days there with my OGA! I highly recommend this hotel — the standard is sky-high, the quality speaks for itself, and the price is unbelievably fair. The environment feels so safe and comfortable that I wish I could stay for a whole month!

The staff spoke good English and we're very friendly and helpful.

user_reviews.Name: Guy S.
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is very nice anyway I'd like to amend my review based on your response, just to avoid being taken for granted. Payment in birr was possible both in cash and by card. In fact, I paid for the restaurant by card, and the exchange rate was 5% more favorable than the one applied by the front desk. The fact that the exchange rate is completely arbitrary is demonstrated by the fact that the hotel next door has a better rate. So let's not tell lies. Dear tourists, it's better to pay in birr; it's not possible to prove the opposite.

user_reviews.Name: Kalkidan Mulugeta
user_reviews.Description: We had a great stay, more reasonable price than other hotels around bole, clean room and a nice shower as well as a good choice of breakfast. The only hiccup I saw is the staff uses the same elevator as the guests which is fine but sometimes they also use it to move food which leaves a horrible smell (raw fish in our case) and there was blood on the floor.

user_reviews.Description: Overall experience was really good. Very helpful staff, rooms are clean, and the food is decent. I hope they add a few more local dishes in their dinner menu at restaurants and room service.

user_reviews.Description: On the 16th floor and there was a overwhelming smell of sewage from the shower and sink drain. We tried to cover them up with towels but did not work. Had another couple state they also were on the 16h floor and had the same. Food was cold in the buffet for breakfast. I’d stay somewhere else next time.

user_reviews.Name: enat taddesse
user_reviews.Description:
Our experience at the hotel was below average. The food tasted good but the service and the staff members professionalism was really disappointing.

During our 5 nights and 4 days stay, we have been barged on in our rooms by unprofessional staff, already taken room was assigned to new customer while we we were there and haven’t checked out, we had even came across injera served at breakfast that was about to rot. And our belongings from a rented meetings space were wiped out without our permission so the room can be given away to another customer.

In conclusion: overall customer treatment, hospitality best practices and professionalism are in great question.

Sidama Lodge, also known as Sidama Inn, is a charming 3-star hotel located in the vibrant Bole district of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Its prime location offers easy access to key attractions and amenities, making it a convenient choice for both business and leisure travelers.

Overview

user_reviews.Name: Zefaniah Ayenew
user_reviews.Description: A hidden gem in the hub of the city. Its rooms are so spacious, with kitchenettes. The whole property is just full of beautiful artwork that gives a relaxing feeling allover. Just a perfect value for money.

user_reviews.Name: 123gelilaa
user_reviews.Description: The best place to stay whenever you’re in Addis. The service was excellent. For me it felt like a home away from home. I had a problem booking online but once I reached them everything was at ease. They are quick to answer (within an hour) and can make all arrangements or give an answer to any necessary enquiries. ||||Email: sidamalodge5000@gmail.com||Ask for : Woudenshe ( the supervisor) she will be more than happy to help

user_reviews.Name: ciaraj263
user_reviews.Description: I stayed in Sidama Inn for 10 days in March 2019 and my time spent in the hotel was a highlight of the trip.||||The staff were incredibly friendly & helpful and could not have done more to make us feel welcome, it truly felt like a home away from home. The aesthetic of the hotel is beautiful and elegant, the entrance doors are stunning works of art which lead to a foyer with high ceilings where the walls were adorned with huge paintings by local artists. The foyer had an inviting and welcoming ambiance, with couches to relax on and several bookshelves from which to borrow a variety of books. The staff were always on hand and happy to give advice about where to go and how to get there. The rooms were very large, spacious, clean and comfortable - I slept incredibly well throughout my stay here. There was ample room to relax and the room included a couch, a table and chairs, a full kitchenette, coffee table, a large wardrobe, and a large balcony. The continental breakfast we had each morning was delicious and plentiful and always served with a smile! My favourite part was having different fresh fruit each morning with yogurt, though the scrambled eggs with Ethiopian spices were always excellent. And of course, the coffee. It was such a joy to stay here, the worst part was having to leave. Thank you to all the staff who made our stay such a memorable one! I look forward to returning again.

user_reviews.Name: trektravel123
user_reviews.Description: I stayed in the Sidama Inn for 12 days earlier this year and it was definitely the icing on top of a wonderful experience. The rooms were spacious, airy and impeccably clean, and they also came with a kitchenette. Breakfast was really good, there was a great selection on offer including food made to order(the scrambled egg was exquisite). The staff were brilliant and really friendly, any questions we had about Addis or Ethiopia in general (first time visiting) were answered promptly and it definitely helped us out with the recommendations that they gave us. The wifi was also great. Next time I return to Ethiopia I will definitely stay in Sidama Inn and would recommend it to all travelers without any hesitation.

user_reviews.Name: Shinta Nishino
user_reviews.Description: Good hotel! Staffs are well trained and very kind to us, service is good. The room is clean and huge! Good thing is that you can cook in your room as there is small kitchen. Mostly WIFI works well. The morning buffet includes fruits, yogurt, serials, bread etc. Coffee is roasted here and taste nice! I met a lot of international org. staffs working in Ethiopia at this hotel, which also guarantees the quality of the hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Liamontrek
user_reviews.Description: I stayed in Sidama Inn at Atlas Square for a week in June and absolutely loved it. The staff are wonderful, always on hand to help and offer advice on places to go and things to do in Ethiopia. The rooms are very spacious and always clean. Breakfast is simple but fresh and well cooked. The reception area has great examples of art by local artists, adding a nice touch to the place. Would have no hasitation in recommending Sidama Inn to anyone traveling to Addis.

user_reviews.Name: 534JoseM
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at Sidama Inn since oct 2016 until apr 2017 doing a consultancy. My experience at Sidama Inn was superb... all staff very kind, always eager to help. Comfortable rooms, equipped with kitchenette, clean, hot water, etc. Nice balcony, view to Bole rd and Atlas area crossing. Excellent location with everything at walking distance. The owner always trying to help. Breakfast buffet type  included. I called home away from home. Internet and cable tv somewhat limited but most of the time due to local conditions and not due to hotel defficiency. So glad to have stayed there.
