user_reviews.Name: Mas Tadesse
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed for a week at Mado Hotel in Addis Ababa and had an excellent overall experience. The service was exceptional—staff were consistently attentive and professional. The Wi-Fi was reliable for the most part, though I occasionally had to turn off my camera during video calls. The breakfast buffet was delicious and offered a wide variety each morning.

I tipped housekeeping 50 birr daily, and my room always smelled amazing, clean, fresh, and well cared for. My only issue was that the refrigerator in my room didn’t work. I didn’t realize it until late in my stay and chose not to report it, but it’s something worth checking for future guests.

Aside from that, I highly recommend Mado Hotel and would gladly stay again.

Excellent stay at Mado Hotel
Clean, spacious rooms, great service, and a perfect location in Bole. The staff were welcoming, and the breakfast was fresh and tasty. Loved the gym and spa. Highly recommended for both business and leisure!

user_reviews.Name: sara arnold
user_reviews.Description: I love Mado Hotel.  The best staff, rooms and location!  Very clean and the restaurant is so attractive .  The breakfast is amazing including a juice and salad bar and many hot entrees.  You must visit to see for yourself.

user_reviews.Name: wegderes gudaey
user_reviews.Description: Well, this is one of the best for me and the room is really so clean and the service is like family and friendly. Well the location is one of the best come to see and enjoy your best time.

user_reviews.Name: Wedgeres
user_reviews.Description: The location is one of the best in a Baller road you can walk you can see different things and then also nearby the hotel there is pastry shop and there is nightclub. The location is one of the best.

user_reviews.Name: Me S
user_reviews.Description:
This hotel used to be my go to whenever I visited Addis. It used to have great quality control for room maintenance and service. I am disappointed to report that in my three consecutive stays over the past couple of years, which are about three weeks each, I have witnessed decline of quality in room maintenance and services.

We had to switch rooms four times for our 10 days stay in search of a bathroom/shower without visible black mold infestation. There is a visible black mold everywhere in the bathrooms, and when I shared this with the front desk and management, they didn’t seem very concerned (or understand how much of a health hazard that is) however they did switch me to a different room which has less black mold.

title: Triple-e Hotel and Spa
address: 22 mazoria, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Thuba Ndebele
user_reviews.Description:
Pleasant people, but we could hardly understand each other because of their poor English-speaking skills. As we drove from the airport to the hotel I thought we were being taken somewhere else to be robbed. The hotel's in the middle of a city that looks like a shanty town. We stayed in the hotel all day and didn't move out in fear. Although the portions were generous, The food was spicy,  no warning given. My kids couldn't even finish the lunch leftovers which they took for their supper. They didn't go to the restaurant for supper.
The showers are blocked such that they pour like a tap instead of a smooth spray. Water takes 5 minutes to get warm.

user_reviews.Name: Zelalem Gebremeskel
user_reviews.Description: I have experienced exceptional 👌 service and memorable atmosphere with best price. The staffs and management are amazing. Best coffee ceremony. 24hrs power and water. The location is favorable to the most places you want to visit. Security at it's best. Overall they made my trip to Addis unforgettable. Thanks to all the team of the hotel TripleE.

user_reviews.Name: abhijeet singh
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely Disgusting Experience – Stay Away!

I had the worst experience of my life at this so-called Triple E hotel and Spa. During my stay, a window in my room was in a cracked state before I checked in the room. I ignored it as I liked the room after checking few rooms in the hotel. One fine day the housekeeping girls broke it during cleaning and I was sitting outside the room and saw it. Once the cleaning was done I informed the reception and they came and cleaned it. Finally when I was checking out, the staff immediately blamed me for it without any investigation. I was interrogated, accused, and mentally harassed for something I did not do.

They treated me like a criminal, not a guest. No proof, no apology—just pure humiliation. The management was rude, unprofessional, and shockingly insensitive. I felt completely unsafe and disrespected. I told them to call police and let them investigate. There were two lady staff who were asking me to prove that I have not broken the glass. Finally, the management took the responsibility and the matter was closed. This place lacks basic hospitality, decency, and common sense and is highly unsafe for foreigners.

Avoid this hotel at all costs unless you want to be mistreated, blamed for their negligence, and made to feel like garbage. Disgraceful.

user_reviews.Name: Arielle TdelaP
user_reviews.Description: I went here for a massage, not for the hotel, at the recommendation of a guide. It was an excellent very firm deep tissue massage. My only complaint is that I asked for 1.5 hours, for which they charge more than a straight 1.5 conversion, and then the masseuse only gave me a 70-75 minute massage. I would consider returning, but only for 1-hour, as obviously they prefer not to go longer.

user_reviews.Name: Hafte Mebrahten
user_reviews.Description: I recently stayed at the Triple-e Hotel and Spa for more than 10 days. I had a fantastic stay and experience. The rooms are clean, the bed is so comfortable and clean as well. The corridors in each floor are attractive and inspiring. I am very satisfied with breakfast service and the fitness and Spa service too.  The food served at the hotel was delicious and freshly prepared, with a variety of options to choose from.  Additionally, the Hotel has a nice bar (Gabi Bar and lounge) on the roof top in which you enjoy a lot with the live music and a great view to the city. Overall, I highly recommend other people to stay in Triple-e Hotel and Spa for its outstanding service, cleanliness, and charming environment.

user_reviews.Name: Brook Zerihun
user_reviews.Description:
I recently stayed at Triple-e Hotel and Spa, and had an unforgettable experience. The location is simply unbeatable, with easy access to all the major attractions and amenities.
One of the standout features was the excellent free breakfast each morning. The variety and quality of the food were top-notch, catering to all tastes and preferences.
After a day of exploring, the sauna and steam rooms were the perfect way to unwind and relax. The facilities were clean, well-maintained, and truly luxurious.
I also treated myself to a massage at the hotel's spa, and it was fantastic. The therapist was skilled and attentive, providing a deeply relaxing and rejuvenating experience.
Another pleasant surprise was the great pricing. For the quality of the amenities and services provided, the cost was more than reasonable and offered excellent value for money.
Overall, Triple-e Hotel and Sap exceeded my expectations in every way. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and top-notch amenities at a great price in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Laine Haile
user_reviews.Description: I had a great exprience at Triple E hotel during my visit from USA. The room, the spa and the breakfast area are all clean and refreshing. I also enjoyed the cozy coffee ceremony area by the hotel entrance. I highly recommend this hotel if you're searching for a cozy and clean hotel to stay.

user_reviews.Name: サブChiharu
user_reviews.Description: Even though I had made a reservation through a hotel reservation site, I was told that the hotel was fully booked and was guided to another hotel. This happened to me, and to other people too. I chose this hotel because it had a bathtub, but the alternative hotel did not have a bathtub and the Wi-Fi was not working, which was the worst. There was no alternative service. Why are they allowing reservations even though the hotel is fully booked? The service at this hotel is not good at all.

title: Southern Addis Hotel | Atlas | ሳውዘርን አዲስ ሆቴል | አትላስ
address: 2Q3M+Q82 Southern Addis Hotel | Atlas | ሳውዘርን አዲስ ሆቴል | አትላስ, Namibia St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Southern Addis Hotel | Atlas | ሳውዘርን አዲስ ሆቴል | አትላስ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: kid cool
user_reviews.Description: Horrible hotel ， always power off, no hot water and old facilities like broken bed. The only remarkable point is it’s expensive price

user_reviews.Name: daniellaochbogdant
user_reviews.Description: We slept at this hotel three nights after landing from Europe. We came back at “our” hotel  after a two weeks tour in the South of  Ethiopia. It feels like coming home! The room is spacious, light and clean, the breakfast includes both Ethiopian traditional dishes and a continental  alternative. We like most of all the fresh juices and the omelette! We eat even dinner at the restaurant and even that was good! |Besides we’ve got help with the transfer from the airport and even from the buss terminal when we arrived from the South. |Anyway the best of all are the services and the friendly way the staff have been meeting us all the time.

user_reviews.Name: Yosef Kebede
user_reviews.Description: Very nice clean room. Price ok. Location is good. Wonderful house keeping. I had good time. Only breakfast and shuttle service need improvement. They messed up my pick up and dropped off.

user_reviews.Name: 99alexa
user_reviews.Description: If you want a nice hotel convenient for the airport-this is it. This hotel has lovely rooms with great comfortable beds and duvets. Wifi works and staff are very friendly and could not be more helpful.They try really hard to please any way they can. Food is good and transport to the airport is provided. I stayed overnight and then a week later I had a room for the day as I was travelling overnight which was very convenient. It is walking distance from small shops and cafes. There is a kettle and teabags in the room and a hairdryer-not often provided in Ethiopia.  Very happy with the service and staff

user_reviews.Name: mknippenberg
user_reviews.Description: The Southern Addis Hotel is a Perfect stay to discover Addis Ababa and even Ethiopia!||||The airport pickup was on point even late at night and totally reliable. The check in process was easy and the rooms are spacious, high standard and totally clean. The whole staff was extremely attentive and professional.||They helped us with every problem that came up in the first days (e.g. buying a local SIM card) and organising our trips throughout the country.||The hotel has a spacious lobby with a calm atmosphere, a nice bar and a restaurant that serves both local and international dishes.||We would definitely come back!

user_reviews.Name: brookel110
user_reviews.Description: The rooms are a bit small but they are clean. The bed is comfortable and the room was pretty quiet. The bathrooms are also clean and modern. Never lost electricity while I was staying there and the bathroom has a hairdryer. Nice breakfast buffet and prompt room service. The wi-fi was hit or miss.

user_reviews.Name: 71peacen
user_reviews.Description: This is a thieving hotel with terrible staff. I was charged an extra night for somebody else. I only realised after i had checked out  and had to go back to get my money. To make it worse the reception staff were terrible disrespectful and downright rude. They acted as if they were doing you a favour letting you stay there. I suspected the treatment would have been slightly better if one is caucasian or local. The rooms were small too. All in all a bad experience.

user_reviews.Name: SteveH6095
user_reviews.Description: We were made to feel very welcome as soon as we checked in thanks to the excellent service from the friendly reception staff and Abraham the manager, who was extremely helpful during our entire stay. The rooms were spotlessly clean, the wifi worked well and the bar area was comfortable and relaxing. Waiter service in the restaurant could be improved though.

user_reviews.Name: nathnael alene
user_reviews.Description: Many thanks to the hotel staff. They been so helpful throughout my stay. Clean rooms and good breakfast all the way through

user_reviews.Name: Fanuel Abate
user_reviews.Description:
Great stay.
The rooms are clean and the staff is help full. The location was convenient for for me. Near the airport for business traving.

user_reviews.Name: Helen Samson
user_reviews.Description: Highly recommend this hotel. Perfect location - close to the airport, near main street. The staff were friendly and helpful.

user_reviews.Name: TheDaoudus
user_reviews.Description: I had a nice stay! Staff is really friendly and the rooms are clean!

user_reviews.Name: Ali Mohammed
user_reviews.Description: I have satisfied with all service this hotel provided for me. Very approciated well come and acceptance

user_reviews.Name: Abel Getachew
user_reviews.Description: It's location which is at the center of Bole makes it a very good choice. It's not on the main road so there is no noise pollution. Many services and businesses are found nearby.

user_reviews.Name: Sam Is
user_reviews.Description:
The manager and staff wasn’t friendly
And it was very noisy cuz of the bar underground

user_reviews.Name: HowardH707
user_reviews.Description: Hotel situated not far from airport, in backstreets behind Namibia Street. Can take some finding unless you have a guide. Clean; friendly, helpful staff; fairly quiet, but small quirks: no towels provided, wardrobe had hangers, but no rail on which to hang them, etc. Breakfast edible but unmemorable. Management decided to undertake serious plumbing repairs, with a hammer, at midnight: had to get up & complain. Was told noise would stop: it didn't. Not what I needed after a 7-hour flight.

address: 2Q7J+J7X melat pension, Haile Gebre Silase St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Sido Yohannes
user_reviews.Description: Affordable price...best location

user_reviews.Description: Details

user_reviews.Name: Rachelle ELIEN
user_reviews.Description:
I spent years asking for soap here. No towel inbthe toilets. You enter the room and no one told you you need to turn on the tv for wifi.
Food is something. Not fresh like they have been in the microwave several times. Baked potatoes are hard to eat.

Please revise your notebook. Almost 11 here and I cannot shower . No soap after asking both the cleaner and the reception

user_reviews.Name: 226alexandrap
user_reviews.Description: I was assigned this hotel by Ethiopian Airlines for a short night as I had a 12 hour layover, I arrived among a group at 11pm. |The check-in process was quick. I had a room on the 6th floor.|But the bathroom stinks, isn't well maintained, not really clean, and I didn't have hot water. |The bed sheets were obviously not fresh. The bay windows don't close fully : you have to have one side open.|We were supposed to be provided with dinner but all we had was coldish leftovers from what I can assume was laying there all day.

user_reviews.Name: Seagul Bird
user_reviews.Description:
WARNING, they are cheaters, I booked online via agooda, and paid everything. When I reached the hotel they told me they haven't received the booking and the price listed on the internet is not theirs, claiming the third party company placed the price on their behalf. I found another one in reception arguing with them for the same reason.
They are very bad and cheaters, they put low prices when customers come they change and increase prices claiming they didn't specify the price. How come such companies like Bookings and Agooda do such stupid things? It is not logic.

user_reviews.Name: צבי קרויטורו
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had an amazing stay! The hotel was beautiful, perfectly located, and the staff were outstanding — always friendly and ready to help with anything we needed. They truly made our vacation special. Highly recommended!
The reception manger is amzing

user_reviews.Name: Amirarsalan
user_reviews.Description:
This hotel really needs to change a lot of things.
The bathroom was extremely dirty.
No Slippers are available for you.
The breakfast is terrible, you can perhaps only have the coffee.
The bed is extremely old but the bed sheets were clean.
Water pressure is very low and in the mornings you almost don't get hot water.
WIFI keeps disconnecting.
Only a few of the recoptionists speak English, they are overall friendly.
The balcony glass is broken and they have not fixed it. The room ends up being filled up with musquitos.
The bathroom light bulbs were flickering and almost dead.
Overall I would definetly not choose this hotel in the future. Considering that it is a 4 start hotel with this price range you can be staying in a much nicer place.

The area around the hotel is no place to walk. Of course it is the government's work to reconstruct the roads. But overall, there are no asphalts at all. Big groups of street dogs walk around the area at night which might be dangerous considering they can bite.

user_reviews.Name: Anil Mukundan
user_reviews.Description:
Stayed here overnight during a transit. The room was clean and comfortable. The menu and food serving style need major improvement — it felt like the kitchen doesn’t prioritize layover guests, even for a la carte order.

Big thanks to the front office and housekeeping staff for their excellent service. They helped retrieve a phone I had forgotten in the room. Much appreciated! Will ofcourse stay there again!

user_reviews.Name: AZ
user_reviews.Description: 1star only because the staff was ok otherwise this hotel is a nightmare. Very poorly maintained unclean place. Getting wifi is such a process. Absolutely worst experience.

user_reviews.Name: Julien Charles Bissock
user_reviews.Description:
Im mister julien charles Bissook,  l'âm cameroonian; since l came yesterday here in Magnolia hostel, l feeling very happy, because things are here with professionaly.
And I meet mr Betsegaw the front office manager and he soo kind and good person

title: Marriott Executive Apartments Addis Ababa
address: African Avenue Kebele 19, Woereda 01, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia
description: Polished apartments in an upscale hotel offering an outdoor pool, Mediterranean dining & a bar.

user_reviews.Name: Pradeep
user_reviews.Description:
During my stay of more than a month, I truly felt like I was living in my second home rather than a hotel. Gashaw, Addis, Salem, and every single person I met here were not just staff members — they became my family away from home. The care, warmth, and attention they showed me went far beyond expectations.

From the very first day to the very last, they made sure I was comfortable, safe, and happy. Every detail was taken care of — whether it was before I left for work or when I returned after a long day, the duty managers always checked on me with genuine kindness. The way they welcomed me this year, remembering me from my last visit, touched me deeply and filled me with joy. That gesture alone showed how much they value and cherish their guests.

The service here is simply top-notch. It wasn’t just about fulfilling my needs, but about anticipating them, ensuring I never felt away from family. The memories created in Room 1010 will stay with me forever.

Leaving a place that feels like another home is never easy, but I leave with a heart full of gratitude. Thank you, my Marriott family, for everything. You have given me more than just comfort — you have given me belonging, warmth, and unforgettable moments.

As a friendly suggestion, I would love to see an upgrade in the Internet/Wi-Fi speed and TV connectivity to support seamless pairing with all mobile brands. Since I use Apple, I felt a bit limited at times. I believe enhancing this would make an already perfect stay even more remarkable for every guest, regardless of the device they use.

user_reviews.Name: nesttoc
user_reviews.Description: The staff was exceptionally courteous, kind, and considerate. From the reception to the housekeeping, the restaurant personnel. I appreciate Addisalem and Abel, who both did everything within their power to make my stay more memorable. Addisalem actually went out of her way to get me a huge pack of Ethiopian coffee to bring back home with me. Will definitely visit again!!

user_reviews.Name: Samrawit Migora
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed at this hotel with my husband and our baby girl, and we had such a wonderful experience. The rooms were very clean and comfortable, but what made it truly special was the staff. Everyone from reception to housekeeping, restaurant, and security was incredibly kind, attentive, and welcoming.
They especially adored our little girl, which made us feel even more at home. We are so grateful for the excellent service and warm hospitality. Highly recommend this hotel for families!

user_reviews.Name: Fery Lissanu
user_reviews.Description:
Firstly, I would like to sincerely thank Samson for his outstanding customer service and professionalism. He treats everyone with respect, which is one of the key reasons we keep coming back.

As for our overall stay at the Marriott Hotel in Addis, the location is excellent, and the safety of the hotel is reassuring. One of the major advantages is that it’s an apartment-style hotel, which is very convenient.

That said, I do feel it’s important to mention some areas that need improvement—especially considering that this is a 4.4-star hotel apartment with relatively high pricing. The level of service we received did not always reflect the price we paid. In particular, the room service was below expectations. As someone who has stayed here multiple times, often with children and for extended periods, I believe there’s a noticeable gap between the cost and the quality of service provided.

I strongly recommend additional training for management, front desk staff, and the room service team to ensure the guest experience aligns with the hotel’s standards and pricing.

Lastly, I would also like to thank the rest of the staff for their efforts and hard work during our stay.

user_reviews.Name: rajeshkF6629WM
user_reviews.Description: I came from India last year and have stayed for more than a year here alone, came for an official project.|This place has been my 2nd home and the staff here including front desk, house- keeping and the support staff has been consistently excellent in providing the services. After staying for such a long time, they have become a family to me in Ethiopia, always welcoming and caring for the chores and needs.||Whenever I went to the restaurant for breakfast and in lobby, I never felt alone. Staff was always there for me to check and have good conversations. The food they served always was amazing and if we don't need anything from the buffet, they cooked and served fresh dishes according to our taste and palate. ||Special shout out and cheers for - Gebere (master chef), Hanna (Baking team), Meko, Selam, Tarik (Spa), Sali, Addis salem (Food Safety), Lem lem (Admin), Tinsea, Fikri, Samson (Front desk), Teyba & Selam (house- keeping) and many others as I am running out of names.||Thank you all  - Ame sage nalow and Igiziabhiheri yibariki for making my stay memorable.

user_reviews.Name: LufunoM20
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at the Hotel for 7 great and well experienced days, the room was great with exceptional room service. An added bonus was care and attention I received from the staff, especially the manager Ms Addisalem, they were awesome.||I am definitely staying there next time I am in Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: 399duncank
user_reviews.Description: I have stayed at the Marriot Executive apartments for a couple of times.  From the airport pick up to service at the reception which is always amazing. I always enjoy my stay at the Marriot, the rooms are spacious, clean and have all the amenities that i need. A special shout out to the ever friendly and proactive staff. I would like to specifically mention Sheferaw one of the bar tenders. His service with a smile and always engaging makes my moments at the bar worthwhile. I would recommend Marriot to anyone visiting Addis

user_reviews.Name: Ali Alkeswani
user_reviews.Description: Lovely team and very helpful. But unfortunately I got an insect bite from the room which is I’m suffering now from and I went to the hospital when I returned back and got the right treatment and they confirmed the bed bugs bite. Hotel team need to work more on rooms cleaning and sanitation all times. Not staying again in this hotel due to cleaning and sanitation issues.

title: Daylin Guest House
address: Namibia St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: L Abraham
user_reviews.Description:
If you want to stay in Addis Ababa in a clean, high-quality, and well-maintained hotel, I would definitely choose Daylin Guest House.

First of all, the location is excellent. It is situated in Bole, close to many restaurants, shops, and other amenities, which makes everything easily accessible.

The hotel itself is of outstanding quality. The rooms are very clean and well maintained, the showers are excellent, and the overall finishing is top-notch. The WiFi was also very good, fast and reliable throughout the stay.

The service is exceptional. Every single staff member is friendly, professional, and genuinely willing to go the extra mile to make guests feel comfortable. They are always ready to help and ensure that your stay is as pleasant as possible.

The breakfast is absolutely delicious, fresh, and well prepared, a perfect start to the day.

For the price you pay, you receive excellent value, outstanding accommodation, and great service. I would highly recommend Daylin to anyone visiting Addis Ababa.

user_reviews.Name: Eskinder Fikade
user_reviews.Description:
I had an absolutely wonderful stay at Daylin  guest house! From the moment I arrived, the front desk staff made me feel welcome with their warm hospitality and genuine attentiveness. They were always ready to help with a smile, whether it was answering questions, giving recommendations, or making sure everything about my stay was comfortable.

The entire management team deserves special recognition as well. Their professionalism and attention to detail were evident in every aspect of my visit. The rooms were spotless, the facilities well-maintained, and everything ran smoothly—clearly showing the pride and care they put into making guests feel at home.

It’s rare to find a place where the service feels both exceptionally professional and sincerely personal. This guest house delivered that and more. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for not just accommodation, but an experience where you are truly valued as a guest.

user_reviews.Name: Karim Bacchus
user_reviews.Description: Fantastic place to stay if you want peace and quiet. Very friendly staff and very clean rooms. Breakfast is delicious and there is fresh buna in the lobby every morning. I'll be returning here next time I'm in Addis! Amesegnalehu!

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Getachew
user_reviews.Description: I was pleasantly surprised to discover this beautiful guest house in Bole for a friend who was visiting from Canada. I also ended up staying for a day for myself as it was such a wonderful experience of extraordinary rooms that were clean, hot shower and personable staff member who can actually hold a conversation. And the price was super reasonable with great location. I highly recommend this place. While the location can be difficult on first experience, I guarantee you would love it once you visit it.

user_reviews.Name: Yowhans Ghirma
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed at this hotel for a few weeks and I was amazed by how the rooms were kept clean and the attentiveness of the staff who go above and beyond to help their customers especially Solomon, Monica, and Haymanot to mention a few nevertheless the whole staff were professional and helpful. The general manager Mr Teferi was very accommodating and always there when needed.
I will definitely stay there in my next visit to Addis Ababa.

user_reviews.Name: salah baloul
user_reviews.Description: I believe the hotel deserves a four-star rating. A warm welcome and friendly service are provided. The rooms vary, but I stayed in a deluxe room. It's a comfortable space with large beds and a sophisticated bathroom with all its modern amenities. There's a sofa in the living room, a desk, and a side mirror at the entrance. There's a closet, a minibar&  kettle inside. Providing daily drinking water tea bags and sugar  , and excellent daily housekeeping. The staff at the reception, the restaurant, and even the entrance and laundry all have an elegant presence. The location is convenient in the city center. The price is very reasonable for what it offers.

user_reviews.Name: Ahmed K. Mohamed
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience at this beautiful and spotlessly clean hotel. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, always going above and beyond to assist me. What impressed me most was their honesty and professionalism. After I checked out and had already travelled, I realized I had forgotten $300 USD in my room. I contacted the hotel, and to my relief, they immediately informed me that the money had been found and was safely kept at the reception. A friend of mine later collected it without any issues. Truly grateful for their integrity. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Vin Cent
user_reviews.Description:
My stay at Daylin Guest House was fantastic!  I was immediately made to feel at home by the staff's warmth and helpfulness.  The rooms had everything I needed for a restful stay—they were modern, clean, and incredibly comfortable.  The setting was comfortable and serene, and the location was handy.
The warm hospitality and meticulous attention to detail were what most impressed me; it truly felt like a home away from home rather than just a hotel.  To anyone traveling through the area, I heartily recommend Daylin Guest House.  Unquestionably worth the money, and I plan to return!

title: RoyoKasas International Guest House
address: BOLE SUBCITY, KEBELE 07, HOUSE NO. 182B, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Streets of the world
user_reviews.Description:
The most beautiful 4 days I spent in this beautiful house. I love Ethiopia. I recommend this place. It is safe and secure.
🫶🇪🇹🫶🇪🇹

user_reviews.Name: Kay Ed
user_reviews.Description:
Excellent value!

For a very reasonable fee, we were picked up at the airport, and had the same driver as our guide for the duration of our 4 day stay.

Abinet is very friendly, prompt, knowledgeable and an excellent English speaking tour guide.
He made our stay very memorable, treating us like friends.

Our room was a large, spacious one bedroom apartment, with kitchenette. Mini fridge and two stove top burners. Counter and large sink.

However, the cost of food is so inexpensive, why bother cooking when you can eat a fabulous dinner at a nearby restaurant, for two people, with soft drinks, taxes and tips included for $10 USD. Or order from the kitchen, and stay in to eat.

4 bread rolls/buns and a croissant are only $1 USD from a fantastic nearby bakery.

There is lots of hot water with thick, soft towels in the bathroom.

Storage cupboards and night table cupboards for clothes in the bedroom.

The room is very airy and cool, with patio door and balcony.

Our room as described and pictured on the website.

Hot Breakfast is included.
Dinner and drinks are served in the evening on the main floor, in a nice dining room and lounge.

There's an elevator, gated entrance and 24 hour security.

Free WiFi, and Satellite TV.

Very friendly and helpful front desk staff. Owner is a lovely lady who lived in Canada, and is often on site.

Very warm and welcoming atmosphere. Close to the airport and everything in the city.

I highly recommend the RoyoKasas!

user_reviews.Name: meaza addis
user_reviews.Description: Wooow our  visit in Ethiopia were the best . The owners is Roman she have  Zembaba Restaurant in Toronto, Edmonton  + Fortmac now she have  ROYOKASAS  Guest house in Addis and we stayed for 2 Weeks for this special Guest House I will give 5 Star . user_reviews.Description: Stayed here for over a month and loved the friendly, amusing staff. The room could use a bit more upkeep, but the location—close to the airport and central areas—is great. At $17 with breakfast, it’s a solid budget choice and good value overall.

user_reviews.Name: danielbU4740NY
user_reviews.Description: This is one of the worst hotels I have ever stayed at. I don’t even know where to start. I’ll just point three big issues I had even though I could right about 20. First I booked through my bank and had the reservation. When I came to confirm they gave me this other women’s number. I call that woman and she says she has no idea and she gives me another number. The next number doesn’t know anything either. So after having dinner elsewhere I go back to show them my reservation through my bank. After some back and forth they give us a room. We were supposed to get doubles but I was okay with a single room because it was late and cold and I was tired. But then they took my drivers license because they still could not confirm the reservation even though I showed them the receipts. Anyway we get to the room and it’s the dirsties looking room you will see. The beds were stained and disgusting looking. But they smelled okay I guess. I was going to just chalk it up as a loss and book somewhere else but my girlfriend said it’s only one night and we should stay. We slept with our clothes on. That’s how nasty the apartment looked felt and everything. The bed was also uncomfortable. We get up in the morning, although I didn’t really sleep due to scary sounds from our neighbors. Lord knows what goes on these types of restaurants. The bathroom was also bad. We come down around 8 am ready to leave. But they won’t give me back my drivers license because they still can’t confirm the booking. So my girlfriend and I are still waiting while this gets resolved. It’s been half an hour so far and we want to get as far from this place as possible. Please good people stay away from this “hotel.” The breakfast looked terrible as well. Definitely wouldn’t eat it if you gave us money. I would give it half a star if I could.

user_reviews.Name: Ralf Heckel
user_reviews.Description: Was here 2018. Room clean, staff kind and breakfast tasty. I used the restaurant at the evening and this was also tasty. Will come back.

user_reviews.Name: Ela
user_reviews.Description: The location is good and the price is fair, but the service is very poor, and the workers are rude. The chairs and tables were covered in dust. When we informed the workers, they told us to clean it ourselves using a small towel from the washroom. We spoke to the manager, Belay Belina, but received no help. We ended up cleaning the tables and chairs ourselves. Dirty bed sheet, dusty floor. No slippers, no WiFi.  Additionally, the phone in the room was not working, and there is very limited parking space. It seems there is no active owner, who cares for the hotel. Overall, this is not a good place, and I do not recommend this hotel to anyone. Go somewhere else.

user_reviews.Description:
It’s just a regular place you can lodge, if you’re out of options. The place is a bit shabby, as they could be room for more improvement.

They’re just by the road side and very easy to miss, if you’re not accustomed to the roads there. The hotel complex is situated just by the traffic light and gets really noisy mostly in the day time and evenings.

The waiters act as though they’re doing you a favor. And it takes them forever to bring in your order. Their food is not really bad, but a bit pricey though. The avocado juice was eeh 🥴

Moving on…

A small parking space for few cars. To be on a safe side, get there with a cab and drop off by the traffic light and walk in.

I think I have my reservations as to recommending to anyone.

user_reviews.Description: I recently had the misfortune of staying at Atlas International Hotel Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. My three days at this hotel were nothing short of a disaster. Save yourself the trouble and look elsewhere for accommodations that prioritize cleanliness, professionalism, and basic guest satisfaction.

user_reviews.Name: Ana Baptista
user_reviews.Description:
Unfortunately, my stay at this hotel in Ethiopia was incredibly disappointing. The room was dirty and infested with bed bugs, making it impossible to sleep in the bed. The loud music blaring from across the street added to the discomfort, leaving me with no choice but to spend the night in a chair.

To make matters worse, the restroom was also in poor condition, with an unpleasant smell and lack of cleanliness. This was by far the worst hotel experience I've ever had. I strongly urge Ethiopian Airlines to reconsider sending their clients to this establishment.

The issues I encountered during my stay were completely unacceptable, and I sincerely hope that the hotel management takes immediate action to address these concerns. Guests deserve a clean, comfortable, and peaceful environment, none of which were provided during my stopover.

My hope is that my feedback will prompt necessary improvements, ensuring that future guests do not have to endure the same subpar conditions. It's crucial that the hotel takes swift and decisive measures to rectify these shortcomings. Thank you for considering my feedback.

user_reviews.Name: Rahel Gemechu
user_reviews.Description:
I stayed here for a month. Overall, had an okay time. I mostly spent the day out and came back to the hotel to sleep.

The pro:

The regular housekeeper was great and cleaned the room very well and listened when told to fix certain things.

Front desk was available and always answered my questions.

The Con:

Food was not great, breakfast was included in my stay and only managed to eat twice and both times made me sick. Not vegan friendly as well.

Laundry service ruined my clothes twice. Who washes white with colors 😔😒

The whole month I was there, they had construction at all times. Even when trying to sleep.

The icing on the cake was when checking out, even though I paid for the month of December and the nerve of these people had the audacity to tell me in Ethiopia the months are only 30 days and since December has 31 days I still needed to pay for the 1 Extra day 🤣😄

Also, tried to have me pay for room service I never used... Huge scammers

I wouldn't recommend it for long stay, but now I see people mostly uses this Hotel for transit.

user_reviews.Name: 92alulak
user_reviews.Description: Despite the rooms being on the smaller side, I found them very comfortable and well-kept. The view overlooking the right side of the African Union complex is a nice bonus, offering an interesting look at the area. One of the hotel’s biggest advantages is its location—within walking distance of the African Union and conveniently close to Addis Ababa International Airport.||The atmosphere is professional and pleasantly quiet, making it a great place to focus or unwind. For the price, the value is excellent, especially compared to other hotels in this specific area that offer even less space or fewer amenities. If you’re planning a longer stay, it’s worth asking about extended-stay discounts.||Among the amenities, the sauna stands out as a highlight.|Service is another strong point: the staff are genuinely friendly and attentive. I forgot an adapter for my charger during my stay, and they went out of their way to find one for me—a small gesture that made a big difference.||Overall, Blue Next Hotel delivers comfort, convenience, and great service at a fair price.

user_reviews.Description: I used the hotel for the first time for work. My stay at the hotel is very pleasant. The room is spacious and quiet. It is convenient for work. It has a city view. It is very close to the African Union. The staff are all nice. The food is delicious. I will come back soon with my family

user_reviews.Name: wendayehu Seyoum
user_reviews.Description:
Blue Nest Hotel is located at the best location in Addis Ababa with a distance of 05 minits walk from the AU HQ. The location is very well secured due to the presence of Int. organization & deplomatic residence's around.
The hotel is clean and managed by good hospitality staff.

user_reviews.Name: craigk744
user_reviews.Description: The room cleaners were the most eager to help that I have seen. The restaurant staff were also very eager to help. They did not always have all the food on the menu (I was not there at a peak time), but what they did have was great. For the price and location, I was very pleased. The one significant disadvantage was that the internet connection was not always good.

user_reviews.Name: 880ignatiusw
user_reviews.Description: Good, Decent rooms and services. Very friendly and helpful staff. Even let me use their phone for local calls for free. Slept on the 5th Floor. Only negatives here are Tiny elevator which wouldn't fit more than two people with luggage and the abundance of mosquitoes even on the 5th floor.

user_reviews.Name: Optatus Henry Nchimbi
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is good and its services are okay. Meals are of good quality and will in general you are doing great you only need to improve in few areas like repair or renovation of your room, keeping slippers or sandlles or any simple open shoes in the rooms, have the style of dressing rooms keep on changing on daily basis especially if a  person occupies it for more than a day. user_reviews.Description: Good location but no parking. You’ll park at the curbside or if you are lucky, you might have one of the 2 special spot they have. Modest and decent rooms. Good price, not expensive at all.

user_reviews.Name: tigist berihun
user_reviews.Description:
I visited the spa today for a Special Moroccan bath, and I was excited to try the new additions, especially after the price increase. Unfortunately, I feel it wasn’t worth the extra cost. The biggest issue was the electricity—while I was in the steam room, the power kept going on and off, which left me freezing and really uncomfortable. The spa’s generator wasn’t working properly, and it took over 15 minutes to restore the power, which was very disappointing.

After that, I went to the hair salon and requested a wave and a trim. I was told they had increased their prices, but I was okay with that and just wanted to look good. However, when I got to the styling station, there was only one stylist available—everyone else was assisting him. He was busy doing eyelash extensions, and after I was washed and dried, I was told to wait for over an hour while he finished. I felt like the staff didn’t have enough hands to handle all the customers. There was only one stylist available, which made the whole experience very frustrating. I left without getting the hairstyle I planned, and it seemed like they didn’t care about my concerns.

Overall, I’m really disappointed with the service today. It was not what I expected, and the experience left me feeling very unsatisfied.

user_reviews.Name: ProffieG
user_reviews.Description: Its an amazing hotel, value for money is great. Spacious rooms and very clean. Friendly staff too. Club H2O adds more options when you cant sleep at night, so you dont have to go out. Yes, can be noist from outside with competing night clubs, but a closed window can do the trick. Dont look for English breakfast, be content to experiment with local breakfast and you will have a good time.

user_reviews.Name: gracen452
user_reviews.Description: I stayed at Yoly's while attending a conference. The rooms were great! Clean and comfortable with plenty of space. the house keeper was great though she could not speak English. The cafe did not have much variety for breakfast.

user_reviews.Name: safariman1705
user_reviews.Description: Yoly Hotel in Addis Ababa is an excellent hotel with the best nightclub in town -H20.||||The reception staff are likable and easy on the eye!! - but more importantly they are all very professional and helpful at all times. I have stayed here several times and would recommend it as it represents excellent value for money. ||||If you can afford it book the Presidential suite - It has a wonderful terrace with a great view of Addis and its spacious suite has an electrical massage chair. The bathroom and bedroom are both equally spacious.

user_reviews.Name: 577ronaldn
user_reviews.Description: This is a nice hotel, with large rooms and situated in the middle of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. It's service is better than what I have experienced in other hotels and it has very friendly staff. ||||The main challenge is that breakfast is not served early and this can make you late if you have an early appointment. ||||I suggest this hotel for new-times in Addis, as it is centrally located and not too expensive.

user_reviews.Name: Lawrence Kimaru
user_reviews.Description: They have a holistic service, from a salon, spa, barber, hotel.. All in one. 😉 The cost is relatively within range. If you are in town, give it a shot. No regret. Got an amazing hair cut. Would definetly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: asmori
user_reviews.Description: the hotel is a very nice place to stay the rooms are big and well layed out, the bathrooms are quite small but OK. however kindly be advised that the hotel in on the bole road which is a street that is very active till 5 am in the morning so quite noisy.||The hotel offers breakfast but in the small restaurant on the ground floor this however is not well run and if you have a deadline to keep you may as i did leave without the breakfast due to the time it take to make your breakfast.||||they have a gym but i was also tole that they would leave the hotel by the end of the month so really do not know what will happen next

user_reviews.Name: young_gates
user_reviews.Description: I stayed here for about a week and overall for the price I had a pretty good experience. There were a few minor issues but the hotel tried their best to resolve. The second day i was there i realized that there were a bunch of ants in my room, the hotel offered to move me to another room or come in and spray. I didn't want to cause too much trouble so I just asked them to spray and it pretty much got rid of the ants. Another issue was they didn't tell me until halfway through my stay that the local calls i made actually were act being billed to my room by the minute. I asked if the calls were free when i checked in and they told me that they were, but it turns out my calls to mobile phones were not free (da heck?). We settled on just paying half of the costs, but i still feel as though they should have been more clear with that policy at check-in. ||||Everything else was pretty cool. The service was good. They have a nice cafe that is open 24 hours on some days. The breakfast is free there for the hotel guests until 12:30pm I think. One of the better clubs in Addis (with tons of pretty women) is in the basement, so you don't have to leave the hotel if you want party. The city is really safe, you can pretty much walk around at anytime and nobody will bother you. When you walk out of the hotel to the right, there are a bunch of restaurants and shops etc. that you can get to on foot. At the first main intersection you can make a left and there are even more places to frequent. If you make a left coming out of the hotel you may run into some unscrupulous women who will want you to share your wealth with them if you know what i mean. Directly across the street is a little store where you can buy everything (bottled water etc.) for really cheap. ||||Oh and be careful taking the taxi from the hotel (or any hotel for that matter). They will try to charge you 200-250 birr to take you to a place that another taxi a block away would only charge 80 birr to take you to. If you have any questions about anything, feel free to contact me.

user_reviews.Name: Mathew Berhanu
user_reviews.Description: I’ve stayed at this hotel twice now, and both experiences have been absolutely amazing. From the food and rooms to the service and hospitality, everything exceeded my expectations. The owner and staff were incredibly kind and welcoming. The first time I visited, I brought my kids, and they were treated with so much warmth—they loved it just as much as I did. For the price, this is hands down the best hotel you can find in Ethiopia. I truly can’t recommend it enough!

user_reviews.Name: Yinka Osuolale
user_reviews.Description:
Abyssinia Hotel comes highly recommended. While it may not be on par with 4- or 5-star hotels, it's certainly not bad at all. The hotel is satisfactory.

The staff's service is superb - welcoming and supportive. However, I suggest they consider labeling their food options during breakfast.

One area for improvement is the lingering smell of cigarettes in the bedroom corridors, which I found unpleasant.

Additionally, the hotel could enhance its cleaning and maintenance culture, particularly regarding the windows and curtains. This would give them a competitive edge.

On a positive note, the bed was extremely comfortable.

Rating:
- Ambiance: 3.5/5
- Staff: 4.5/5
- Comfort: 4.5/5
- Cleanliness: 3/5
- Overall: 3/5

user_reviews.Name: Anthony Gwilt
user_reviews.Description: This was an in transit stopover hotel supplied as part of the ticket with Ethiopian Airlines, so I wasn’t expecting much. But it does has an air of tired and uncared for.

user_reviews.Name: Nebil Aman
user_reviews.Description: Excellent  hotel 🏨  shuttle bus  breakfast  service   everything   from A to Z perfect

user_reviews.Name: Dayal
user_reviews.Description:
We checked into the old-style 4-star Abyssinia Renaissance Hotel and were pleasantly surprised by the value for money. Given the price we paid and the quality of service we received, we were quite happy and satisfied with our stay.

Upon arrival, we encountered an issue with logging into the Wi-Fi on our laptop, but the IT staff were prompt and professional, helping us resolve the problem successfully. The hotel is clean, and the rooms are spacious and comfortable, which made for a relaxing stay.

One thing we appreciated was the attention to cleanliness. In other 4-star hotels we’ve stayed at in Addis Ababa, we’ve often noticed dirty spots on the bedsheets, which was disappointing. However, this hotel had no such issues, and the bedding was fresh and spotless. This level of care and attention is one of the reasons we decided to stay here for three nights.

Overall, if you’re looking for a comfortable and reasonably priced hotel in Addis Ababa with good service and clean accommodations, the Abyssinia Renaissance Hotel is a solid choice.

user_reviews.Name: FarAway429751
user_reviews.Description: The hotel is perfectly located near Bole area. The price is very fair in comparison to the products. The staff is very friendly although this a language differences. The manager Niti is an outstanding manager. He believes in customers satisfaction, he works 7 days a week (which is hard to find) I worked with hilton hotels for 15+ years in different states in USA as GM. My wife and I are enjoying our stay. Thanks for Nati and his staff. Nati is treating all guests as if we're in his own house to me that is customer service is and what a successful manager will do goes beyond the call of duty always. (the exercise room is beyond perfect) |Abdel & Julie room 204

The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful. I would recommend this place and will definitely come again.
You can order for breakfast, e.g. continental breakfast with toast, pancakes, omelet. The rooftop terrace is great as well.

user_reviews.Name: Sara S
user_reviews.Description:
We stayed at Averi Hotel as a family of four for 25 wonderful days, and it truly felt like a home away from home. The hotel offers a calm and peaceful atmosphere. The surroundings are quiet and child-friendly, making it an ideal place to relax and unwind.

What stood out the most was the warm welcome we received upon arrival — we felt genuinely cared for from the very beginning. The service is top-notch, with friendly and helpful staff.
The team was exceptional — always available, attentive, and eager to assist with anything we needed.

The rooms were spotless and well-maintained throughout our stay. Both breakfast and dinner were delicious, which we truly appreciated.
Another great advantage of Averi Hotel is its location. It’s close to everything you might need and this made getting around very convenient for us.
We highly recommend Averi Hotel to anyone looking for a relaxing, business- or family-friendly getaway with outstanding service, a warm atmosphere, and a great location.

It’s a place we would gladly return to.

user_reviews.Name: Yohan Berhe
user_reviews.Description: I received first-class service from the moment I arrived at the hotel until the moment I left. The prime location of the hotel is a big plus. The facilities were top-notch, and the view from my room was simply stunning. I have stayed at a dozen hotels. This was on the top of the list of best stays/experiences ever. The friendly and helpful staff were there for every need of mine. My Amharic isn’t that good so.. it helps a lot that the manager Mike spoke fluent English and he was very helpful with everything I need it. Thank you so much.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Getachew
user_reviews.Description:
The hotel service was disappointing. The staff at reception were unprofessional and unhelpful. I expected better hospitality and attention to guest needs.
Perhaps, my complaint regarding Poor Hotel Service and Reception Experience waking us to remove the car from parking lot in late night while we sleep knocking the door none stop same time calling by hotel phone and the car flash on all night no body's telling us then car is not moving now they're not helpful at all even if we are in urgent need to leave the hotel.......... We face very bad experience we don't recommend anyone to stay here.

user_reviews.Name: Estifanos Berhane
user_reviews.Description:
I recently attended an event at Cot Hotel, and I must say, the experience was fantastic. The staff were incredibly friendly and polite, always ready to assist with a smile. The food served was absolutely delightful and added to the overall positive experience.

One thing that stood out was the ambiance — the entrance to the hotel was spotless and inviting, creating a cozy and welcoming atmosphere right from the start. Cot Hotel provided the perfect setting for the event, and I would highly recommend it for gatherings or even just a relaxing stay.

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Solomon
user_reviews.Description:
I heard a lot of good things about this place from friends, but today it completely disappointed me.

I had an urgent meeting and chose it because it was the closest option. After ordering, I took out my laptop to join the call. A waiter immediately came over and told me laptops are banned because of a “new policy.”

Banning laptops in 2025 makes no sense. It ruined both my meeting and my impression of the place.

I don’t recommend it for anyone who expects a modern setup.

They seriously need to rethink and improve their policies.

user_reviews.Name: Letera Asfaw
user_reviews.Description: I usually go to Cot to work when I don't have power at home. It's a quiet place that helps me concentrate. On weekends, I often visit Cot to watch football games with friends. Since it’s located nearby, I also meet my business partners and friends there. Aside from their WiFi connectivity, everything is quite enjoyable. If you are a sandwich lover, I highly recommend you their chicken sandwich.

user_reviews.Name: Makena Yvonne
user_reviews.Description: Lovely service! Mike is an excellent host. Its quiet and the staff are dedicated to excellent service

user_reviews.Name: dukayea
user_reviews.Description: Me and my husband had a great stay at Cot. The staff are so nice, helpful. The hotel room is very spacious and comfortable. The lounge up stairs is a convenient and great spot to set meet ups  with friends for long staying guests like I was. overall great experience.

title: Yohannes Guesthouse
address: Haya Hulet 22, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: maramawit alemayehu
user_reviews.Description: I recently stayed at Yohannes Guesthouse and had an amazing experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making me feel welcome from the moment I arrived. My room was spotless and well-appointed, offering a perfect blend of comfort and luxury. The hotel amenities, including the pool and restaurant, were top-notch. The location is ideal, with easy access to everything. I highly recommend Yohannes Guesthouse and will definitely be returning on my next visit Addis  Ababa.

user_reviews.Name: Yassin Shalan
user_reviews.Description:
I recently visited Addis Ababa with my family and stayed at Youhannes Guesthouse, and it was truly an exceptional experience. This newly built guesthouse stands out as one of the most impressive places I’ve ever stayed.

We had the privilege of staying in the penthouse on the 8th floor, which was absolutely stunning. The interior design is luxurious, thoughtfully furnished with everything you could possibly need—from a large TV to the smallest details like teaspoons. The rooms are spacious, impeccably clean, and feature large windows and balconies that offer breathtaking views. The atmosphere is calm and comfortable, making it ideal for families or anyone seeking a relaxing retreat.

One feature that really stood out for us was the massive 60-square-meter terrace, which was perfect for our 2-year-old boy to play and enjoy. The location is also fantastic—close to all the essentials, making our stay even more convenient.

The pricing is very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the facilities and services. The staff deserves special recognition for being incredibly welcoming, polite, and always ready to assist, adding a personal touch to the experience.

A special thanks to Habtamu Getachew for his patience, kindness, and exceptional support. He made everything so much easier for us, and his dedication to ensuring our comfort did not go unnoticed.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Youhannes Guesthouse and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Addis Ababa. It’s a perfect blend of comfort, luxury, and value, and I look forward to staying here again!

user_reviews.Name: gora Secka
user_reviews.Description: I stay 2 weeks in yohaness guest House but it was wonderful. The staff are very helpful and friendly. The rooms are very good and big. Is not very far from the airport. Very easy for taxis.

user_reviews.Name: TA&his brother
user_reviews.Description:
